**About Colan Infotech - https://colaninfotech.com/**

Colan Infotech is a fast-growing **CMMI Level 3** digital transformation and technology services company delivering innovative solutions across **AI, Cloud, Mobility, Web Applications, DevOps, and Product Engineering**. With a strong global footprint spanning the **US, UK, India, and GCC**, we partner with organizations to build scalable, future-ready technology products. Backed by a culture that values **innovation, ownership, continuous learning, and collaboration**, Colan Infotech provides an environment where people grow, contribute meaningfully, and make a real impact.

  

**About the Role**

We are looking for an **ERP Presales Consultant** who can understand customer requirements, map business needs to ERP solutions, conduct product demonstrations, and support the sales team with solution presentations and proposals. * Maintain strong relationships with customers and stakeholders throughout the pre-sales engagement.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 3+ years of experience in **ERP Presales, ERP Consulting, ERP Implementation, Business Analysis, or a related role**.
* Strong understanding of **ERP business processes and modules** such as Procurement, Inventory, Sales, Finance, HR, CRM, etc.
* Hands-on experience in **requirement gathering, business process analysis, and solution mapping**.
* Experience in conducting **ERP product demonstrations and customer presentations**.
* Strong understanding of ERP implementation lifecycle, including **configuration, customization, testing, data migration, deployment, and go-live**.
* Ability to translate business requirements into **functional and technical ERP solutions**.
* Experience in preparing **proposals, solution documents, presentations, RFP/RFQ responses, and process flows**.
* Strong customer-facing and stakeholder management skills.
* Good understanding of ERP integrations, workflows, reporting, and customization.
* Ability to work closely with **Sales, Business Analysts, Developers, and Implementation teams**.
* Strong communication, presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

a33f1752.title: Platform Sales – Partner Level (Technical Pre-Sales)
a33f1752.description:
The Opportunity

*"FICO is looking for an addition to our talented and successful Global Platform Software Sales Team based in India. As a member of this team, you will represent FICO’s flagship software offering called the FICO Platform as the Solution Sales Executive (SSE). The FICO Platform Sales Team (SSEs) are an overlay sales role, and you will partner with Key Account Managers as well as both Technical & Industry Pre-Sales teams to round out the go to market. The SSE would have strong technical pre sales skills. Each SSE carries a quota for a dedicated set of Enterprise Accounts within their region comprised of both existing and target Platform customers. The SSE is responsible for driving initial adoption (Land) and growth (Expand) of Platform by educating and inspiring our customers about the enormous opportunity to empower business users to leverage the FICO Platform as the ‘brain and central nervous system’ for the creation and iteration of customers journeys that involve data, analytics, and strategy design and execution across the enterprise.*
"– Hiring Manager

.

What You’ll Contribute

* Work with existing and new customers to understand their key initiatives in Consumer Lending and Retail Banking across Marketing, Originations, Customer Management, Personalization, Collections and Fraud. Share expertise and thought leadership in Decisioning, Analytics, & Optimization within Financial Services with the goal of helping our clients leapfrog the competition leveraging FICO’s cutting-edge Platform.
* Build relationships with senior client stakeholders in Business and Technology to gain insights into their most urgent decision management related problems while articulating FICO’s platform capabilities.
* Research and shape potential solution opportunities through collaborative engagement with internal Key Account Managers, Pre-Sales Domain Experts and Pre-Sales Architects to formulate and effectively position solution proposals.
* Ensure clients are delighted with solutions purchased to create win-win relationships that are long-term, expanding, and profitable.
* Collaborate across internal FICO teams including Global Solution Architecture, Product Development, Finance and Professional Services to shape a cohesive sales effort that educates our customers on the tremendous business value the FICO Platform delivers.
* Work with the largest and most advanced Financial Institutions as well as a core set of leaders in other sectors.
* Manage sales to quarterly and annual targets, with significant earnings upside when targets are exceeded.

What We’re Seeking

* Bachelor’s degree and, or experience developed in work environments.
* Strong track record building relationships and a knack for understanding the client’s industry and business/technology challenges
* Demonstrated success structuring and selling complex, enterprise software solutions to large clients in financial services/banking a plus.
* Knowledge or experience in Consumer Lending, Credit Risk, Account Management, Retail Banking and Fraud is also a plus.
* Experience with Databricks / similar platforms is a plus.
* Have a deep interest in, and or experience in both the technical and business use of data, behavioural profiles, decision management, orchestration, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Simulation, and Optimization in SaaS offerings.
* A Passion to learn and educate customers and FICO colleagues through presentations, and conversations. Strong soft skills, and a genuine interest in people and a desire to help them be wildly successful.
* A Passion to work hard under tight deadlines and a pension for thriving in high pressure situations.
* A Collaborative style of working where the strengths of teammates are celebrated and the whole team is greater than the sum of its players.
* Ability to travel up to 50% of business week as we need to know our customers and their aspirations intimately to truly make difference.

Our Offer to You

* An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
* The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
* Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognised for doing so.
* An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

**Your Role**
-------------

* Design secure and scalable network architectures using Azure Virtual Network, Network Security Groups, Application Gateway, and ExpressRoute.

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fuelled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. 7d21a362.description:
**About Chargebee**

Chargebee is a leading provider of billing and monetization solutions, empowering businesses with recurring revenue models to streamline revenue and finance operations, capture actionable insights, and drive growth.

Chargebee is trusted by businesses of all sizes, including Zapier, LegalZoom, Lambda, Freshworks, DeepL, Condé Nast, and Pret a Manger, and is proud to have been consistently recognized by customers as a Leader in Subscription Management on G2.

With headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, our team members are based primarily in India, the U.S., and Europe.

**About the Team**

Product Support helps Chargebee customers succeed after go-live. We troubleshoot complex billing and subscription workflows, debug API and integration issues, and partner with Product and Engineering to improve reliability, reduce repeat tickets, and strengthen self-serve through better documentation and tooling.

**About the role (Job Summary)**

You will own complex customer issues end-to-end across Chargebee’s product, APIs, and integrations. You will reproduce problems, identify root causes, communicate clearly with customers, and drive resolution with the right internal teams. You will also turn support patterns into better self-serve content and actionable product feedback.

**What you’ll do (role and responsibilities)**

1. Build deep product and API expertise to deliver advanced technical support across email, chat, and calls.
2. Own and drive complex issues end-to-end by reproducing problems, troubleshooting systematically, and coordinating internal teams when needed to reach a confirmed resolution.
3. Provide consultative support by understanding customer workflows and guiding best-practice configuration and integration choices.
4. Troubleshoot customer API usage and integrations, including payload analysis and debugging in a test environment.
5. Support integrations across CRM systems (HubSpot, Salesforce), finance platforms (NetSuite, Xero, Intacct), and payment gateways (Adyen, Authorize.net, Stripe).
6. Identify recurring pain points and trends, and convert them into actionable feedback for Product and Engineering to improve the product and supportability.
7. Create and improve self-serve content such as knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and runbooks to reduce repeat tickets.
8. Improve team efficiency through better workflows, tooling, and process improvements, while supporting customers 24/7 through rotational shifts.

**What you’ll bring (required skills and experience)**

1. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
2. 3+ years supporting a SaaS product in a customer-facing role, with strong debugging and problem-solving skills and a structured troubleshooting approach.
3. Clear, polished communication with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
4. Hands-on experience with APIs, HTTP fundamentals, and tools like Postman
5. Working knowledge of JavaScript, and comfort reading code and API payloads
6. Experience supporting or integrating with at least one ecosystem tool such as Salesforce, HubSpot, NetSuite, Xero, Intacct, QuickBooks, or similar platforms
7. Familiarity with subscription billing concepts such as plans, coupons, invoices, taxes, and payment workflows
8. Willingness to work rotational shifts

**Nice to have (preferred)**

1. Experience troubleshooting high-scale APIs and complex integrations across multiple systems
2. Strong grasp of advanced billing and revenue workflows such as proration, credits, refunds, dunning, and revenue recognition basics
3. Familiarity with payment gateways and payment troubleshooting (for example Stripe, Adyen, Authorize.net), including webhooks and failure analysis
4. Comfort with SQL and log analysis to trace issues end-to-end
5. Strong documentation instincts, including writing KB articles and internal troubleshooting guides

You'll tackle complex technical challenges at unprecedented scale, building world-class systems that drive efficiency and enable tax professionals to meet Amazon's unique global challenges.
  
  
This is an opportunity to make a significant impact by architecting solutions that transform tax operations for one of the world's most innovative companies. You'll work at the intersection of tax domain expertise and modern cloud technologies, creating elegant technical solutions that directly improve how Amazon's tax team operates at a global scale.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Design and implement scalable tax technology solutions using Python, generative AI, and modern development practices to solve complex tax processing challenges
  
  
Define front-end architectures and user experiences, owning specific technical components while establishing best practices for model development and solution design
  
  
Collaborate with tax professionals, Product Managers, and fellow Solutions Architects to translate customer requirements into technical specifications that engineering teams can execute
  
  
Lead end-to-end solution architecture for tax technology projects, including planning, design, implementation, testing, and continuous process improvement as part of an autonomous team
  
  
Mentor and develop other Solutions Architects by sharing technical expertise, facilitating knowledge transfer, and contributing to team growth through code reviews and technical guidance
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
Your day blends creative problem-solving with hands-on technical work. You might start by architecting a generative AI solution to streamline tax compliance workflows, then collaborate with tax professionals to refine user experience requirements. After lunch, you'll dive into Python modeling to optimize data processing pipelines, followed by a design review where you mentor junior architects on best practices. The afternoon could include troubleshooting a technical challenge with your team, contributing to solution planning, and ending with a customer workshop where you demonstrate how new capabilities will transform their tax operations.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Direct Tax Technology team sits within Amazon's Tax organization and is dedicated to supporting tax professionals in the Tax Reporting and Compliance group with innovative technology solutions and streamlined processes. Our team tackles the unique and complex challenges that come with operating at Amazon's scale, building systems that enhance processing efficiency and empower our internal customers.
  
  
We foster a culture of innovation and collaboration where technical excellence meets business impact. Our mission is to continuously evolve tax technology capabilities, ensuring our tax professionals have the tools they need to succeed. Join a team where your work directly influences how Amazon manages tax compliance and reporting, and where you'll have opportunities to explore emerging technologies like generative AI while growing your skills alongside talented engineers and architects.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

795deacf.title: Solutions Architect
795deacf.description:
At AT DAWN Technologies, we are a fast-growing technology services company building high-impact teams across Data Engineering, AI, and Backend Development. Our clients include some of the most innovative product companies in the world. We operate delivery centers in India and Vietnam, enabling rapid, high-quality execution with a product mindset.

We are seeking an experienced
**Enterprise Solution Architect**
with expertise in
**High**
**Performance Computing (HPC) and Container platforms in Linux-based environments**
to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for architecting solutions including but not limited to installation, configuration, integration and implementation of HPC technologies and enterprise-grade container orchestration platform.

We are looking for a person with very strong technical skills and a proven track record of designing and working with container platforms such as Red Hat OpenShift, SUSE Rancher, CNCF Kubernetes, HPC Schedulers such as Slurm or PBS Pro, HPC/AI Cluster management technologies such as HPCM or BCM and the ability to work in a dynamic customer-focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Candidate must have strong proficiency as a Solution Architect in at least three areas and proficiency in other areas.

* Leadership and Strategy:
* Develop HPC and container platform roadmaps and strategies for growth based on business needs.
* Engage in and enhance the complete service lifecycle—from conceptualization and design to implementation and operation.
* Identify the growth path and scalability options of a solution and include these in design activities.
* Solution Planning and Design:
* Gather requirements, assess technical feasibility, and design integrated HPC and container solutions that align with business objectives.
* Architect and optimize the technical solutions to meet the requirements of the customer.
* Identify the potential challenges and constraints that impact the solution and project plan.
* Opportunity assessment:
* Respond to the technical sections of RFIs/RFPs and Lead proof-of-concept engagements to a successful conclusion
* Utilize an effective consultative approach to advance opportunities.
* Innovation and Research:
* Stay abreast of emerging technologies, trends, and industry developments related to HPC, Kubernetes, containers, cloud computing, and Security.
* Develop best practices, Accelerators and Show & Tell for HPC and container platform solutions and integrations.
* Customer-centric mindset:
* Strong focus on understanding customer business requirements and solving complex cloud technology issues
* Be the trusted advisor, delight customers, and deliver exceptional customer experiences to drive customer success.
* Communicate complex technical concepts and findings to non-technical stakeholders
* Team Collaboration:
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including system administrators, developers, data scientist and project managers, to ensure successful project delivery.
* Understands the roles and effectively engages other teams and resources within the company
* Mentor and train new team members and lead the way in participation in tech talks, forums, innovation.

**Required Skills:**

* Knowledge and experience with Linux System Administration, package management, scheduling, boot procedures/troubleshooting, performance optimization, and networking concepts.
* In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience with HPC technologies, workload schedulers – Slurm, Altair PBS pro, and cluster managers – HPCM, Bright cluster manager.
* In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience with containerization technologies like Docker, Singularity, or Podman.
* In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience with at least two of the container orchestration technologies like CNCF Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, SUSE Rancher RKE/K3S, Canonical charmed kubernetes or Ezmeral Runtime. Good to have
* Good knowledge and hands-on experience with OpenStack cloud solutions.
* Good knowledge and hands-on experience with virtualization technologies like KVM, OpenShift virtualization
* Good knowledge and hands-on experience with at least two various Linux distributions like RHEL, SLES, Ubuntu, Debian.
* Good Knowledge of GPU technologies, NVIDIA GPU operator, NVIDIA vGPU technology
* Good knowledge of HPC networking stack (high speed networking), InfiniBand, Mellanox
* Good experience in performance optimization and health assessment of HPC components

such as operating systems, storage, servers, parallel file systems, schedulers, and container orchestration platforms.

* Must be good in any of the programming or scripting languages like python, bash
* Good understanding of DNS, TCP/IP, Routing and Load Balancing.
* Knowledge of network protocols like TCP/IP, S3, FTP, NFS, or SMB/CIFS
* Familiarity with microservices architecture, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps tools.
* Excellent problem-solving abilities, analytical thinking, and communication skills to interact with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to lead technical projects by gathering the requirements, preparing the architecture / design and executing it end to end. Must be able to bring clarity and drive complex projects involving multiple stakeholders.
* Solid business acumen and ability to converse with client on issues and challenges.
* Demonstrates a solid knowledge of the company's breadth of solutions.
* Demonstrates a high-level understanding of all related vendor product roadmaps.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a Solutions Architect, HPC and Container platform Specialist, or similar role, with expertise in designing and implementing complex solutions.
* Red Hat Certified Specialist in Containers and Kubernetes (RHCSA, RHCE), CNCF certification - CKA, CKAD, CKS is preferred.
* Typically, 6-8 years of experience in delivering complex HPC and container platform projects.

4a3771e0.title: Solution Architect, IT/ITES Vertical
4a3771e0.description:
**Description**
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
  
  
Working closely with internal teams at AWS, you’ll identify how our customers push the boundaries and how we can improve our services to obsess over our customers.
  
  
Being a thought leader who creates and presents content you’ll help all of our customers scale and grow in non-linear ways, using AWS as their building blocks.
  
  
In this role, you will push technology boundaries and help scale some of the emerging companies across various Verticals in India. You will have the opportunity to partner with customers early in their cloud journey and help them scale as well as customers further in their cloud journey where you can have visible and measurable impact in their growth ambitions.
  
  
You will test traditional thinking by pushing the boundaries for your customers and AWS to dream and deliver beyond what they think is possible.
  
  
Our customers’ needs are moving fast, so you will too. Be part of the team helping our emerging customers find innovative and transformative ways to reinvent their business!
  
  
#aws-ags-India
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Work directly with customers to accelerate their business outcomes and recommend best-practice cloud architectures in line with their long-term business needs.
* Drive technical solutions discussions with your customers, diving deep into the details to solve complex technical problems and use your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures.
* Scope and own customer engagements, with attention towards clear and well-defined objectives and success criteria.
* Work backwards from your customer's business needs to accelerate adoption of the most appropriate AWS technology
* Define and execute on the strategy by engaging highly technical teams (Solutions Architects, Technical Account Managers, AWS professional services consultants and consulting/managed services partners).
* Act as a thought leader in the wider community, playing a key role in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops.
* Share the voice of the customer to influence the roadmap of new features and services for the AWS platform. Proactively work within the organisation to influence the evolution of the platform.
* Serve as a key technical member of the Solutions Architecture team through influencing decision makers across multiple domains to ensure customer success in building applications and services on the AWS platform which align to long-term business goals.

A day in the life
  
  
Our solutions architects are experienced technologists with technical breadth and depth coupled with strong interpersonal skills. The variety of customers is huge as we work across all industries within the SMB segment, like FSI, Retail , IT& ITeS , Media and Entertainment to name a few. On a daily basis you will work alongside people who are leading the way in designing cloud bases architecture. We are the trusted advisor to our customers, so challenge our customers to think differently, learn more build elegant, transformative solutions!
  
  
As a Solutions Architect you’ll own the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS and make recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency. They work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. To do this they collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, support, product teams and the AWS partner ecosystem.
  
  
**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of cloud architecture
* 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 7+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* 7+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Experience working with end user or developer communities

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The Staff Consulting Architect will combine deep hands-on expertise in Kubernetes, virtualization, platform engineering, automation, and cloud-native technologies with strong consulting, architecture governance, and technical leadership capabilities.
  
  
The role will also be responsible for developing reference architectures, reusable delivery patterns, technical assets, and enablement programs, while mentoring Staff and Consulting Architects and raising the overall cloud-native capability of the consulting organization.
  
  
Hands-on expertise in Kubernetes, virtualization, platform engineering, CI/CD, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) is mandatory.

+ Nutanix AHV
+ VMware vSphere
+ Bare metal
+ Public cloud platforms including AWS and Azure

+ Backup and disaster recovery
+ Enterprise monitoring and logging

* Establish architecture patterns for platform standardization across multiple business units, data centers, and geographies.

* Provide technical leadership for high-value and technically complex customer engagements from Day-0 architecture through Day-2 operations.
* Lead architecture workshops, technical discovery sessions, design reviews, and transformation planning.
* Provide technical oversight for:

+ Platform deployment
+ Cluster onboarding
+ Application migration
+ Application modernization
+ Platform integration
+ Operational transformation

* Guide teams through complex implementation and troubleshooting scenarios spanning:

+ Kubernetes
+ Hypervisors
+ Networking
+ Storage
+ Security
+ Automation
+ CI/CD

* Act as the senior technical escalation point for critical architecture and delivery challenges.
* Ensure architectural decisions are translated into practical, supportable, and repeatable implementation patterns.
* Review and provide technical governance for solution designs produced by Staff and Consulting Architects.
* Automation, GitOps & Platform Engineering

* Establish standardized GitOps and CI/CD operating models using technologies such as:

+ GitHub Actions
+ GitLab CI
+ Jenkins
+ Argo CD
+ Tekton
+ Flux CD

* Design Infrastructure as Code frameworks using:

+ Terraform
+ Ansible

* Define automation patterns integrating:

+ NKP APIs
+ Kubernetes APIs
+ Nutanix APIs
+ VMware APIs
+ AWS/Azure APIs

* Drive adoption of platform engineering principles, self-service infrastructure, and developer experience (DevEx) practices.
* Establish reusable automation frameworks and reference implementations that can be adopted across customer engagements.
* Promote secure, compliant, version-controlled, and auditable platform delivery practices.
* Security, Governance, Resilience & Operations

* Establish security and governance models covering:

+ RBAC
+ Network policies
+ Pod Security Standards
+ Secrets and certificate management
+ Policy-as-Code
+ Workload isolation
+ Multi-tenancy

* Design policy and governance frameworks using OPA/Gatekeeper or equivalent technologies.
* Define enterprise approaches for:

+ Observability
+ Logging
+ Monitoring
+ Backup and recovery
+ Disaster recovery

* Lead communities of practice and technical forums to drive knowledge sharing.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking an accomplished Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) Incident to Resolve Functional Consultant for a support engagement. The ideal candidate will have over 5 years of functional experience specifically in EAM and Incident to Resolve processes within the Oracle Fusion Cloud environment. The focus will be on providing business-as-usual (BAU) support, system troubleshooting, ongoing improvements, and user enablement for the EAM suite and related modules across global operations.

**Reference**

Oracle Fusion Cloud Maintenance (Enterprise Asset Management / EAM) provides a unified, cloud-native platform to manage physical assets, maintenance operations, and lifecycle costs.

**Core Functional Capabilities of the Functional Module**

* **Asset Lifecycle & Master Data Management:**

+ Manages enterprise-owned and customer-owned assets with a 360-degree view of asset hierarchies (parent-child relationships), parts lists, warranties, and meter readings.
+ Supports bulk cloud imports, manual entry, and asset routing for grouped maintenance.

* **Work Management & Execution:**

+ Handles reactive, preventive, and condition-based maintenance strategies.
+ Uses guided work definitions, standard operations, and dispatch capabilities for technicians on mobile/ruggedized devices.
+ Manages work orders, labor tracking, material issues, and direct procurement integration.

* **Preventive, Predictive, & Prescriptive Maintenance:**

+ Schedules maintenance via calendar patterns, meters, or IoT-driven condition monitoring.
+ Leverages AI-driven analytics and forecasting to predict asset failures and analyze root causes.

* **Native Enterprise Integration:**

+ Shares a common data model with Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM, ERP Financials, Inventory, Procurement, and HCM without requiring custom integration middleware.
+ Connects maintenance spending directly to financial ledgers, assisting with repair-versus-replace decisions and asset capitalization

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Application Support & Troubleshooting:**

+ Provide comprehensive functional support for Oracle Fusion Cloud EAM, focusing on Incident to Resolve processes, including maintenance requests, work order management, asset tracking, preventive maintenance, and failure analysis.
+ Analyze and resolve user-raised incidents, system issues, and service requests in line with agreed SLAs.
+ Conduct root cause analysis for recurring issues and work with technical teams and Oracle Support for complex/systemic challenges.
+ Support asset lifecycle management, from incident creation and assessment through resolution and closure.

* **System Enhancements & Change Management:**

+ Assess and implement minor enhancements and configuration updates in line with evolving business requirements.
+ Participate in testing activities (unit, integration, regression, UAT) for Oracle quarterly releases, upgrades, and new feature roll-outs.
+ Support interfaces/integrations with related modules, such as Inventory, Procurement, Projects, and Supply Chain applications.

* **Documentation & User Training:**

+ Create and maintain user manuals, functional specifications, process documentation, and quick reference guides for Incident to Resolve processes.
+ Lead training sessions and knowledge transfer workshops for business users and support staff.

* **Stakeholder Engagement & Communication:**

+ Act as the primary contact for business users seeking EAM functional support, ensuring effective communication and follow-up for incident resolution, enhancements, and process queries.
+ Collaborate closely with business process owners, IT, operations, and vendor/partner teams to address issues and ensure end-to-end process efficiency.

* **Continuous Improvement & Best Practices:**

+ Proactively identify process gaps and system improvement opportunities, leveraging best practices and the latest Oracle Cloud EAM enhancements.
+ Recommend process optimizations for asset reliability, maintenance scheduling, and data quality within the EAM suite.
+ Stay current on Oracle Fusion Cloud updates and their impact on EAM and cross-functional processes.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Information Technology, or related field.
* Minimum of 5 years’ hands-on functional experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud EAM, including direct exposure to Incident to Resolve processes.
* Comprehensive understanding of asset management, maintenance planning & execution, incident management, preventive maintenance, and work order processes.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and documentation skills.
* Experience working in support engagements or managed services, including incident, problem, and change management.
* Excellent communication skills for user support, stakeholder management, and cross-team collaboration.
* Oracle Cloud EAM certification (preferred, not mandatory).

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with related Oracle Fusion Cloud modules (Inventory, Procurement, Projects, Supply Chain).
* Familiarity with enterprise support tools (ServiceNow, JIRA, Remedy, etc.) and ITIL best practices.
* Exposure to process reengineering, integration points, and reporting/dashboard solutions.
* Managed services or Application Maintenance & Support (AMS) background.

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. **Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

We help some of the world’s biggest biopharmaceutical companies answer questions no one else can. We support our clients through their entire business lifecycle; providing market intelligence that helps them launch new therapies, optimize promotional efforts, defend against competitive pressure, shape marketing strategies, and much more.

**Job Description:**

* Oversee end-to-end service delivery for clients, ensuring all accounting and reporting outputs are accurate, timely, and meet client expectations with minimal rework

* Excellent communication, organization, and time management skills with high attention to detail and ability to adapt and apply learnings effectively. Demonstrated ability to operate independently, manage relationships across international teams, and make informed decisions in a fast-paced, multi-client environment.

* Lead solution workshops, MVD/CAS sessions, due diligence and pursuit-related workshops, interfacing with clients and third-party advisors (TPAs).
* Develop winning themes, SWOT and competitor analysis, and build re-usable bid components, templates and frameworks for strategic pursuit management.
* Manage and mentor a team of junior and mid-level solution managers.

**Work model**
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Chennai or Bangalore. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
**What You Must Have To Be Considered**

* Strong techno-commercial capability with proven customer interaction and solution presentation skills.
* Solid IT infrastructure technical understanding across Compute (on-prem and cloud), Network, Security, End User and Service Management, including Managed Services and Digital Transformation.
* Knowledge of service assurance and automation tools and ITIL/ITSM processes.
* Knowledge of pricing models, IT spend analysis, business case development, and TCO and ROI analysis.
* A proven track record in fast-paced environments with strong, complex problem-solving skills and the ability to see problems through to resolution.

**These will help you succeed**

* Awareness of industry IT trends and analyst/TPA reports such as Gartner, Everest, Forrester, ISG, BCG, HfS and IDC.
* Experience in cross-cultural settings and with top-tier outsourcing organizations.
* Excellent communication, presentation and analytical skills with a proactive, can-do attitude.
* Ability to shape creative, innovative solutions deliverable at acceptable business profit levels, with effective project and time management.
* Flexibility and mobility to accommodate short domestic and international business travel (up to 2 months).

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

4696c400.title: Solutions Engineer
4696c400.description:
**Meet the Team**
Join our dynamic Solutions Engineer team at Cisco, where you’ll collaborate with experienced professionals passionate about driving technical sales excellence and enhancing customer engagement. Together, we innovate and deliver cutting-edge solutions that empower our customers and partners to achieve their business goals. Be part of a supportive environment that fosters growth, teamwork, and meaningful contributions to Cisco’s success.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Technical Sales Professional, you will own the Cisco brand with customers and partners by delivering technical solutions that address their business needs. You will collaborate closely with the account team and connected sales teams to ensure customer success, serving as a trusted technical advisor.
  
  

* Leverage deep knowledge of Cisco’s portfolio, including specialized and architectural perspectives. Drive penetration through cross-selling and up-selling while displacing competition. Be responsible for the technical relationship with customers and partners.
* Lead engagements with IT and business decision-makers, understand customer environments and market dynamics, and translate business needs into technical requirements.
* Focus on landing opportunities and expanding within accounts. Participate actively in customer strategic planning.
* Provide valuable feedback to Business Executives and sales teams on strategic customer needs, market opportunities, and competitive tactics.
* Lead deals through the technical sales process, design and present solutions based on customer requirements, manage virtual sales support teams, and leverage tools to support deals.
* Increase revenue by converting opportunities to closed deals, displace competitors to grow market share, and expand the customer base quarterly.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop multi-year strategic plans integrating Cisco’s portfolio for customers.
* Deepen expertise by combining domain knowledge with cross-architectural solutions.
* Shape technical strategies for senior executives.
* Align customer business objectives with industry knowledge to create comprehensive solutions.
* Lead demand generation and enablement initiatives.
* Identify latent customer needs and showcase cross-architecture solutions.
* Lead impactful demonstrations emphasizing business outcomes driven by Cisco solutions.
* Use competitive intelligence to differentiate Cisco offerings.
* Mobilize broad stakeholder networks to drive transformative synergies and optimize relationships.
* Direct virtual and extended sales teams toward continuous improvement and oversee educational programs.
* Demonstrate agility by adapting strategies in response to market disruptions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with 8+ years of related experience, or an advanced degree (Master's or PhD) with related experience.
* Proficiency in Cisco networking technologies and solutions, including SD-WAN, MPLS, LAN, Cloud, Unified Communications (UC), and Security.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong understanding of cloud computing platforms and services.
* Expertise in Cisco’s cloud portfolio to design scalable, secure, and cost-effective architectures.
* Hands-on experience with network automation tools to streamline deployment, management, and operational efficiency of network and collaboration solutions.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

f377589c.title: Presales Consultant
f377589c.description:
MTX Group Inc. (MTX) is currently hiring for the position of
**Pre-Sales Consultant**
with strong multi-cloud expertise and hands-on Salesforce knowledge. The ideal candidate will design and propose scalable, secure, and cost-efficient technical solutions across diverse technology ecosystems—including Salesforce, AWS, Azure, and integration/middleware platforms—without vendor bias.

This role bridges sales, delivery, and engineering, bringing deep technical insight, excellent communication skills, and strong solution-design capabilities to the RFx process.

**Key Responsibilities:**

The Senior Pre-Sales Consultant is expected to lead large-scale/complex project(s), executing the following responsibilities:

* Client, Sales & RFx Engagement:
* Lead the analysis of RFI/RFP/Tender documents to understand customer pain points, objectives, technical landscape, and constraints.
* Summarize bid details: agency background, contract duration, contract value, scope of work, user journeys, and design-critical considerations.
* Participate in internal stakeholder/client meetings, discovery/business domain understanding workshops, requirement-gathering sessions and existing client portal research..
* Collaborate with internal sales (including Salesforce PSS) and delivery teams to align solution direction and ensure feasibility.
* Support creation of Functional & Technical Requirement Traceability Matrices.

* Solution Design & Architecture (Platform-Agnostic):
* Architect multi-cloud, hybrid, and on-premise solutions that meet functional, technical, security, and compliance requirements.
* Recommend best-fit technology stacks—Salesforce or otherwise—based purely on customer needs and evaluation criteria.
* Create high-level and detailed technical architecture diagrams, data flow models, and integration patterns.
* Translate requirements into epics, modules, feature lists, and high-level solution blueprints.
* Apply modern architectural principles: microservices, API-led integration, event-driven frameworks, serverless, containerization, and cloud-native patterns.

* Technical Expertise & Ecosystem Knowledge:

The ideal candidate brings broad technical versatility, including:

Salesforce Ecosystem:

* Core technologies: Apex, Visualforce, Lightning (Aura/LWC), SOQL/SOSL, Salesforce APIs.
* Clouds: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, CPQ, Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, Einstein.
* Integration: MuleSoft (API-led connectivity), Dell Boomi, Informatica, Jitterbit, and other middleware platforms.
* DevOps & CI/CD: Copado, Gearset, Bitbucket/Jenkins/GitHub Actions.
* Security & governance: OAuth, SSO, profiles/permissions, event monitoring.
* Salesforce PSS engagement for deep technical validation & alignment with product roadmap.

Third Party Integrations:

* Document generation: Conga, DocuSign Gen, Nintex.
* E-signature: DocuSign, Adobe Sign, Zoho Sign.
* Storage/Content: SharePoint, Google Drive, AWS S3, OneDrive, Box.
* SMS/Communication: Twilio, Sinch, Whatsapp APIs, Netcore.
* Monitoring/Logging: Splunk, Datadog, ELK.
* Analytics/BI: Tableau, Power BI, CRM Analytics.

Cloud & Application Stack:

* AWS, Azure, GCP (optional) cloud services.
* Databases: SQL, NoSQL.
* Programming: Java, Python, Node.js (advantage).
* Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes.
* AI/ML model usage & LLM-based solutioning.

* Estimation, Planning & Financial Modelling
* Prepare accurate estimates for functional work, integrations, data migration, and system complexity.
* Develop implementation timelines, resource/staffing plans, and project roadmaps.
* Create margin analysis, cost breakdowns, and pricing models.
* Collaborate with sales and delivery leadership for approvals and validation.

* Technical Proposal & Documentation
* Draft and refine technical sections for RFIs, RFPs, proposals, and solution decks.
* Convert customer requirements into compelling technical narratives and business value propositions.
* Document design assumptions, architectural decisions, and solution trade-offs.
* Ensure solutions meet scalability, security, compliance, and performance standards.

**What you will bring:**

* 6-12 years of experience in Pre-Sales, Solution Design, or Architecture roles.
* Strong multi-cloud and Salesforce experience, including deep hands-on understanding of integrations and ecosystem tools.
* Ability to convert requirements into modular solution components and architectural blueprints.
* Excellent communication skills to simplify complex concepts for business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with technical writing, prompt engineering, and AI-assisted solutioning.
* Proven experience participating in large-scale RFx processes and cross-functional collaboration.

**What we offer:**

Group Medical Insurance (Family Floater Plan - Self + Spouse + 4 Dependent Children)

* Sum Insured: INR 5,00,000/-
* Maternity cover upto two children
* Cashless & Reimbursement facility
* Access to free online doctor consultation

* Accidental Death and Permanent Total Disability is covered up to 100% of Sum Insured
* Permanent Partial Disability is covered as per the scale of benefits decided by the Insurer
* Temporary Total Disability is covered

This includes providing guidance, support, and advice in the proposal, implementation, and deployment of any new or existing product developments as part of a customer solution.

**What You'll Do**

These solutions may involve multiple parties, both internally and externally, including the selection of 3rd party vendors to meet customer requirements for network connectivity, wireless technologies, and security.

4d70e452.title: Technical Solutions Consultant
4d70e452.description:
**About the role**

We're hiring a Technical Solutions Consultant to sit with our customers, find where their work is slow, manual or broken, AND fix it. You'll diagnose the problem, design the fix, AND build it yourself. The solutions are ordinary software (internal tools, automations, dashboards, simple apps); AI is how you build them, using AI coding assistants ("vibe coding") and no-code tools.

This is a business role first. Spotting a costly problem and framing the right fix comes first, but you also need enough coding knowledge to build, debug and maintain what you ship. Engineers are on hand when a build outgrows your tools.

**What you'll do:**

**Discovery:**
Run conversations with founders, ops leads and front-line teams to understand how their business actually runs, not just how they say it runs.

**Process diagnosis:**
Map current workflows, find bottlenecks, handoffs, duplicate data entry and spreadsheet sprawl, and quantify the cost in hours, errors or lost revenue.

**Solution design:**
Propose fixes ranked by impact and effort. Know when the answer is a better process, an off-the-shelf tool, or something custom.

**Build:**
Ship working prototypes and internal tools using AI coding assistants (Claude, Cursor, Lovable, Replit and similar) and automation platforms (n8n, Zapier, Make, Airtable).

**Rollout:**
Get the people who use it to adopt it. Train them, collect feedback, iterate.

**Measure:**
Track whether the fix saved the time or money you promised, and report it back plainly.

**Feed the business:**
Spot repeatable problems across customers and bring them back as product or service opportunities.

**What we're looking for:**

- 2+ years in a business-facing role: business development, consulting, operations, sales engineering, or running a small business.

- Strong business acumen. You can read a P&L-level problem, ask why until you hit the root cause, and tell a real pain from a nice-to-have.

- Clear communicator with non-technical people. You can explain a solution to a shop owner and to a CFO.

- Systems thinking. You naturally draw a process as boxes and arrows and see where it breaks.

- Working coding knowledge. You can read and change code in at least one language (Python or JavaScript preferred), work with APIs, JSON and basic SQL, and debug what an AI assistant writes rather than just pasting it.

- Hands-on with AI coding tools. You have built and shipped at least one working tool, automation or app yourself.

- Comfortable with ambiguity, owning outcomes end to end, and working directly with customers.

- You don't need to be a full software engineer. You do need to understand what the code is doing.

**Nice to have**

- Experience with a web framework, databases, or deploying apps (Vercel, Supabase, AWS).

- Experience with CRMs and ops tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Notion, Airtable).

- A portfolio of things you've built: automations, internal tools, small apps.

- Domain depth in an industry we serve.

- Experience pricing or scoping projects for clients.

**Hiring process**

1.
**Intro call (30 min):**
Your background and one business problem you've solved.

2.
**Discovery role-play (45 min):**
We play a business owner with a messy operation. You ask questions, find the real problem, and propose a fix.

3.
**Build exercise (take-home, \~4 hours):**
Turn your proposal into a working prototype using any AI or no-code tools you like.

4.
**Walkthrough (60 min):**
Demo it to us as if we were the customer, including trade-offs and what you'd do next.

5. Founder conversation.

7a79d28a.title: Senior Digital Solutions Consultant (IROC Consultant)
7a79d28a.description:
**About Us**
Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
  
  
**Purpose**
As a Senior Digital Solutions Consultant (IROC Consultant) , you will serve as the strategic and technical spearhead for our clients' digital and operational transformation journeys. You will bridge the gap between heavy industrial operations and cutting-edge technology, leading high-value studies and executing successful IROC implementations.
  
  
This role requires a unique blend of "boots-on-the-ground" operational understanding, deep Information Technology/Operational Technology (IT/OT) architecture expertise, and top-tier management consulting acumen. You will work directly with client leadership teams and home office engineering teams to design, build, and deploy integrated operating models that optimize safety, production, and asset capability.
  
  
**The Role**
***As a Senior Digital Solutions Consultant (IROC Consultant) with Worley,***
you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
  
  

* Partner with client executives and site teams to define, capture, and map business and technical requirements for modern Integrated Real-Time Operations Centers.
* Design and implement integrated operating models that seamlessly connect product quality, production, and maintenance functions.
* Work with the client team to establish frameworks for Integrated Planning and Short Interval Control (SIC) to optimize daily production, manage schedule execution, and handle real-time deviation control effectively.
* Lead complex, multi-disciplinary engineering studies (Concept, PFS, DFS) and spearhead the physical and digital implementation of IROC facilities and systems.
* Leverage a strong understanding of capital and operational cost estimation to build robust business cases, project budgets, and resource models for IROC deployments.
* Act as a trusted advisor, guiding client teams through the cultural and process shifts required to transition to an integrated, data-driven operating model.
* Collaborate with engineering and delivery teams to ensure production systems, safety technology, and remote operations infrastructure are seamlessly integrated and resilient.
* Design and deploy strategies for workforce mobility, ensuring field operators and remote teams are equipped with seamless mobile worker tools. Architect these solutions to actively support generational change, making the technology intuitive and adoption-friendly across all demographics.
* Support the application of Artificial Intelligence, agents, and Machine Learning capabilities into the IROC ecosystem enhancing workflow and analysis. Utilize these technologies to improve data-driven decision-making, optimize integrated planning, and deliver superior outcomes in real-time execution and deviation control.

**Other Attributes**

* Ability to see the big picture and understand risk and how changes in one part of the value chain (e.g., maintenance) impact others (e.g., production and product quality).
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence everyone from frontline operators to C-suite executives.
* A structured, analytical approach to solving complex operational bottlenecks using technology and process redesign.

**About You**
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
  
  

* Total experience of 10 to 15 years with up to 5 years of direct, site-based operational experience within the Mining and/or Oil & Gas sectors.
* 5+ years of experience working in multi-disciplinary engineering delivery, specifically focusing on IT/OT, production technology, and safety technology design and deployment.
* 5+ years of proven experience in national and international consulting, demonstrating the ability to manage complex stakeholder environments across different geographies.
* Practical, hands-on experience of minimum of 1 successful full-cycle IROC implementation.
* Demonstrated experience leading at least 3 distinct IROC or digital transformation studies (e.g., Scoping, Pre-Feasibility, or Feasibility).
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mining, Process, or Automation and Autonomy Control Systems), Information Technology, or a related technical discipline. Master’s degree or MBA is well regarded.
* Candidates with outstanding and extensive industry experience may also be considered.
* Solid knowledge of project estimating methodologies, cost-benefit analysis, and CAPEX/OPEX modelling for technology infrastructure.
* Lead the human-centric, cultural side of digital transformation and IROC by designing frameworks that address operational readiness, role clarity, and cultural shifts.

**Moving forward together**
We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
  
  
And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
  
  
And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

Job Description:  
  
Mission  
The Messaging Architect is a member of the Global Collaboration Services and UX Governance team. This role acts as an Architect, technical and strategic reference for enterprise messaging and communication platforms, ensuring consistency, security, scalability, and alignment with business objectives across a global organization. The primary mission of the Messaging Architect is to design, architect, deploy, govern, manage and optimize enterprise messaging and communication platforms, covering:  

* Enterprise Email & Messaging (Postfix, Exchange Online, Hybrid Exchange)
* Email Security & Hygiene (Proofpoint)
* Microsoft 365 & Identity integrations
* Unified Communication integrations including CPaaS
* Automation, API integration, and governance
* MS Places

The role ensures high availability, security, compliance, and innovation across global messaging services while acting as Level 4 technical authority.  
Key Responsibilities  

* Postfix & SMTP / Email Relay Architecture

o Architect, deploy, migrate, upgrade, and maintain Postfix-based SMTP relay platforms on Red Hat Linux.  
o Extensive hands-on expertise in:  
 Postfix internals, mail flow, queues, transports, and policies  
 SMTP authentication (AD-based and local authentication)  
 TLS, certificates, and secure relay configurations  
 High availability, performance tuning, and scaling Postfix environments  
o Experience with other Linux-based email components/MTAs.  
o Design end-to-end mail relay architecture, including:  
 Active Directory integration  
 Whitelist IP address to source email address matching  
 Network flows, firewall rules, and routing  
 Secure relay patterns for SaaS, on-prem, and third-party systems  
o Strong automation and scripting skills for Linux email platforms.  
o Reporting experience exporting smart reports segregating source applications based on private/public Ips.  
  
  
  

* Microsoft Exchange & Microsoft 365
* Architect and manage Exchange Online for large enterprise environments.
* Strong experience with:

o Exchange Online / Exchange Online Protection (EOP)  
o Hybrid Exchange (Exchange 2019)  
o Decommissioning/Re-architect post migration  
o Public/private Certificate renewal/management  

* Design and govern:

o Mail flow, connectors, transport rules  
o Security, compliance, and governance controls  
o Archive and Backup Strategies for Mail  

* Deep knowledge of:

o Purview (DLP, retention policies, sensitivity labels, eDiscovery)  
o Microsoft 365 tenant management  
o Clients: Outlook (Windows/Mac), IMAP, POP3, mobile devices, Active Sync, Intune over Modern Authentication protocol.  

* Knowledge on Entra ID Connect, Entra AD RMS, and identity-driven mail authentication.
* Troubleshoot mail related issues.
* Keep a tab Microsoft 365 notification and be pro-active on communicating, planning and executing.
* Onboarding and offboarding automation of joiners/leavers integrating with 3rd party tools like Jarvis/One Identity.

  

* Proofpoint – Email, Network, DNS Security & Hygiene
* Strong hands-on experience with Proofpoint email security platforms.
* Architect and manage end-to-end Proofpoint + Exchange Online integrations.
* Deploy and manage Proofpoint appliances for secure email relay.
* Design and implement:

o Email hygiene policies  
o Firewall policies, Domain integration, Whitelist/Blacklist  
o Message header based rules  
o Anti-phishing, anti-spam, and threat protection rules  
o Governance and compliance use cases  

* Act as the security reference for messaging solutions in collaboration with the Security team.
* Troubleshooting mail flow related issues
* Strong understanding of:

o SMTP protocol and mail routing  
o Public mail domain management  
o DNS records: MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, TXT  
o SMTP alias hosting and domain integration  

* Ability to collaborate closely with network, server, and security architects.

  

* Migration & Transformation
* Extensive experience in large-scale migrations, including:

o Tenant-to-tenant (M&A, divestments)  
o On-premise to cloud migrations  
o Mail domain migration and coexistence  

* Perform discovery, scoping, and estimation (LOE), wave wise data migrations for messaging transformation projects.
* Provide in-person and remote support during migration and cutover and Hyper-Care phases.
* Experience working with 3rd party tools like Quest On Demand, Sharegate, Avepoint etc.
* Experience working on MS places and onboarding new offices, integration, building, desks, pools etc.

  

* Automation, APIs & Integration
* Strong PowerShell scripting capabilities for Exchange, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 with Entra ID SPN/app-based unattended approach.
* Experience with Microsoft Graph / REST APIs for automation and integration.
* Entra ID integration, Service Principals, managed identity knowledge.
* Power Platform based automation (power-Apps, Power Automate, Power BI) is a strong advantage.
* Good-to-have experience integrating messaging platforms with CPaaS solutions.
* Reporting to showcase different messaging KPIs, Metrics through automated Dashboard is an added advantage.

  

* Documentation & Support
* Ensure technical architecture documents (TAD), KBs, and operational guides are created, maintained, and up to date.
* Define and enforce messaging governance standards.
* Provide Level 3 support for complex mail and messaging incidents.
* Educate and upskill Level 1 and Level 2 support teams.
* Communicate and educate both technical and business stakeholders on:

o Current architectures  
o Industry trends  
o Microsoft roadmap and enterprise impact  
  
Required Profile  

* Core Technical Skills

o Postfix (Red Hat Linux) –proven Expertise  
o Exchange Online / Hybrid Exchange  
o Exchange On premise 2019  
o Microsoft 365 & Entra ID  
o PowerShell scripting & automation  
o SMTP, DNS, Mail Security standards  
o Microsoft Graph / REST APIs  
o Proofpoint Email Security  
o MS places  

* Additional Competencies

o Strong troubleshooting skills with ability to identify and resolve performance, stability, and availability issues.  
o Experience working in large, global enterprise environments.  
o Strong understanding of digital security principles.  
o Ability to work collaboratively with international teams.  
o Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.  
o Ability to communicate complex technical topics to non-technical audiences.  
o Experience with integrated Cloud SaaS and IaaS solutions.

* Nice to Have

Job Description:  
Key Responsibilities  
Job Description: Azure Data Cloud Architect  
Position Overview  
We are seeking an experienced and visionary Azure Data Cloud Architect to lead the strategy, design, and modernization of cutting-edge, enterprise-scale data solutions on Microsoft Azure. In this role, you will serve as a strategic technical leader bridging business strategy and technology execution. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders—including the Data Hub, Digital & AI teams, and DevOps—to translate complex business requirements into high-performing, resilient, secure, and cost-effective cloud data architectures.  
Your deep expertise in Azure cloud data services, advanced data modeling, modern ETL/ELT pipelines, cloud governance, and enterprise digital transformation will drive continuous innovation, scalability, and efficiency across our global data ecosystem.  
  
Key Strategic Focus Areas  

* Solution Architecting: Designing robust, multi-region end-to-end architectures that leverage the full power of Azure native data and analytics services.
* Modernization & Cloud Migration: Leading the evolution from legacy data warehouses, databases, and on-premises infrastructure to cloud-native Azure data solutions.
* Digital & AI Transformation: Enabling advanced analytics, machine learning, and business intelligence capabilities that empower data-driven decision-making across the enterprise.

  
Detailed Roles, Responsibilities & Key Activities  
1. Strategic Solution Architecting  

* End-to-End Architectural Leadership: Design, architect, and deliver scalable, resilient, and secure data platform architectures utilizing the complete Azure data ecosystem (e.g., Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure SQL Database, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and Azure Data Lake Storage).
* Business & Technical Alignment: Partner closely with business stakeholders, product managers, and leadership in Digital & AI to evaluate business needs and translate them into high-level architectures (HLD) and technical architecture documents (TAD).
* Target State Architecture: Define future-state data architecture roadmaps, network flow matrices, environment topologies, secret inventories, and enterprise data models (star/snowflake schemas, Data Vault, or relational models).

2. Modernization & Enterprise Data Transformation  

* Legacy System Cloud Migration: Architect and execute cloud migration strategies to transition legacy on-premises databases, data warehouses, and ETL jobs into modernized Azure cloud-native equivalents with minimal operational disruption.
* Modern Data Integration (ETL/ELT): Oversee and optimize real-time, micro-batch, and batch data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and Event Driven architectures to accelerate time-to-insight.
* Innovation & Emerging Technologies: Continuously evaluate emerging cloud, AI/ML, and IoT technology capabilities (e.g., Azure ML, Logic Apps, Service Bus) to solve complex data challenges and expand automated operational workflows.

3. Implementation, Governance, Security & Operations  

* Data Security & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure full compliance with global and enterprise data privacy and security standards (including GDPR, HIPAA, UK data residency regulations, and client-specific security standards such as Sodexo policies).
* Automated Governance & Lineage: Establish comprehensive data governance frameworks encompassing metadata management, enterprise data cataloging, lineage tracking, data quality monitoring, and role-based access control (RBAC).
* DevOps, IaC & Automation: Work with DevOps teams to drive automated infrastructure provisioning and continuous delivery using Infrastructure as Code (IaC with Azure Bicep/ARM templates/Terraform) and Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines.
* Security & Vulnerability Remediation: Regularly review security compliance reports (e.g., Sodexo's CACTUS tool, Azure Security Center) and leverage Azure Key Vault, Private Endpoints, and Managed Identities to remediate security risks.
* Performance Tuning & Cost Optimization: Monitor, audit, and tune data pipelines, query performance, and storage tiers for maximum speed, enterprise resilience, and cloud cost efficiency (FinOps).

4. Technical Leadership, Mentorship & Stakeholder Collaboration  

* Team Mentorship & Guidance: Act as a hands-on technical mentor to data engineers, data analysts, and data scientists, instilling cloud design patterns and architecture best practices.
* Cross-Functional Synergy: Foster seamless collaboration between data engineering, infrastructure, security, DevOps, and business analytics teams.
* Operational Guidelines & Standards: Author standard operating procedures, architectural guidelines, reference architectures, and deployment documentation.

  
Required Qualifications & Experience  
Education  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field (Master’s Degree preferred).

Experience  

* Overall Experience: Minimum 5+ years of progressive experience in data engineering and solution architecture.
* Azure Cloud Focus: Minimum 3+ years of dedicated experience architecting, building, and deploying enterprise-scale cloud data solutions specifically on Microsoft Azure.
* Migration Experience: Demonstrated track record of leading complex data warehouse and pipeline migrations from legacy platforms to Azure.

Preferred Certifications  

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

  
Technical & Professional Skills  
Primary Azure Services & Data Architecture  

* Core Data Services: Expert-level knowledge of Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Databricks, Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2), Blob Storage.
* Integration & Security: Azure Key Vault, Azure Private Link / Private Endpoints, Azure Data Gateway, Azure Relay, RBAC.
* Supporting Cloud Infrastructure: Azure IaaS/PaaS, Application Gateway, Azure Load Balancer, Web Apps, Function Apps, Logic Apps, Azure Service Bus, Azure Machine Learning.

Engineering, DevOps & Methodologies  

* Data Engineering & Query Languages: Advanced proficiency in SQL, T-SQL, Python/PySpark, PowerShell, and database design.
* DevOps & IaC: Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps (pipelines, repos), Infrastructure as Code (Azure Bicep, ARM, or Terraform), and continuous deployment practices.
* Monitoring & Analytics: Familiarity with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and business intelligence suites (Power BI).

Soft Skills & Leadership Capabilities  

* Communication: Exceptional communication and storytelling skills with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical executive stakeholders.
* Strategic Problem Solving: Highly analytical mindset with strong organizational, risk management, and decision-making skills.
* Collaboration: Natural collaborator who thrives in global, matrixed enterprise environments.

Clear and fluent English (both verbal and written)  
Ability to build and maintain efficient working relationships with remote teams  
Demonstrate ability to take ownership of and accountability for relevant products and services  
Ability to plan, prioritize and complete your own work, whilst remaining a team player
