ca01e6ba.title: AI Solution and Platforms Junior Architect/Engineer
ca01e6ba.description:
Overview

The Junior AI Observability Architect is an execution-focused engineer who designs, builds, and operates observability capabilities within a defined domain of the enterprise AI observability platform. Working under the strategic direction of the Senior AI Observability Architect, this role translates architecture blueprints into production-grade instrumentation, telemetry pipelines, dashboards, quality gates, and safety signals across agentic AI systems.

The junior architect is a hands-on engineer who codes, integrates, tests, and iterates owning feature-level delivery within one or more specialization tracks while developing a growing understanding of the full observability platform. They are a technical practitioner first, with an emerging architect mindset.

Responsibilities

1. Observability Platform Engineering OTEL Integration (25%)

* Implement OpenTelemetry (OTEL) instrumentation within assigned agent frameworks or platforms including custom exporters, span enrichers, semantic conventions, and context propagation hooks.
* Build and maintain telemetry pipeline components (collectors, processors, exporters) that route metrics, logs, traces, and semantic signals to central observability backends.
* Integrate OTEL with enterprise agentic platforms as assigned which may include Salesforce AgentForce, ServiceNow, Microsoft Agent 365, or internal frameworks following architecture blueprints set by the L11.
* Develop and maintain observability dashboards, alerting rules, and SLO/SLA definitions for the assigned sub-domain, ensuring signal quality and low false-positive rates.
* Participate in on-call rotations and incident response for the observability platform contributing to RCA documentation and runbook improvement.
* Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for all telemetry components; maintain >80% test coverage across owned services.

2. Safety, Security Red Teaming Support (15%)

* Instrument safety-critical signal capture within assigned pipelines including guardrail trigger rates, policy violation events, prompt injection detections, and hallucination flags.
* Support red team exercises by building observability hooks that capture adversarial test results, attack surface telemetry, and behavioral deviation signals in real time.
* Implement secure trace handling for sensitive AI decision events applying data masking, PII redaction, and audit-log retention policies as defined by the security architecture.
* Assist in maintaining the Security Observability Playbook documenting findings, updating escalation paths, and contributing to incident classification procedures.
* Monitor agent-to-agent protocol traffic (A2A, UCP, AP2) for anomalous communication patterns and flag deviations for review by the L11 architect and security team.

3. Responsible AI (RAI) Governance Signal Instrumentation (10%)

* Implement RAI signal collectors within assigned agent workflows capturing fairness indicators, bias detection outputs, explainability scores, and content safety classifications.
* Maintain RAI telemetry pipelines and ensure data quality, completeness, and timeliness of governance signals feeding into compliance dashboards.
* Contribute to audit-readiness work by ensuring all AI decision traces within the assigned domain include required governance metadata and are retained per policy.
* Support gap analyses by comparing current RAI signal coverage against governance framework requirements and flagging coverage gaps to the L11.

4. Quality Engineering for Agentic Solutions Post Go-Live Continuous QE (15%)

* Build and maintain quality gate components within CI/CD pipelines using observability data to detect performance regressions, behavioral drift, and SLA breaches before they reach production.
* Instrument and monitor Skill Evaluations (evals) across the Memory, Skills, and MCP harness stack collecting eval results, tracking pass/fail trends, and alerting on regression thresholds.
* Implement continuous quality monitoring for post-go-live agentic solutions tracking agent success rate, tool-call fidelity, latency distributions, and user outcome proxies.
* Conduct structured testing of new agent capabilities using standardized eval harnesses documenting results and feeding findings into quality improvement cycles.
* Develop automated quality reports and quality metric dashboards for stakeholder review, surfacing trends and anomalies in agent behavior over time.

5. Memory, Skills, MCP Harness Engineering Observability (10%)

* Instrument agent memory operations (read/write latency, cache hit rates, memory drift) across episodic, semantic, and working memory backends within the assigned scope.
* Add trace instrumentation to MCP server interactions tagging tool registrations, skill invocations, context injections, and result returns with semantic OTEL attributes.
* Capture harness execution telemetry for self-evolving and RL systems logging reward signals, policy update events, environment transitions, and convergence indicators.
* Monitor skill eval harness execution pipelines detecting flaky evals, environment setup failures, and result inconsistencies that could mask real capability regressions.

6. Data Science Python Engineering (10%)

* Write production-grade Python for observability tooling custom OTEL exporters, signal aggregators, anomaly detectors, and data transformation pipelines adhering to team engineering standards.
* Apply basic statistical and data science methods to telemetry data time-series analysis, threshold tuning, distribution characterization to improve signal quality and alerting precision.
* Contribute to Python SDK and library development that simplifies OTEL onboarding for agent developers across the organization.
* Participate in code reviews, apply test-driven development practices, and continuously improve the quality and maintainability of the observability codebase.

7. Agent Fleet, Physical AI Multi-Modal Observability (5%)

* Implement telemetry for agent fleet coordination capturing spawn/termination events, inter-agent communication traces, load distribution metrics, and fleet health indicators.
* Contribute to observability instrumentation for physical AI pipelines (edge inference, sensor fusion, robotics control loops) as directed focusing on latency, reliability, and data quality signals.
* Add OTEL instrumentation to multi-modal model pipelines tracing vision, audio, and text input processing stages and capturing cross-modal alignment quality signals.

8. Agentic Marketplace, Registry A2A / UCP / AP2 Observability (5%)

* Instrument the Agentic Marketplace and Agent Registry with usage telemetry tracking agent invocations, capability health scores, adoption trends, and dependency relationships.
* Implement protocol-level observability for A2A (Agent-to-Agent), UCP, and AP2 communication flows capturing message latency, error rates, retry patterns, and trust boundary crossings.
* Contribute to Marketplace Observability Dashboard

we are looking for AI Architect for Bangalore, Pune & Mumbai locations.

pls find the below JD and share your updated profile.

* Ability to produce architecture decision records, target architecture views, integration diagrams, NFR documentation, delivery roadmaps and implementation options.

* Strong understanding of banking products such as deposits, accounts, cards, lending, mortgages, wealth lending or investments, with specific experience in pricing, fees, interest rates, concessions or product configuration preferred.
* Understanding of governance, auditability, segregation of duties, regulatory traceability, data privacy, IAM and security requirements in financial services.
* **Problem-Solving and Analytical Skills:**
* Exceptional analytical and strategic problem-solving abilities, with the ability to structure complex pricing, architecture and delivery challenges into clear solution options.
* Ability to make informed trade-off decisions across functional fit, architecture fit, cost, delivery risk, compliance and long-term maintainability.
* **Core Competencies:**
* Excellent leadership, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence business, technology, architecture and vendor stakeholders at all levels.
* Strong presentation and documentation skills for creating architecture packs, RFP inputs, decision papers, solution options and executive-ready summaries.
* Structured delivery mindset with the ability to manage multiple workstreams across requirements, architecture, vendor assessment and implementation planning.
* Commercial awareness and ability to assess solution options through the lenses of time-to-value, total cost of ownership, implementation complexity and operational sustainability.
* **Team Leadership and Mentorship:**
* **Technical Guidance:**
  Lead and mentor engineers and architects, providing guidance on architecture decisions, integration design, coding standards, testing approach and delivery quality.
* **Delivery Enablement:**
  Support teams in converting architecture into executable backlogs, clarifying dependencies, resolving technical blockers and aligning implementation with target architecture.
* **Knowledge Sharing:**

e7433414.title: Solution Architect | Shopify + eComm IRC307837
e7433414.description:
**Description**
This organization operates within the dynamic retail sector, specializing in consumer-facing products and services. It leverages advanced digital platforms to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences to a broad customer base. The company focuses on integrating innovative technologies to enhance customer engagement and streamline online purchasing journeys. Its market position is defined by a commitment to quality offerings and a robust digital infrastructure that supports scalable operations. The enterprise continuously evolves its technological capabilities to meet changing consumer demands and maintain a competitive edge in the digital marketplace.
  
  
**Requirements**
We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Hands-on eCommerce Solution Architect to lead the architecture, design, development, and implementation of enterprise Retail and eCommerce solutions.
  
  
The candidate must have 15+ years of overall IT experience, including at least 12+ years of hands-on eCommerce technology experience, with proven experience delivering production projects on Shopify and at least one additional eCommerce platform, such as VTEX, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce (Magento), commercetools, or SAP Commerce Cloud.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in eCommerce architecture, headless commerce, API-led integrations, and retail ecosystem systems, including Payment Gateways, OMS, ERP, PIM, WMS, Loyalty, and CRM. This role requires a hands-on technical leader who can drive architecture decisions, develop proof of concepts, review implementations, mentor engineering teams, and ensure scalable, secure, and reliable solutions across the full software development lifecycle.
  
  
**Required Skills:**

* Demonstrated expert-level proficiency and extensive hands-on experience with Shopify Plus, including deep knowledge of Liquid templating language and platform customization capabilities.
* Mandatory expertise in the retail and e-commerce domain, with a proven track record of architecting and delivering successful digital commerce solutions.
* Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, are essential for articulating complex architectural concepts to diverse technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Advanced understanding and practical application of Clean Architecture and Layered Architectures principles in designing robust and maintainable software systems.
* Strong advanced knowledge of database design, optimization, and management, ensuring high performance and scalability for critical e-commerce data.
* Proven advanced capability in solution architecture, including the ability to translate business requirements into comprehensive technical designs and system blueprints.
* Advanced proficiency in HTML, with a strong ability to develop and optimize front-end structures for responsive and user-friendly e-commerce interfaces.
* Advanced expertise in JavaScript, including modern frameworks and libraries, for building dynamic and interactive web applications within the e-commerce ecosystem.
* Advanced experience with CRM systems, demonstrating the ability to integrate and leverage customer relationship management platforms to enhance business processes.

**Preferred Skills:**
Job responsibilities
  
  
Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of scalable, secure, and high-performance Retail and eCommerce solutions.
  
  
Translate business requirements into robust, maintainable solution architectures aligned with business objectives.
  
  
Define architecture standards, design principles, integration patterns, and technology guidelines.
  
  
Create High-Level Designs (HLD), Low-Level Designs (LLD), solution architecture diagrams, API specifications, and integration documentation.
  
  
Design commerce solutions using Shopify and at least one additional enterprise eCommerce platform.
  
  
Evaluate native platform capabilities, third-party applications, extensions, and custom development requirements.
  
  
Design headless, composable, and omnichannel commerce architectures where appropriate.
  
  
Lead platform replatforming, modernization, migration, and phased implementation initiatives.
  
  
Define non-functional requirements covering performance, scalability, availability, security, and operational resilience.
  
  
eCommerce Platform Expertise
  
  
Demonstrate hands-on implementation and architecture experience with Shopify, including Shopify Plus where applicable.
  
  
Design and implement Shopify integrations using Admin GraphQL APIs, Storefront API, REST APIs where applicable, webhooks, metafields, metaobjects, themes, app extensions, and Shopify Markets.
  
  
Have substantial implementation experience with at least one additional eCommerce platform, such as VTEX, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce (Magento), commercetools, or SAP Commerce Cloud.
  
  
Understand platform-specific capabilities, extensibility models, APIs, integration patterns, and architectural trade-offs.
  
  
Lead technical assessments and recommend appropriate platform capabilities, native integrations, third-party applications, or custom solutions.
  
  
Drive implementation strategies for multi-brand, multi-market, multi-currency, and omnichannel commerce solutions.
  
  
Development & Integration Architecture
  
  
Remain hands-on by developing proof of concepts, validating architectural approaches, and contributing to complex technical implementations.
  
  
Design and implement API-led integrations using GraphQL, REST, webhooks, and event-driven communication patterns.
  
  
Architect middleware, Backend-for-Frontend (BFF), microservices, and integration orchestration layers using Node.js, .NET, Java, or equivalent technologies.
  
  
Design secure, scalable integrations between eCommerce platforms and enterprise retail systems, including:
  
  
Payment Gateways: Payment authorization, capture, refunds, tokenization, fraud prevention, split payments, and PCI DSS considerations.
  
  
Order Management Systems (OMS): Order orchestration, status synchronization, order allocation, cancellations, returns, refunds, and fulfillment.
  
  
Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP): Product, pricing, order, inventory, financial, and fulfillment data synchronization.
  
  
Product Information Management (PIM) and Digital Asset Management (DAM): Product catalog, attributes, taxonomy, media assets, localization, and enrichment.
  
  
Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and Inventory Systems: Stock synchronization, reservations, availability, fulfillment, and multi-location inventory.
  
  
Loyalty and CRM Platforms: Customer profiles, membership, points, rewards, promotions, subscriptions, and customer engagement.
  
  
CDP and MarTech Platforms: Customer data, consent, segmentation, personalization, marketing automation, analytics, and event tracking.
  
  
Tax, Shipping, Search, and Marketplace Systems: Tax calculation, carrier integrations, delivery estimates, product feeds, marketplace orders, and search capabilities.
  
  
Define integration contracts, data mappings, transformation rules, error handling, retry mechanisms, idempotency, reconciliation, and rate-limiting strategies.
  
  
Ensure reliable data synchronization across products, prices, inventory, customers, orders, payments, and fulfillment systems.
  
  
Drive code quality through architecture reviews, code reviews, technical coaching, and implementation guidance.
  
  
Troubleshoot complex production issues and provide architectural recommendations for reliability, performance, and scalability improvements.
  
  
Mentorship & Team Collaboration
  
  
Mentor Solution Architects, Technical Leads, and Software Engineers across multiple delivery teams.
  
  
Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, UX/UI, QA, DevOps, Security, Infrastructure, and business stakeholders.
  
  
Lead architecture reviews, design workshops, technical discussions, and proof-of-concept development.
  
  
Establish reusable architecture patterns, integration frameworks, reference implementations, and engineering standards.
  
  
Guide teams in implementing modern software engineering practices, automated testing, CI/CD, and secure development.
  
  
Collaborate with clients and third-party vendors to resolve integration dependencies and align technical implementation with business objectives.
  
  
Support technical presales, solution estimation, architecture assessments, and proposal development where required.
  
  
Scalability, Security & Performance
  
  
Design highly available, scalable, resilient, and secure eCommerce architectures.
  
  
Define performance and scalability strategies for storefronts, commerce APIs, middleware, and downstream integrations.
  
  
Establish observability strategies covering logging, metrics, distributed tracing, monitoring, alerting, and operational dashboards.
  
  
Define security practices for authentication, authorization, encryption, secrets management, API protection, and secure integrations.
  
  
Understand payment security, tokenization boundaries, and PCI DSS implications.
  
  
Define and validate non-functional requirements, including latency, throughput, availability, disaster recovery, and platform API rate limits.
  
  
Drive technical debt reduction, architecture modernization, operational optimization, and continuous improvement.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in eCommerce architecture, headless commerce, API-led integrations, and retail ecosystem systems, including Payment Gateways, OMS, ERP, PIM, WMS, Loyalty, and CRM. This role requires a hands-on technical leader who can drive architecture decisions, develop proof of concepts, review implementations, mentor engineering teams, and ensure scalable, secure, and reliable solutions across the full software development lifecycle.
  
  
**Required Skills:**

* Demonstrated expert-level proficiency and extensive hands-on experience with Shopify Plus, including deep knowledge of Liquid templating language and platform customization capabilities.
* Mandatory expertise in the retail and e-commerce domain, with a proven track record of architecting and delivering successful digital commerce solutions.
* Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, are essential for articulating complex architectural concepts to diverse technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Advanced understanding and practical application of Clean Architecture and Layered Architectures principles in designing robust and maintainable software systems.
* Strong advanced knowledge of database design, optimization, and management, ensuring high performance and scalability for critical e-commerce data.
* Proven advanced capability in solution architecture, including the ability to translate business requirements into comprehensive technical designs and system blueprints.
* Advanced proficiency in HTML, with a strong ability to develop and optimize front-end structures for responsive and user-friendly e-commerce interfaces.
* Advanced expertise in JavaScript, including modern frameworks and libraries, for building dynamic and interactive web applications within the e-commerce ecosystem.
* Advanced experience with CRM systems, demonstrating the ability to integrate and leverage customer relationship management platforms to enhance business processes.

**Preferred Skills:**
Job responsibilities

eCommerce Platform Expertise

Drive implementation strategies for multi-brand, multi-market, multi-currency, and omnichannel commerce solutions.
  
  
Development & Integration Architecture

Architect middleware, Backend-for-Frontend (BFF), microservices, and integration orchestration layers using Node.js, .NET, Java, or equivalent technologies.
  
  
Design secure, scalable integrations between eCommerce platforms and enterprise retail systems, including:

Loyalty and CRM Platforms: Customer profiles, membership, points, rewards, promotions, subscriptions, and customer engagement.

Define integration contracts, data mappings, transformation rules, error handling, retry mechanisms, idempotency, reconciliation, and rate-limiting strategies.

6b423bf3.description:
**Job Description Full Stack Architect (Next.js, React.js & Python)**

  

**Immediate Joiners Preferred**

  

**Position:** Full Stack Architect / Technical Architect  
 **Experience:** 6-8 Years  
 **Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Duration:** Fulltime

**Location:** Jaipur

**Technology Stack:** Next.js, React.js, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Cloud (AWS/Azure)

  

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced **Full Stack Architect** with strong expertise in Next.js, React.js, and Python to design, architect, and deliver scalable, secure, and high-performance enterprise applications.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on development experience, strong system design capabilities, and the ability to lead technical architecture decisions across frontend, backend, databases, cloud infrastructure, and integrations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement end-to-end architecture for enterprise-grade full-stack applications.
* Lead frontend architecture using **React.js, Next.js, TypeScript**, and modern UI frameworks.
* Design scalable backend services and RESTful APIs using **Python, FastAPI, or Django**.
* Define application architecture, including microservices, modular monoliths, and event-driven systems.
* Establish reusable components, coding standards, and architectural best practices.
* Design database schemas, optimize queries, and manage relational and NoSQL databases.
* Architect authentication, authorization, RBAC, and secure API integrations.
* Lead technical design discussions, architecture reviews, and system design decisions.
* Collaborate with product managers, UI/UX designers, DevOps engineers, and business stakeholders.
* Implement performance optimization, caching, monitoring, and application scalability strategies.
* Guide development teams through code reviews, technical mentoring, and solution implementation.
* Support cloud-native deployments, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and production readiness.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend suitable architectural solutions.

**Required Technical Skills**

**Frontend Technologies**

* Strong expertise in React.js, Next.js, JavaScript (ES6+), and TypeScript.
* Experience with Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Static Site Generation (SSG), and React Server Components.
* Strong understanding of state management, component architecture, and frontend performance optimization.
* Experience with Tailwind CSS, Material UI, or similar UI frameworks.
* Knowledge of micro-frontend architecture is an advantage.

**Backend Technologies**

* Strong hands-on experience with Python and frameworks such as FastAPI or Django.
* Experience designing RESTful APIs, asynchronous services, and microservices.
* Strong understanding of API security, authentication, authorization, and middleware.
* Experience with background processing, task queues, and distributed systems.

**Database & Data Layer**

* Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server.
* Knowledge of MongoDB, Redis, or other NoSQL/caching technologies.
* Strong understanding of database modeling, indexing, and query optimization.
* Experience with ORMs such as SQLAlchemy.

**Architecture & System Design**

* Strong knowledge of High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD).
* Experience designing scalable, distributed, multi-tenant enterprise applications.
* Understanding of design patterns, SOLID principles, and clean architecture.
* Experience with API gateways, message queues, caching, and event-driven architecture.
* Ability to make architectural decisions considering performance, security, cost, and maintainability.

**Cloud & DevOps**

* Experience with AWS or Microsoft Azure.
* Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and container-based deployments.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins.
* Understanding of cloud networking, monitoring, logging, and infrastructure scalability.

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience integrating Generative AI and LLM-based capabilities into enterprise applications.
* Familiarity with AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar technologies.
* Experience with WebSockets, real-time applications, and asynchronous communication.
* Knowledge of GraphQL and API orchestration.
* Familiarity with Databricks, data platforms, or analytics-driven applications.
* Experience working with enterprise SSO, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and Microsoft Entra ID.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Ability to lead technical teams and mentor senior developers.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience conducting architecture reviews and technical feasibility assessments.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical architecture and implementation plans.
* Strong communication skills for collaborating with clients, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.
* Experience supporting technical estimations, solution proposals, and delivery planning.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6-8+ years of software engineering experience, with significant hands-on experience in full-stack application development.
* At least 23 years of experience in technical architecture, solution design, or technical leadership.
* Proven experience architecting and delivering production-grade enterprise applications.

**Expected Outcomes**

* Deliver scalable, secure, maintainable, and production-ready application architectures.
* Establish consistent technical standards across frontend and backend development.
* Improve application performance, reliability, and development efficiency.
* Provide architectural guidance while remaining actively involved in critical technical implementations.

fe29adfd.title: It Architect
fe29adfd.description:
**Ready to take your career global?**   
Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We are looking for the IT Architect to join our ever evolving Genius team and help shape the future of global commerce.   
   
**What you'll own**   
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience  
 - 12+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 5 years in a solution architect, lead engineer, or principal engineer capacity  
 - Demonstrated experience designing and shipping payment integrations: card-present, gateway integrations, semi-integrated payment flows, tokenization, or PCI-scoped architectures  
 - Hands-on experience building or operating cloud-native systems on AWS or Azure (microservices, event-driven architecture, API design)  
 - Strong API design skills across REST and OpenAPI, including authentication/authorization patterns (OAuth 2.0, API key lifecycle)  
 - Experience integrating third-party platforms and designing scalable integration patterns (adapters, SPIs, provider-agnostic contracts)  
   
**What you'll bring**  
**Technical:**  
- Cloud platforms:\*\* AWS (ECS/Fargate, EKS, Lambda, SQS/SNS, Aurora, S3, CloudWatch) and/or Azure (App Services, AKS, Service Bus, Cosmos DB)  
 - Backend:\*\* Java, .NET, Node.js, PHP, Go, or comparable; comfortable reading and reviewing across stacks  
 - Data:\*\* Relational (MySQL/PostgreSQL/Aurora), caching (Redis), search (OpenSearch/Elasticsearch), big data pipelines (BigQuery, Athena, S3-based lakes)  
 - Messaging / events:\*\* Kafka, SQS/SNS, or comparable event-driven architectures  
 - Mobile platforms:\*\* Familiarity with iOS, Android, or React Native in the context of commerce client applications  
 - IaC and CI/CD:\*\* Terraform, GitHub Actions, Harness, or equivalent  
 - AI/ML:\*\* Practical experience with foundation model APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, GCP Vertex), prompt engineering, RAG patterns, agent frameworks, or MCP tooling  
-Skills / Knowledge:\*\* Having wide-ranging experience, uses professional concepts and company objectives to resolve complex issues in creative and effective ways.  
 -Job Complexity:\*\* Works on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. Exercises judgment in selecting methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Networks with key contacts outside own area of expertise.  
 -Supervision:\*\* Determines methods and procedures on new assignments and may coordinate activities of other personnel.  
- Action over artifacts:\*\* Ships solutions, not documents. Diagrams exist to align teams, not to substitute for delivery. Value is measured by what teams build and ship, not by the elegance of designs in isolation.  
 - Bias toward decisions:\*\* Makes the call when teams are stuck, documents the why and the risks.  
 - Shared mindset:\*\* Before approving a net-new build, the first question is whether a peer domain already solved it or also has value in it.  
 - Communicates across levels:\*\* Equally comfortable in an engineering design review and a product conversation about tradeoffs.  
**#Tooling**  
- \*\*Project and delivery management:\*\* Jira, Confluence  
 - \*\*Architecture and diagramming:\*\* Lucidchart, Miro, draw.io, or comparable  
 - \*\*API design and documentation:\*\* Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman, Apigee, or comparable  
 - \*\*Observability:\*\* Datadog, CloudWatch, or comparable APM/logging platforms  
   
**It's a bonus if you have**   
- Experience with point-of-sale systems or commerce platforms  
 - Familiarity with payment gateway ecosystems  
 - Experience designing or working with unified integration platforms, API gateways (Apigee, Kong, AWS API Gateway), or developer portals  
 - Experience building or architecting AI-enabled features: chatbot/conversational AI, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, LLM tool use (function calling, MCP), or AI-assisted developer tooling  
 - Experience working across verticals (SMB, mid-market, enterprise) and understanding the architectural tradeoffs each requires  
- Working knowledge of PCI DSS scope management and semi-integrated payment architectures  
 - Familiarity with P2PE, tokenization, and secure card data handling  
 - Understanding of payment tender types: credit/debit, gift card, BNPL, ACH, and alternative payment methods  
**About the team**   
Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We are proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections it's unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.   
   
**What makes a Globalpayer?**   
Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We are curious and innovative - always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it's our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.   
   
Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

8fa382c1.title: Strategic Account & Delivery Manager
8fa382c1.description:
**Company Description**

EDMO is an AI-powered company specializing in enrollment-centric solutions for higher education institutions, offering tools to streamline admission processes. By automating tasks like document verification, transcript evaluation, and applicant matching, EDMO enables institutions to process applications efficiently and with greater accuracy. Its innovative features, such as AI-powered chatbots and GPA calculators, enhance transparency and efficiency across the enrollment journey. Clients benefit from reduced administrative workloads, improved decision-making, and enhanced student engagement. EDMO is committed to making the admissions process smarter, faster, and more personalized.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Project, Account & Integration Manager to oversee strategic US-based enterprise accounts. This role combines project and account management with a strong focus on leading product integration efforts—ensuring our solutions are successfully deployed and delivering maximum value for our customers.

**Responsibilities**

**Project Management**

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of large-scale client projects, ensuring on-time, on-budget, and within-scope execution—including product integrations.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, and resource allocations, coordinating cross-functional internal/external teams.
* Apply established project management methodologies (PMO, Agile, Lean, etc.) and tools for structured execution.
* Proactively identify and resolve risks/issues, control scope, and manage change processes.
* Prepare regular status updates, present project progress to customers and leadership teams.

**Product Integration**

* Take ownership of product integration work for enterprise clients, from planning through go-live, ensuring seamless deployment of all solution components.
* Collaborate with clients and technical teams to define integration requirements and success criteria.
* Oversee the design, customization, configuration, and deployment of product integrations, acting as the liaison between client technical teams and internal product/engineering teams.
* Troubleshoot and resolve integration issues, coordinating root cause analysis and implementing lasting solutions.
* Ensure all product integrations meet customer needs, compliance standards, and performance expectations.
* Lead user acceptance testing and client enablement for integrated solutions, ensuring successful adoption and usage.

**Account Management & Growth**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for US-based enterprise customers, developing deep relationships with key stakeholders.
* Own and manage a portfolio of large enterprise accounts, crafting and executing account growth strategies.
* Identify, pursue, and secure new business opportunities within existing accounts, consistently meeting/exceeding revenue goals.
* Conduct regular business reviews, deliver performance reports, and recommend strategic solutions—driving upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
* Gather, communicate, and act on client feedback to improve service delivery and inform product enhancements.

**Collaboration & Leadership**

* Coordinate cross-functional teams including technical, sales, support, and integration resources to deliver value to enterprise clients.
* Drive accountability, provide coaching/mentorship, and foster collaboration within project and integration teams.
* Ensure compliance with organizational standards, security, and quality controls, as well as contractual obligations.

**Market & Industry Awareness**

* Stay informed about market trends, customer business environments, and competitive landscapes relevant to client accounts.
* Leverage industry knowledge to propose innovative solutions and best practices—including integration trends—tailored for US enterprises.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred in Business, Management, Computer Science, or related fields.
* Minimum 5 years’ experience in enterprise project management and/or account management, including direct experience with product software or SaaS integrations for US clients.
* Proven track record of growing large, complex accounts, successfully delivering enterprise-grade projects, and handling product integrations.
* Strong understanding of integration standards, APIs, enterprise platforms, and deployment processes.
* Deep knowledge of project management methodologies and best practices.
* Excellent client relationship, communication, negotiation, problem-solving, technical, and leadership skills.
* Experience working with cross-cultural and international teams; familiarity with US business practices preferred.
* Industry experience in technology, SaaS, enterprise software, or consulting is highly valued.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
* Opportunity to work with leading U.S. universities and shape the future of EdTech.
* Collaborative, mission-driven team culture.
* Exposure to cutting-edge AI tools transforming global education.

9f5b96b3.title: Management Consulting Engagement Manager
9f5b96b3.description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title** - Engagement Manager

**Corporate Title** – Vice President

**Location** - Mumbai

**Deutsche Bank Management Consulting**
---------------------------------------

**You will be joining Deutsche Bank Management Consulting (DBMC), the Bank’s in-house management consulting global team that partners with senior leaders to actively contribute to the bank’s strategic objectives. DBMC connects strategy to execution with measurable outcomes. Our role is to support the bank’s transformation journey, helping to define and operationalize its key priorities. To achieve this, we collaborate with business divisions and infrastructure functions across Deutsche Bank’s global platform.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Our Engagements cover a wide range of topics including strategic growth initiatives, product development, process optimization, risk and regulatory transformation, generative AI adoption, as well as organizational / operating model design. This provides our team with broad exposure to the bank’s key priorities, diverse topics, and the opportunity to work with senior clients.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**We are a dynamic and highly motivated team with a global presence, operating from offices in Frankfurt, London, and Mumbai. You will work in a multicultural team, regularly collaborating with international colleagues across different regions.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Our team members are academically and professionally accomplished, with degrees from leading global universities and backgrounds not limited to business/finance. We take pride in being an inclusive and collaborative** **group of professionals who celebrate and support one another**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  

**What We Offer You**
---------------------

To support the transformation and growth ambitions of the bank in the best possible way, we are looking for an Engagement Manager to join our team in Mumbai, India

You can expect challenging and varied tasks - from day one. As part of your job, you will rotate into new project teams every 3-6 months and get to know all business divisions (Corporate & Investment Bank, DWS, Private Bank) as well as infrastructure functions (e.g., Risk, Finance) of the bank. You will engage with the bank’s most senior leaders. We regularly work with top executives, gaining a strategic, high-level view of the bank’s priorities.

**Your key responsibilities:**

* Lead and deliver end-to-end project modules across business and infrastructure functions, applying structured problem-solving methodologies, clearly defining situation, complication, and decision points
* Lead and develop project teams by setting clear expectations, managing team performance, allocating responsibilities effectively, and providing regular coaching and constructive feedback to support individual development and high-quality project delivery
* Take ownership for the conceptual planning and implementation of strategic projects
* Formulate feasible tactical and strategic recommendations, ensuring alignment with Deutsche Bank’s strategic priorities, governance standards, and regulatory context.
* Drive hypothesis led, advanced analytics to generate robust insights and evidence based recommendations and translate findings into clear, decision oriented messages tailored to senior and audiences.
* Together with our AI experts, lead structured problem solving across strategic and transformation topics including opportunity sizing, operating model design and process improvement
* Translate business problems into AI use cases, including problem definition, target outcomes, user needs, business process redesign implications, feasibility considerations and prototyping Agents in our end-user development environment
* Act as a primary day‑to‑day client contact for assigned project modules; independently lead client meetings, workshops, and working sessions.
* Develop the necessary and appropriate structures and frameworks to aid robust analysis and development of solutions, ultimately to ensure positive outcomes and sustainable results
* Prepare high quality, insight driven materials for senior management, translating complex analysis into clear, compelling recommendations.
* Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for the project topic, demonstrating strong understanding of the topic and integrate this knowledge into project delivery and client discussions.
* Own and contribute to project knowledge resources to enable knowledge reuse, consistency, and capability building within DBMC.
* Supervise, coach, and quality‑assure the work of junior and senior consultants and ensure timely delivery of their outputs
* Own and drive strategic internal initiatives alongside client projects, in close collaboration with consulting teams across London, Frankfurt and Mumbai
* Flexibility to work across global time zones (European hours), as required for the project needs and stakeholder interactions.
* Act in line with the bank’s values & aspirational culture, contributing to an inclusive, collaborative, and high‑performance team environment.
Ensure awareness of and adherence to relevant bank policies, practices, governance, and control requirements, proactively flagging delivery, risk, or stakeholder concerns.  

  

**Your skills and experience:**
-------------------------------

We are looking for professionals with excellent academic performance across relevant disciplines), in all disciplines (Master's degree mandatory). Professional qualifications are important, but your personality is even more decisive to us.

* Minimum 10 years of relevant Consulting and Financial Services experience (Post MBA) across relevant Consulting, Financial Services, AI transformation or technology-enabled business deliv-ery (ideally in financial services) focusing on strategy, transformation & demonstrating prob-lem‑solving, structured thinking, and delivery ownership
* Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional strategy and transformation engagements end-to-end, from problem definition and workplan development through recommendation, stakeholder alignment and implementation.
* Proven experience leading and managing diverse teams with the ability to motivate team members to deliver complex project outcomes successfully
* Strong senior stakeholder management and executive advisory skills, with the ability to build credibility, challenge constructively and shape decisions with senior leaders across business and infrastructure functions.
* Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity and independently structure complex business problems, develop hypotheses, evaluate strategic options and translate analysis into pragmatic, actionable recommendations.
* Strong commercial and business judgement, with experience developing and challenging business cases, assessing financial and non-financial impact, and evaluating trade-offs to inform management decisions.
* Ability to develop compelling executive-level narratives and decision materials, synthesising complex analysis into clear recommendations and communicating effectively with senior and Board-level audiences.
* Strong understanding of the Financial Services industry, including banking business models, operating models, key value drivers and the broader risk, regulatory and technology environment.
* Track record of translating strategy into execution, including designing target operating models, process improvements, governance structures, implementation roadmaps and measurable outcomes.
* Ability to identify, anticipate and proactively manage project risks, dependencies and stakeholder challenges, escalating appropriately while maintaining accountability for delivery.
* Experience working effectively across functions, geographies and cultures, with the adaptability to engage different stakeholder groups and operate in complex organisational environments
* Conceptual and practical understanding of Generative AI, workflow automation or agentic workflows is beneficial. Software engineering experience is not required
* Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs
* Clear, confident communicator in English, capable of explaining and interpreting complex information to support stakeholder alignment and decision‑making; German language skills are an advantage.
* Commitment to continuous learning and development, Proven experience in coaching and developing junior professionals
Relevant internships, certifications, and entrepreneurial activities are also a plus  

  

**How we’ll support you**

* Training programs tailored to your experience level from day one to help you excel in your career

* Coaching and support from experts in the DBMC team

* Support through a personal buddy system tailored to experience level

* Access to diverse role models across regions for guidance (We have a strong network of 100+ alumni across the bank)

* Flexibility around key moments in the day and respect for personal priorities

* Strong feedback culture supporting open, 360-degree professional development

* A mix of formal and informal social events, including sports activities and CSR/volunteering opportunities

* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

o Best in class leave policy

o Gender neutral parental leaves

o 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)

o Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents

o Accident and Term life Insurance

o Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Are you interested in joining us? We are looking forward to getting to know you!

Please submit your application online in English (including CV, cover letter and all academic and professional references).

  

**About us and our teams**
--------------------------

  

**Please visit our company website for further information:** https://www.db.com/company/company.htm

  

**For more information on DBMC, please visit our team website for further information:** **DBMC – Deutsche Bank Careers**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

a7e02a18.description:
**Description**
Fascinated about Alexa? Have a passion for cars? Want to help build our Automotive business? Alexa Automotive is looking for an experienced Senior Program Manager with strong track record of driving cross-organization programs in a tech setup. This role is within our Monetization team that is invested in building best in class billing product platform covering commerce experiences, automated invoicing and revenue recognition. This is a high-visibility role which will directly impact economic growth of our business. As part of a rapidly growing team, this role offers plenty of opportunity to learn, have an impact, and grow.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
This role functions as a day-to-day liaison between business development, technology, product, tax, accounting, legal and finance organizations to deliver enterprise services that deal with off-the-chart complexity and scale.
  
  
Our ideal candidate is collaborative, driven with attention to detail, makes data-driven decisions and can build trust with all stakeholders. As a passionate program leader, you will have direct impact on how our partners are billed reliably, correctly, and on-time, and accelerate growth & expansion of our business. Experience in managing large scale fintech programs is highly desirable.
  
  

* Articulate the key pain-points with our current manual processes and define process optimizations we could achieve through automation products.
* Conceptualize programs to scale existing billing operations through automation to keep up with rapidly growing Auto business.
* Work cross-organizationally with members of product, business development, tax, accounting, legal, finance in driving delivery, mitigating risks, eliminating impediments, ensuring compliance and operationalization.
* Establish metrics and design self-serve reports to keep stake-holders informed and excited about billing team’s progress.

**About The Team**
Alexa Automotive's vision is to create safe, voice-first and multi-modal experiences to drivers and passengers in vehicles. With Alexa in the vehicle, customers can use their voice to play music, control in-cabin comfort features like AC/heater, control smart home devices, and access tens of thousands of skills built by third-party developers – all while keeping their hands on the wheel and eyes on the road.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

****Title And Summary****
Senior Technical Program Manager
  
  
**Overview:**
The AI Platform Engineering team is responsible for enabling the enterprise adoption of artificial intelligence by building, operating, and evolving shared AI platforms, services, governance capabilities, and operational practices. Our mission is to provide scalable, secure, reliable, and compliant AI infrastructure that empowers teams across Mastercard to accelerate the development and deployment of AI-powered solutions.
  
  
As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will lead the delivery of complex, cross-functional initiatives that support the evolution of Mastercard's AI platform ecosystem. You will partner closely with engineering, product, architecture, infrastructure, security, governance, operations, and business stakeholders to drive alignment, manage dependencies, reduce execution risk, and ensure successful delivery of strategic programs.
  
  
This team functions as an enterprise AI Platform Engineering organization, delivering and operating shared capabilities that enable application teams to build and scale AI-powered products across public and private cloud environments.
  
  
This role provides the opportunity to help shape and execute the roadmap for Mastercard's next generation AI platform capabilities. Rather than focusing on a single product or application, you will drive programs that span platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, developer enablement, governance, operational excellence, and enterprise adoption.
  
  
You will work on challenging problems involving large-scale technology delivery, platform adoption, stakeholder alignment, roadmap execution, operational readiness, governance, and organizational transformation while helping shape Mastercard's long-term AI platform strategy.
  
  
**About The Role:**
As a Senior Technical Program Manager, AI Platform Engineering, you will be responsible for leading large-scale technology initiatives from concept through implementation and operationalization. You will coordinate work across multiple engineering and business organizations, ensuring that strategic priorities are translated into executable plans and delivered successfully.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong program management expertise with sufficient technical depth to engage effectively with engineers, architects, and technology leaders. You are passionate about execution, organizational effectiveness, continuous improvement, and enabling teams to deliver complex technology solutions at enterprise scale.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Lead complex, cross-functional technology programs from initiation through deployment and operational readiness.
* Develop and maintain integrated delivery plans that account for dependencies, risks, resource requirements, milestones, and evolving business priorities.
* Drive alignment across engineering, product, architecture, infrastructure, security, governance, operations, and business stakeholders.
* Establish clear program objectives, success metrics, execution strategies, and delivery mechanisms.
* Proactively identify, manage, and resolve risks, issues, dependencies, and organizational blockers.

* Drive effective decision-making by facilitating discussions, evaluating tradeoffs, and escalating issues when necessary.
* Coordinate delivery across multiple teams, ensuring dependencies are understood, managed, and communicated effectively.
* Develop executive-ready communications, dashboards, status updates, presentations, and program reviews.
* Lead planning sessions, steering committees, roadmap reviews, operational reviews, and stakeholder meetings.
* Establish governance, reporting, and operational mechanisms that improve transparency, predictability, and execution effectiveness.
* Partner with engineering teams to improve delivery processes, operating models, planning practices, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Ensure programs meet organizational standards for security, compliance, risk management, operational readiness, and business continuity.
* Utilize metrics and data-driven insights to assess program health, communicate outcomes, and drive continuous improvement.
* Support strategic planning, portfolio management, roadmap development, prioritization, and organizational scaling initiatives.
* Contribute to a culture of accountability, collaboration, operational excellence, and customer focus.

**All About You:**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* Experience leading large-scale technical programs involving multiple engineering teams and business stakeholders.
* Strong experience managing complex cross-functional initiatives within software engineering, infrastructure, cloud, platform engineering, data, or technology organizations.
* Demonstrated ability to build and manage integrated plans, coordinate dependencies, mitigate risks, and drive successful delivery outcomes.
* Experience communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
* Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Experience managing competing priorities and delivering results in fast-paced, evolving environments.
* Ability to influence across organizations without direct authority.
* Experience working with Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid delivery methodologies.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level presentation and reporting.
* Experience working within highly collaborative, cross-functional technology organizations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting cloud platforms, developer platforms, AI/ML platforms, data platforms, infrastructure platforms, or enterprise software systems.
* Familiarity with software engineering concepts, system architecture, cloud computing, and modern technology delivery practices.
* Experience supporting platform adoption, developer enablement, operational excellence, and organizational transformation initiatives.
* Experience establishing delivery governance, operational reviews, portfolio management, or enterprise planning practices.
* Experience working within regulated environments requiring strong security, governance, compliance, and risk management controls.
* PMP, PgMP, Scrum, SAFe, or comparable program management certifications.

We are seeking an accomplished and highly driven Senior Technical Program Manager to lead strategic IT programs to enable business capabilities for Sales, Marketing and Finance functions. This role sits in the central IT PMO where you will own planning and delivery of high-impact cross-functional programs that span Go-To-Market, Marketing automation, Web marketing, Finance, Sales Compensation, and Partner enablement. You will provide visible leadership, accountability, and governance across initiatives, from intake and prioritization through execution, go-live, and post-implementation optimization.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on program leader with a proven track record delivering complex technology programs, a deep understanding of Sales & Marketing or Finance processes, and exceptional collaboration skills to partner effectively with business stakeholders and technical teams.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Program Strategy & Governance**

* Define, champion, and execute the programs, aligned to company-wide business objectives, Business strategy, and annual planning priorities.
* Lead one or more concurrent, complex programs involving one or more of these domains - CRM, CPQ, Marketing Automation, Web Marketing, Sales Performance Management, Procure-to-Pay, Revenue and Sales Commissions.

**Program Delivery & Execution**

* Track scope, timeline, budget, and quality, proactively identify risks and interdependencies and drive mitigations and trade-off decisions with stakeholders.

**Business Domain Leadership**

* Partner with Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, Product Operations, Channel/Partner teams, Finance and Commissions to prioritize and deliver programs across:

+ CRM (i.e. CPQ Cloud, Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing integrations)

**Experience You’ll Need**

* 10-15 years of progressive experience in IT program / project management, technology consulting, or enterprise applications, with at least 5+ years leading Sales & Marketing or Finance programs.
* Understanding of Sales & Marketing and Finance processes across lead lifecycle, opportunity management, forecasting, campaign management, sales performance management, commissions, and partner programs.
* Hands-on experience delivering complex programs on CRM and marketing platforms (e.g., Salesforce Sales Cloud / Service Cloud, Marketo, Adobe Experience Manager, or equivalent).
* Hands-on proficiency with generative AI platforms (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) to automate project documentation, accelerate decision-making, and streamline cross-functional workflows.
* Demonstrated ability to leverage LLMs and prompt engineering to synthesize complex program data, conduct rapid risk analysis, and produce executive-level reporting.
* Track record of integrating frontier AI tools into daily program management practices to enhance operational velocity, optimize stakeholder communication, and drive efficient problem-solving.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional, global teams and manage stakeholders at multiple levels, including senior business leaders.
* Proven track record establishing program governance, managing budgets, and driving projects to successful completion in fast-paced environments.
* Proficiency with Agile and hybrid delivery models, and with project / program management tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Smartsheet, or similar.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to define business cases, quantify ROI, and make data-driven decisions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in high-growth technology companies working closely with global Sales, Marketing, and GTM Operations teams.

d65a1c60.title: Technical Program Manager – Data Center Infrastructure Deployments
d65a1c60.description:
**About Nebius**

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

**The role**

As a Technical Program Manager, you will own the delivery of a defined workstream within large-scale GPU and data center infrastructure deployment programs. In this role you’ll be responsible for tracking progress, managing dependencies, and ensuring your workstream is delivered on time and at quality.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of infrastructure, execution, and coordination, with strong exposure to real-world data center delivery.

Travel: On-site presence at data centers will be required during key deployment phases.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include**

* Own delivery of a defined workstream within a larger data center or infrastructure program.
* Track scope, schedule, and dependencies, escalating risks when needed.
* Coordinate with engineering, networking, construction, and operations teams.
* Maintain clear and structured reporting on progress, risks, and blockers.
* Support vendor and contractor coordination within your scope.
* Work closely with the Senior TPM to align on priorities and execution approach.

**Technical Scope & Expectations**

This role requires exposure to physical infrastructure environments, not only software-based projects.

**You Should Be Comfortable Working With Or Learning About**

* Data center environments: basic understanding of infrastructure readiness (power, cooling, space, networking dependencies).
* Compute infrastructure: knowledge about server and storage equipment.
* Networking: cabling, connectivity, and integration dependencies.
* Deployment & bring-up: understanding how systems move from installation to operational readiness.

You are not expected to be an expert, but you should:

* Be willing to learn technical concepts quickly.
* Understand how different parts of infrastructure depend on each other.
* Identify when something is not ready or at risk and escalate appropriately.
* Communicate effectively with technical teams.

**We Expect You To Have**

* 2–5 years of experience in program management, operations, or technical coordination roles.
* Ability to organize work, track progress, and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams.
* Structured thinking and attention to details.
* Willingness to learn and grow in a fast-paced, technical environment.

**It will be an added bonus if you have**

* Exposure to data center, networking, or hardware-related projects,
* Familiarity with program management tools (Jira, Asana, etc.),
* Understanding of cloud environments infrastructure,
* Certifications or coursework in program management.

**Benefits & Perks**

* Competitive compensation
* Career growth and learning opportunities
* Flexibility and ownership
* Collaborative and innovative culture
* Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
* International environment and talented teams

**What's It Like To Work At Nebius**

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

**Overall Summary**

  

The Senior Public Transportation Architect serves as a senior technical delivery professional responsible for the planning, design, and multidisciplinary coordination of complex transit infrastructure and public transportation facility projects. The role is intended for an experienced engineer-architect who can lead technical workstreams, coordinate across disciplines, support client and stakeholder discussions, and deliver practical, sustainable, and operationally effective transit facilities.

  

The role supports projects such as transit stations, bus rapid transit facilities, multimodal transportation hubs, maintenance and operations facilities, mobility hubs, park-and-ride facilities, passenger transfer facilities, and fleet electrification infrastructure. The position is focused on technical excellence, project delivery, design integration, quality, and mentoring within multidisciplinary transit infrastructure teams.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead planning, programming, architectural design, and construction support for transit stations, multimodal hubs, maintenance facilities, BRT facilities, operations centers, and other transportation infrastructure projects.
* Serve as Lead Architect, Design Lead, or Discipline Lead for complex transit infrastructure assignments, ensuring that architectural deliverables are coordinated, technically sound, and aligned with project requirements.
* Coordinate and integrate architectural solutions with civil, structural, geotechnical, MEP, rail systems, communications, traction power, transportation planning, operations, safety, security, sustainability, and digital delivery disciplines.
* Develop facility concepts that balance passenger experience, operational efficiency, accessibility, safety, maintainability, resiliency, sustainability, lifecycle performance, and future expansion needs.
* Prepare, review, and coordinate design criteria, reports, technical memoranda, drawings, specifications, BIM models, and contract documents across project phases.
* Support project managers with scope management, schedule coordination, budget awareness, resource planning, risk reviews, and quality assurance for architectural and facility-related tasks.
* Participate in interdisciplinary design reviews, constructability reviews, value engineering sessions, and technical quality reviews to improve project outcomes.
* Interface with client teams to present design concepts, resolve technical issues, and support approvals.
* Support construction-phase services including responding to RFIs, reviewing submittals, and coordinating design clarifications.
* Promote BIM coordination, digital delivery workflows, and innovative approaches to improve quality, coordination, and delivery efficiency.
* Mentor architects, engineers, designers, and BIM/modeling staff.

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

  

* Bachelors degree in Architecture or related engineering field from an accredited institution.
* 12+ years of relevant experience in architecture, transportation facilities, transit infrastructure, or complex public infrastructure projects.
* Minimum 8 years of experience delivering rail, metro, BRT, bus, or multimodal transportation facility projects.
* Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary design teams and coordinating with civil, structural, MEP, systems, operations, safety, and sustainability disciplines.
* Experience supporting project delivery through multiple phases, including planning, feasibility, conceptual design, detailed design, procurement support, and construction support.
* Strong working knowledge of accessibility requirements, sustainable design principles, and public infrastructure design requirements.
* Strong communication, coordination, and technical leadership skills.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Masters degree in Architecture, Urban Design, Transportation Planning, or a related field.
* Experience with transit stations, rail/metro facilities, BRT facilities, multimodal hubs, maintenance and storage facilities, operations centers, passenger facilities, and fleet electrification infrastructure.
* Experience integrating architecture with rail systems, transit operations, maintenance requirements, transportation engineering, and public realm design.
* Experience with Design-Build, Progressive Design-Build, CM/GC, or other alternative delivery methods.
* Proficiency with BIM, Navisworks, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and digital delivery workflows.
* Experience delivering large-scale transit infrastructure projects for North American, Middle East, or other international clients.

  

**Primary Focus**

  

Transit stations, BRT facilities, multimodal hubs, maintenance and operations facilities, mobility hubs, and fleet electrification infrastructure.

Leads and coordinates with civil, structural, MEP, rail systems, operations, safety, sustainability, and digital delivery teams
