97416e01.title: Architect
97416e01.description:
**Role Summary**

The Citrix Architect is the technical authority for the organization's Citrix virtualization platform. This role investigates complex, high-severity issues, leads upgrade and migration projects (CVAD and Citrix DaaS), drives the Citrix Profile Management (UPM) vs FSLogix strategy, and evaluates and proves out new solutions through POCs before leading their production deployment.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**

**1. Architecture and Design**

· Design, document, and maintain the end-to-end Citrix architecture (CVAD on-prem, Citrix DaaS, hybrid, and multi-site/DR designs).

· Produce high-level and low-level designs (HLD/LLD), reference architectures, standards, and build guides.

· Define capacity planning, sizing, scalability, and high-availability strategies for Delivery Controllers, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, Cloud Connectors, and VDA workloads.

· Design secure remote access using NetScaler Gateway/ADC, including authentication (SAML, MFA, Entra ID), aligned with Zero Trust principles.

· Ensure the architecture aligns with security, compliance, and enterprise standards.

**2. Complex Issue Investigation and Escalation**

· Serve as the Tier 3 / final technical escalation point for complex, high-impact Citrix incidents.

· Perform deep-dive root cause analysis (RCA) on slow logons, session launch failures, black screens, session reliability/reconnects, HDX/graphics performance, VDA registration failures, and profile issues.

· Use tools such as CDF Control, Citrix Director, WEM analytics, Wireshark, ProcMon, Event Logs, and Citrix Scout to diagnose problems.

· Engage Citrix Support and vendors (Microsoft, hypervisor, storage, network) and drive cases to resolution.

· Document RCA findings, implement permanent fixes, and create knowledge base articles and runbooks.

**3. Upgrade and Project Delivery**

· Lead end-to-end delivery of CVAD upgrades (LTSR/CR): assessment, prerequisites, test plan, pilot, cutover, and rollback planning.

· Lead Citrix DaaS migration, upgrade, or onboarding projects, including Cloud Connector deployment and hybrid/cloud transition.

· Upgrade related components: StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, Licensing Server, Director, WEM, PVS/MCS, and VDA/master images.

· Develop project plans, timelines, risk registers, and communication plans; coordinate with Project Managers, infrastructure, security, and application teams.

· Ensure minimal downtime and sound change management (CAB, change records, post-implementation reviews).

**4. Profile Management Strategy (UPM vs FSLogix)**

· Evaluate Citrix Profile Management (UPM) vs Microsoft FSLogix on logon performance, scalability, storage impact, resilience, Office/OneDrive/Teams support, and supportability.

· Design the profile architecture: storage (SMB, NetApp, Azure Files), Cloud Cache vs VHD(X) locations, redirection, and exclusions.

· Lead profile migration projects, including pilot, tuning, and user acceptance testing.

· Define best practices for profile size, antivirus exclusions, and monitoring.

**5. New Solution Deployment and POC**

· Lead POCs and pilots for new technologies (e.g., Citrix DaaS, WEM, App Layering, Citrix Analytics, cloud-hosted VDAs, GPU/HDX 3D Pro, Windows 11 multi-session, Citrix Secure Private Access).

· Define success criteria, test cases, and measurable outcomes; present findings with clear recommendations, cost, and risk analysis.

· Lead production rollout of approved solutions through design, build, testing, and handover to operations.

· Evaluate alternatives (e.g., Azure Virtual Desktop, VMware Horizon) and provide objective comparisons when required.

**6. Operations, Automation, and Optimization**

· Optimize logon times, session performance, user experience, and resource utilization.

· Automate deployment, image management, and configuration using PowerShell, REST APIs, Terraform/Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines.

· Define monitoring and alerting strategy (Director, ControlUp, Splunk, SCOM, Azure Monitor, etc.).

· Perform regular health checks, patching strategy reviews, and lifecycle/EOL planning.

· Maintain golden image standards and application delivery/packaging strategy (MSIX, App-V, App Layering).

**7. Governance, Security, and Compliance**

· Define and enforce Citrix security baselines, hardening standards, and certificate management.

· Support audits and vulnerability remediation (NetScaler/ADC patching, Citrix security bulletins).

· Maintain architecture documentation and DR/BCP plans, and test DR failovers.

**8. Leadership and Collaboration**

· Provide technical leadership and mentorship to Citrix engineers and support teams.

· Act as the primary technical liaison with Citrix, Microsoft, and other vendors.

· Communicate technical concepts clearly to stakeholders, management, and non-technical audiences.

· Contribute to roadmap planning, budget inputs, and vendor/licensing strategy.

**9 Methodology Development & Knowledge Transfer**

* Design and continuously refine the team's diagnostic playbook — a step-by-step, tool-by-tool guide that enables engineers at all levels to systematically diagnose logon performance issues in a structured, repeatable way
* Develop training materials, recorded sessions, and runbooks covering the full diagnostic toolchain: Logic Monitor, Citrix Director, Power BI (Citrix All, GPO dashboard, scatter plot), Azure Log Analytics, Wireshark, Citrix policies, and GPO auditing
* Create and maintain a library of "lessons learned” specific, documented findings from customer investigations that can be evaluated and applied across the entire install base
* Mentor Systems Engineers, reviewing their diagnostic approaches, providing guidance on complex cases, and building their technical depth over time
* Conduct knowledge-transfer sessions and training surges so that the team's collective expertise grows faster than any individual's

**10 AI-Assisted Analysis & Tooling**

* Lead the team's use of AI for large-scale analysis — including ingesting Citrix configuration exports, GPO data, ServiceNow knowledge articles, and public Citrix best practice documentation to generate actionable insights and surface configuration gaps at scale
* Develop or guide the development of scripts (PowerShell, Python) to automate GPO auditing, data extraction, and comparison across customer environments
* Work with internal tooling teams to refine and productionize AI-based GPO audit capabilities and Citrix policy analysis pipelines
* Able to work on CITRIX Automation – Can use GitHub for CITRIX innovation

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

· 8–12+ years of experience in end-user computing, with 5+ years in Citrix CVAD architecture and engineering.

· Expert knowledge of Citrix CVAD, Citrix DaaS, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, PVS/MCS, Director, and WEM.

· Proven experience delivering major upgrades (CVAD LTSR/CR) and migrations.

· Hands-on experience with UPM and FSLogix, including design, migration, and troubleshooting.

· Strong knowledge of Windows Server/Client, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, PKI, networking, and storage.

· Experience with hypervisors and cloud platforms (VMware vSphere, Hyper-V, Nutanix AHV, Azure, AWS).

· Proficiency in PowerShell scripting and automation.

· AI-enabled Citrix automation: able to use AI tools to build and troubleshoot PowerShell/REST/Terraform automation for Citrix (image builds, deployments, upgrades, health checks), with GitHub for source control, pull request review, and CI/CD workflows (e.g., GitHub Actions) and the main branch as the controlled, reviewed source of truth.

· Demonstrated ability to lead POCs, solution deployments, and cross-functional projects.

· Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

· Citrix certifications (CCP-V, CCE-V, or current Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops certifications).

· Microsoft certifications (Azure, Windows Server, Microsoft 365).

· Experience with ITIL processes, change management, and Agile/hybrid project delivery.

· Experience with Azure Virtual Desktop or VMware Horizon.

**Key Performance Indicators**

· Reduction in critical incidents and mean time to resolve (MTTR).

· On-time, on-budget delivery of upgrade and migration projects with minimal downtime.

· Improved logon times and user experience metrics.

· POC outcomes delivered with clear, actionable recommendations.

· Quality and completeness of architecture documentation and knowledge transfer.

Job Description:

Network (NSX) Engineer — VCF9 Migration (India – Remote)

Job Profile Summary

The Network (NSX) Engineer owns NSX migration and network cutover activities within a VCF9 Migration Factory Delivery Pod — typically the critical path for a wave. This is a specialist role kept thin and dedicated rather than pooled with general Migration Engineers, responsible for NSX-T design validation, cutover sequencing, and cutover risk management across the pod's wave cadence.

Career Level Summary

* Requires in-depth conceptual and practical knowledge in own job discipline and basic knowledge of related job disciplines

* Solves complex problems

* Works independently, receives minimal guidance

* May lead projects or project steps within a broader project or may have accountability for ongoing activities or objectives

* Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience

Critical Competencies

* Excellence: Exceeds expectations by consistently demonstrating accountability, discipline, high performance, and a proven track record of exceptional results.

* Customer-driven: Prioritizes customer needs and satisfaction through collaborative and proactive problem-solving, and an unwavering commitment to customer success.

* Expertise: Possesses deep understanding of customer needs and continually grows and enhances skills to provide customer-focused solutions.

* Agility: Quickly adapts and responds to dynamic customer needs and expectations through innovative solutions.

* Compassion: Cultivates a positive and supportive environment to effectively work together towards a common goal, fostering trust within Rackspace and with external stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

* Owns NSX-T design validation and migration execution, including logical switching, distributed routing, and Tier-0/Tier-1 gateway cutover, for VCF9 migration waves.

* Leads network cutover activities during migration waves — typically the critical path — sequencing cutover windows in coordination with the Senior Migration Engineer and Migration Architect.

* Monitors tickets, responses, and resolutions for network events tied to migration waves; gathers and analyzes bandwidth and NSX flow data.

* Documents scheduled maintenances, network topologies, NSX segment/gateway configurations, and connectivity mappings in the designated tool.

* Opens service requests to vendors for hardware/software problems; works with Service Providers for proper handling of outages, maintenances, or other problems during cutover windows.

* Communicates cutover status and network risk to customers and the Migration Coordinator/PMO via tickets, emails, and calls.

* Ensures NSX and network alerts are detected, acknowledged, and resolved in a timely manner during and after cutover.

* Documents planned and unplanned network events and changes; follows change and escalation processes for unique, complex, or critical network cutover changes and customer outages.

* Validates rollback readiness for network cutover activities in partnership with the QA/Validation Engineer.

* Participates in on-call support per team design, particularly around scheduled wave cutover windows.

Knowledge

* Intermediate to advanced knowledge of VMware NSX-T design, deployment, and migration from NSX-V or legacy network virtualization platforms

* Intermediate to advanced knowledge of the design, configuration, installation, maintenance, administration, and upgrade of NSX-based networking environments

* Intermediate knowledge of TCP/IP, OSI topology, and switching technologies as applied to NSX overlay/underlay networking

* Intermediate knowledge of equipment from multiple vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, and Arista as they interface with NSX underlay networks

Skills

* VMware NSX-T Migration & Cutover

* Network Virtualization Design

* Client/Customer Service

* Network Device Naming Schemes

* Network Service Monitoring Systems

* Process Improvement

* Script Maintenance

* Technical Acumen

* Technical Support

* Technical Writing Skills

Education

* Bachelor's Degree required, preferably in a field related to role.

Certifications

* VMware Certified Professional – Network Virtualization (VCP-NV) required, or obtained within 90 days of hire

* CCNA or CCNP certification preferred

Experience

* 3 – 6 years of experience in the field of role required, including hands-on NSX-T design or migration experience

**Department:**

Permanent - Full Time
  
  
**Location:**

**Description**
We are looking for an On-Site Technical Account Manager (L3) to act as a dedicated Resident Engineer for a major enterprise deployment. Working directly at the customer site, you will serve as the primary technical bridge between local operations, internal engineering teams, and vendor support to ensure high availability and rapid issue resolution.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Investigate and resolve escalated Hazelcast component issues. Lead root-cause analysis for P1, recurring and critical incidents with Hazelcast support, keep stakeholders informed and track permanent corrective actions through closure. When an incident closes, make sure the knowledge base captures the cause, permanent fix and lessons learned.
* Coordinate Hazelcast support cases for product bugs, patches and escalations; promptly notify RBI of critical defects or security vulnerabilities and track remediation and closure status.
* Recommend, configure and validate RBI-approved Hazelcast designs for high availability, resilience, throughput and scalability in line with Hazelcast guidance, working with L2 and developers on complex workflow, connector, integration and performance issues.
* Plan and carry out approved UAT, pre-production and production updates with impact and risk analysis, approved operating procedures, test and rollback plans, execution in approved maintenance windows and post-change validation.
* Advise RBI security teams on Hazelcast hardening; assess releases and patches and maintain upgrade, adoption and infrastructure-lifecycle roadmap recommendations.
* Work with RBI’s performance-monitoring team to establish baselines, diagnose bottlenecks and implement tuning and configuration improvements with measurable before-and-after results.
* Perform capacity planning and sizing and conduct periodic capacity and utilization reviews, including annual audits and corrective recommendations for threshold breaches.
* Maintain senior-level operating procedures and technical documentation; guide L1/L2 teams through knowledge sharing, current industry trends, best practices and thoughtful automation.
* Provide senior oversight for complex or escalated service requests, authorizations, coordination issues and configuration-backup concerns, while the L2 TAM owns routine handling. Help keep the agreed roles and responsibilities (RACI) and escalation matrix current, join remote, OEM and on-call coverage, and contribute to quarterly service-level reporting and RBI certification. The team supports unlimited cases, with response targets of 30 minutes initially and 1 hour ongoing for P1; 1 hour and 2 hours for P2; 4 hours and 8 business hours for P3; and 8 hours and 2 working days for all other cases.

**What You Have**

* Graduate qualification such as BE, BSc, MCA or equivalent; an engineering background is preferred.
* At least 6 years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years designing, implementing and upgrading Hazelcast or the directly relevant OEM product.
* Advanced Hazelcast architecture, configuration, high-availability, resilience and distributed-caching expertise, including security hardening and lifecycle management across UAT, pre-production and production.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex production incidents, P1 root-cause analysis, permanent corrective actions and OEM engineering/support escalations.
* Strong performance-tuning, capacity-planning, sizing, throughput and scalability skills supported by measurable validation.
* Ability to work with RBI stakeholders, developers and L1/L2 teams; communicate recommendations and approved decisions clearly and produce strong operating procedures, configuration records, root-cause analysis reports, roadmaps and knowledge-transfer guidance.
* Be prepared to share degree records, project dates, relevant experience and evidence of your Hazelcast or OEM association so Hazelcast can support RBI’s approval process.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Technology Innovation in Transportation Automation Systems (TITANS) builds software solutions that expand Amazon's supply chain network while reducing the time and cost of network design, planning, and configuration management. We partner with multiple Global Transportation Services (GTS) teams to deliver technology that enables Hands-Off-the-Wheel (HOTW) network configuration management — measuring and improving configuration quality to reduce operational overhead and increase deployment velocity across Fulfillment Centers, Sort Centers, Amazon Air Gateways, and Delivery Stations. a583b255.title: Software Architect (iOS)
a583b255.description:
**Software Architect (iOS) | Ahmedabad, Gujarat | Work from Office**

**Experience:** 7+ years

**Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

**About Vagaro**

Vagaro is a global leader in cloud-based business management software for the salon, spa, beauty, fitness, and wellness industries. Our product-led platform helps businesses manage scheduling, payments, marketing, and operations in one place.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a hands-on iOS Architect to own the architecture, quality, and scalability of the Vagaro Pro and Vagaro customer iOS apps. You will set technical direction for the iOS platform, lead the modernization of a large production codebase, and raise the engineering bar across the mobile team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the iOS app architecture: modularization, layering, state management, navigation, and dependency injection.
* Define and drive the iOS technical roadmap, including the Objective-C to Swift and UIKit to SwiftUI migration.
* Author architecture decision records (ADRs) and design docs; review and approve significant designs and critical PRs.
* Design API contracts with backend teams covering REST, pagination, error handling, offline sync, and versioning.
* Set and enforce targets for crash-free users, hangs, launch time, app size, and memory usage.
* Lead root-cause analysis for production crashes and incidents, and drive fixes to closure.
* Define the iOS testing strategy (unit, UI, snapshot, integration) and automation coverage gates per release.
* Own app security: Keychain usage, certificate pinning, token handling, and OWASP MASVS alignment.
* Improve CI/CD, Xcode build performance, the release train, phased releases, and feature flag usage.
* Mentor iOS engineers, run architecture reviews, and take part in technical hiring.

**Required Skills**

* 7+ years of software engineering, including 5+ years building native iOS apps shipped at scale.
* 2+ years in an architect, tech lead, or principal role owning architecture decisions.
* Expert in Swift, with strong working knowledge of Objective-C for legacy code and hands-on SwiftUI and UIKit interop.
* Strong in Swift Concurrency (async/await, actors) and Combine, with a solid grasp of GCD and the app lifecycle.
* Expert in MVVM, Clean Architecture, the Coordinator pattern, and modular project structure using Swift Package Manager.
* Experience with Core Data or SwiftData, Keychain, URLSession, Codable, and protocol-based dependency injection.
* Proficient with Xcode build settings, schemes, code signing, provisioning, and CocoaPods/SPM dependency management.
* Testing with XCTest, XCUITest, and snapshot testing; performance work using Instruments, MetricKit, and launch-time and memory optimization.
* Experience with Firebase Crashlytics, APNs, and App Store Connect (TestFlight, phased release, review guidelines).
* Mobile CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps and Fastlane.
* Clear written communication for design docs, ADRs, and RCA reports.

**Good to Have**

* Working knowledge of Android or Kotlin Multiplatform.
* Experience with WKWebView/React screens embedded in native apps and bridge design.
* Mobile payments or POS experience (card readers, Tap to Pay on iPhone, PCI considerations).
* Accessibility (VoiceOver, WCAG) and localization at scale.
* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS products.

**Why Join Us**

* 5-day work week with a flexible schedule
* 15 paid leaves + 11 holidays, with leave encashment
* Comprehensive family medical insurance and maternity benefits
* Annual bonus and recognition programs
* Learning resources, tech sessions, gaming zones, Fun Fridays, and cultural events

Shape the architecture and direction of a product used at scale. If you want ownership, influence, and room to grow, apply now and let's build something great together.

cb65035c.title: Refrigeration Engineer/Program Manager, Global Energy Sustainability & Automation (GESA)
cb65035c.description:
**Description**
Amazon's Operations Global Engineering Materials & Sustainability (Ops GEMS) organisation sets the strategy, technical standards, and programme delivery that keep Amazon's operational estate safe, energy-efficient, and sustainable — spanning fulfilment centres, delivery stations, grocery, and fresh-food facilities worldwide.
  
  
Within Ops GEMS, the Global Energy, Sustainability & Automation (GESA) team provides hands-on technical leadership for Amazon's global portfolio of building management systems (BMS), energy platforms, and refrigeration systems — driving safety, reliability, and energy reduction through deep engineering expertise combined with enterprise SCADA, monitoring, and analytics platforms. We are a small, high-impact team that partners closely with RME, D&C, and operational stakeholders across all regions.
  
  
Purpose of the Role - We are seeking an Refrigeration Engineer to take ownership of the refrigeration estate supporting Amazon's food delivery network across the Middle East and India. This is an agile role spanning varied projects — system optimisation, automation rollouts, failure investigations, and energy-reduction initiatives — with safety, reliability, and reducing energy consumption as the common thread. You will combine deep refrigeration knowledge with strong aptitude for automation, enterprise SCADA, and performance data analytics, working closely with the European refrigeration team (Barcelona) and Global BMS Technical Services. The ability to context-switch and deliver across concurrent workstreams is essential.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Champion safety as the overriding priority across all refrigeration activities, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, Amazon safety policies, and food safety standards.
* Drive reliability programmes that reduce unplanned downtime, extend asset life, and minimise risk across the portfolio.
* Lead energy-reduction initiatives — identify consumption hotspots, establish measurable baselines, and implement control strategies that deliver sustained efficiency gains.
* Support the deployment and optimisation of enterprise SCADA platforms for refrigeration monitoring across the Middle East and India estate, working controller-agnostic across diverse technology stacks.
* Manage alarm rationalisation and tuning to reduce noise and surface genuine events that threaten safety or reliability.
* Analyse performance data from SCADA historians and monitoring platforms to identify trends, anomalies, and optimisation opportunities. Generate reports and actionable insights for stakeholders.
* Identify technical improvement and energy-efficiency opportunities across the regional refrigeration estate; evaluate emerging technologies and conduct feasibility studies.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to RME and Maintenance Operation Centres, providing specialist guidance beyond routine troubleshooting through the established escalation model.
* Support D&C projects with operational best practices, lessons learned, and alignment with regional legislation and design standards.
* Develop and deliver training material and contribute to a shared knowledge base covering fault modes, diagnostics, legislation, and spare parts management.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience gathering and analyzing large amounts of data and delivering continuous business improvements
* Experience working effectively across cross-functional teams and partner well with people at all levels within an organization, including coaching of junior staff
* Experience as a strong leader who can prioritize well, communicate clearly and effectively influence across cross-functional teams
* 5+ years of refrigeration industry experience
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Refrigeration Engineering, HVAC/R Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline. Alternatively, a recognised advanced apprenticeship or Higher National Diploma (HND) in Refrigeration / Air Conditioning with substantial demonstrable industry experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of managing food safety and quality in a large-scale retail or manufacturing environment experience
* 4+ years of commercial CO2 refrigeration applications experience, or experience in Amazon RME (Reliability, Maintenance, and Engineering), fulfillment operations, or automation deployment environments
* Familiarity with multiple refrigeration controller platforms (e.g., Danfoss, Carel, Emerson/Dixell) and enterprise SCADA packages, with a controller-agnostic mindset.
* Experience with cloud-based data analytics, IoT platforms, or predictive maintenance tools applied to refrigeration or HVAC/R systems.

cd1cc537.title: Technical Account Manager (Pre-Sales & Client Success)
cd1cc537.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Account Manager (Pre-Sales & Client Success) based in India.**
We are looking for an experienced Technical Account Manager to take ownership of the complete client journey, from initial discovery and solution design to deal closure and successful project delivery. In this techno-commercial role, you will combine technical expertise, consultative sales, and relationship management to understand client needs and translate them into tailored software solutions. You will collaborate with internal developers, architects, and sales teams to prepare proposals, define project scopes, estimate resources, and negotiate commercial agreements. Acting as the primary point of contact throughout the development lifecycle, you will ensure alignment between client expectations and technical execution. You will also identify opportunities to expand existing accounts, generate recurring revenue, and build long-term client partnerships. This is an excellent opportunity to influence business growth while working on diverse software development projects in a collaborative, fully remote environment.
  
  
**Accountabilities**
  
  

* Client Discovery and Requirements Gathering:

+ Lead discovery calls with prospective clients to understand their business objectives, challenges, technical requirements, and expectations.
+ Ask relevant questions to establish project scope, budget, timelines, constraints, and measurable success criteria.
+ Translate business needs into clear and structured documentation, including Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), user stories, feature lists, and project scope documents.

* Technical Solution Design and Proposals:

+ Collaborate with internal technical leads and software architects to design appropriate solutions, define technology stacks, establish high-level architecture, and identify required modules and integrations.
+ Prepare accurate effort estimates, project timelines, delivery milestones, and pricing structures, including fixed-price, time-and-materials (T&M), and dedicated-team models.
+ Develop compelling business proposals, Statements of Work (SOWs), Request for Proposal (RFP) responses, and presentation materials.
+ Present proposed solutions to client stakeholders, explaining technical approaches, business value, project scope, and delivery expectations.
+ Develop wireframes and clickable prototypes when necessary to communicate proposed features and user experiences.

* Sales and Deal Closure:

+ Own opportunities from the initial client conversation through proposal presentation, commercial negotiations, and signed contract.
+ Work closely with the sales team to progress opportunities, address client objections, negotiate pricing and contractual terms, and successfully close deals.
+ Maintain accurate sales pipeline information and deal records within the CRM, ensuring reliable revenue forecasting and opportunity tracking.

* Project Delivery and Client Success:

+ Coordinate project handovers to development teams, ensuring clear communication of requirements, priorities, deliverables, and acceptance criteria.
+ Serve as the primary client contact throughout the development lifecycle, maintaining strong communication and alignment between clients and internal delivery teams.
+ Organize client meetings around project milestones, demonstrations, and agreed delivery checkpoints.
+ Manage scope changes, change requests, client expectations, and potential delivery risks, escalating issues proactively when necessary.
+ Monitor project progress to ensure deliverables meet agreed requirements, quality standards, and timelines through final client approval.

* Account Growth and Relationship Management:

+ Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling additional services, including new software modules, maintenance and support, cloud solutions, quality assurance, and dedicated development teams.
+ Develop trusted, long-term client relationships that encourage repeat business, referrals, and positive testimonials.

38e367ae.title: Kinaxis Solution Architect
38e367ae.description:
Kinaxis Solution Architect Job Description

Location : Bangalore/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Gurgaon/Hyderabad

Role Overview

The Kinaxis Solution Architect will be responsible for designing and architecting end-to-end supply chain planning solutions using Kinaxis Maestro (formerly Rapid Response). The role requires strong hands-on Kinaxis expertise combined with solution architecture, supply chain domain knowledge, integration design, and stakeholder management.

The Solution Architect will work closely with business stakeholders, functional consultants, technical teams, and enterprise architects to translate complex supply chain requirements into scalable Kinaxis solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead end-to-end solution architecture and design for Kinaxis Maestro implementations and transformation programs.
* Understand business requirements and translate them into scalable Kinaxis solution designs.
* Architect solutions across Demand Planning, Supply Planning, S&OP/IBP, Inventory Planning, and related supply chain processes.
* Define Kinaxis configuration, data models, workbooks, worksheets, dashboards, alerts, and planning logic.
* Provide technical and functional leadership for Kinaxis Maestro Authoring and configuration.
* Design integration architecture between Kinaxis and enterprise applications such as SAP, Oracle, and other ERP/data platforms.
* Define data flows, integration requirements, interfaces, and data transformation strategies.
* Lead solution design workshops and provide recommendations on Kinaxis best practices.
* Review configurations and solution designs developed by implementation teams and ensure adherence to architectural standards.
* Support testing, defect resolution, performance optimization, deployment, and go-live activities.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to Kinaxis consultants and development teams.
* Work with business and IT leadership to resolve complex supply chain and solution design challenges.
* Develop and maintain architecture documents, solution designs, integration specifications, and implementation best practices.

Required Skills & Experience

* 10+ years of overall experience in Supply Chain Planning, IT solutions, or enterprise applications.
* Minimum 5+ years of strong hands-on experience with **Kinaxis Maestro/RapidResponse**, preferably including Maestro Authoring.
* Proven experience as a **Kinaxis Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Lead Consultant, or equivalent**.
* Strong experience in Kinaxis configuration, solution design, and implementation.
* Strong functional understanding of **Demand Planning, Supply Planning, S&OP/IBP, and Inventory Planning**.
* Experience designing end-to-end Kinaxis solutions for complex enterprise supply chain environments.
* Strong understanding of data models and integration between Kinaxis and ERP systems such as **SAP and Oracle**.
* Ability to lead architecture/design discussions with senior business and technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.

91fe9e70.description:
**Application Deadline:**
31 December 2026

**Department:**
61-870 - Technology - Architecture

**Location:**
India - Hyderabad

**Description**
As a Solution Architect, you will lead the architecture and solution design of large-scale technology initiatives spanning multiple systems across the OTT platform ecosystem.
  
  
You will be responsible for translating business and product requirements into scalable, secure, resilient and maintainable technical solutions that align with the organization's strategic objectives.
  
  
Our culture is highly delivery-focused, and the role extends well beyond producing architecture diagrams and design documentation.
  
  
You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Programme Management, Operations and external partners throughout the delivery lifecycle, providing hands-on architectural guidance, resolving technical challenges, managing design trade-offs and ensuring successful implementation of solutions through to production release.
  
  
  
**What you'll be doing:**

* **Solution Architecture:**
  Lead the architecture and solution design of strategic initiatives across the OTT platform ecosystem, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technology strategy.
* **Architectural Evolution:**
  Drive architectural evolution by assessing existing systems, identifying improvement opportunities and challenging established assumptions and technical constraints, including the pragmatic application of AI-enabled tools and capabilities where they deliver measurable value.
* **End-to-End Delivery:**
  Own solution delivery from concept through implementation, providing technical leadership, resolving complex challenges and ensuring successful outcomes.
* **Scalable Solution Design:**
  Design scalable, secure, resilient and maintainable solutions, defining both functional and non-functional requirements and producing key architectural artefacts, including requirements for responsible AI use, data privacy, security, observability and governance where AI capabilities are involved.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:**
  Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Delivery and Business stakeholders to ensure solutions adhere to architectural principles, standards and best practices.
* **Architecture Reviews:**
  Conduct architecture reviews, identify and mitigate technical risks, dependencies and gaps, and drive continuous quality improvement.
* **Engineering Guidance:**
  Support engineering teams throughout delivery with architectural guidance, governance and decision-making for complex technical issues. Promote effective and responsible use of AI-assisted engineering and delivery practices.
* **Technology Innovation:**
  Evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends, OTT best practices and relevant AI capabilities to enhance platform capabilities, engineering efficiency and long-term architectural sustainability.

**What you'll bring:**

* 6+ years' experience as a Solution Architect or similar role, designing and delivering large-scale technology solutions in complex environments.
* Deep understanding of OTT platform architectures and domains, including subscriptions, monetisation, identity and access management (IAM), content and metadata management, and related platform services.
* Proven experience designing and delivering scalable, distributed systems using
  **Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture (EDA)**
  principles.
* Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures and services, preferably
  **AWS**
  .
* Strong solution design expertise, including integration and management of third-party vendor solutions and in-house platforms.
* **AI fluency:**
  Practical understanding of Generative AI, Machine Learning and AI-enabled platform capabilities.
* Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve architecture, analysis, documentation, engineering productivity and problem-solving, while validating outputs and retaining appropriate technical judgement.
* Ability to assess AI use cases, dependencies, risks and non-functional requirements.
* Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle, with hands-on experience in technologies such as
  **Node.js, Java, Python or Go**
  , and strong knowledge of database technologies.
* Proven ability to solve complex business and technology challenges, navigate ambiguity and drive effective technical outcomes.
* Experience analysing and optimising business processes, operating models and technology landscapes.
* Strong documentation skills and experience applying industry-standard architecture and design methodologies.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions and communicate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

ad00acc5.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
ad00acc5.description:
**Description**
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won’t fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer’s growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**What You’ll Actually Be Doing**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client’s current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team’s use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation & ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**You’re Our Person If...**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

**Job Description**
Specialist, Software, Cloud Engineering
  
  
**The Opportunity**

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our companys’ IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. The individual collaborates across product, engineering, validation, and business teams to drive solution delivery, manage vendor relationships, develop technical documentation, and support system implementations in AWS and on-premises environments. The role also contributes to DevOps automation, cloud infrastructure, test automation, and application lifecycle management while ensuring adherence to GxP, SDLC, and organizational compliance requirements.

* Vendor and Partner Engagement\*\*

* Automate configuration management and provisioning with Ansible playbooks and roles.
* Implement guardrails such as branch protection, code review workflows, quality gates, and rollback strategies.
* Collaborate with platform teams on deployment standards, secrets management, and approvals.
* Custom Development and Integrations\*\*
* Design, build, test, and document custom scripts and components using Python and JavaScript.
* Integrate upstream and downstream applications using REST APIs.
* Test Automation and Quality Engineering\*\*
* Define test strategies across unit, integration, API, UI, and end-to-end testing.
* Collaborate with testing teams or build and maintain automated test suites using Robot Framework and Tosca.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, including reporting and quality gates.

Develop documentation and artifacts required by policies, including
  
  

* Security assessments
* AI assessments, where applicable
* Architecture documents
* GxP SDLC documents
* Application administration SOPs
* Support models, structures, and SLAs

**What You Should Have**

* Education and Experience\*\*
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; a master’s degree is a plus.
* 3+ years of experience in a Technical Analyst or Systems Analyst role in a technology-driven environment.
* Core Skills\*\*
* Mission-driven mindset, with the ability to connect project work to company goals and customer outcomes.
* Self-directed and organized, with the ability to prioritize work, remove blockers, and deliver with minimal supervision.

* Cloud Engineering and DevOps\*\*
* Experience with AWS services used in delivery and operations, such as IAM, VPC, EC2/EKS, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, and Secrets Manager.

* Vendor and Partner Engagement\*\*
* Experience working with third-party vendors and partners on technical discovery, integration design, prerequisites, and go-live readiness.
* Ability to translate vendor documentation into internal requirements, playbooks, and runbooks.
* Development and Testing\*\*

* JavaScript scripting experience.
* Experience building API endpoints.

* Tosca experience with model-based test design, execution, and dashboards.

\*\*Regulated Environment Experience\*\*
  
  

* Experience delivering and validating applications under GLP and/or GCP.

7b3de394.title: Cloud, Engineer - Linux and Automation
7b3de394.description:
*In Time Tec is an award-winning IT & software company. In Time Tec offers progressive software development services, enabling its clients to keep their brightest and most valuable talent focused on innovation. In Time Tec has a leadership team averaging 15 years in software/firmware R&D, and 20 years building onshore/offshore R&D teams. We are looking for rare talent to join us. People having a positive mindset and great organizational skills will be drawn to the position. Your capacity to take initiative and solve problems as they emerge, flexibility, and honesty, will be key factors for your success at In Time Tec.*  
  
Position Overview

The Cloud, Engineer - Linux and Automation is an infrastructure engineering role responsible for the administration, automation, and continuous improvement of Thrive's Linux-based and virtualized infrastructure. The role owns the build-out of Thrive's Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practice from the existing Ansible and Terraform framework, establishing the standards, reusable code, and workflows the team uses to provision and manage infrastructure. The engineer also works hands-on with the VMware vSphere and HPE Morpheus Enterprise HVM (KVM-based) virtualization hosts that make up Thrive's private cloud, serves as a Tier 2 escalation point for infrastructure issues, and partners with senior engineers and architects to design and implement repeatable, code-driven solutions while keeping Linux systems secure, patched, and operating within established SLAs. The ideal candidate comes from a systems administration or infrastructure engineering background and brings hands-on virtualization and IaC experience at scale, strong Linux troubleshooting skills, and an automation-first, security-first mindset focused on operational excellence and avoiding unplanned downtime. This position focuses on infrastructure operations, not application or full stack software development.

Responsibilities

Administer, monitor, and troubleshoot Linux systems (primarily Ubuntu and RHEL) across physical and virtual environments, including routine health checks, capacity reviews, and performance tuning.

Build, configure, patch, and maintain VMware ESXi and KVM-based (HPE Morpheus Enterprise HVM) virtualization hosts and clusters alongside the team, including host networking, shared storage connectivity, and hypervisor-level troubleshooting.

Manage virtual machine workloads across VMware vCenter and HPE Morpheus Enterprise, including provisioning, template management, and lifecycle management.

Lead the maturation of the team's IaC practice from the existing Ansible and Terraform framework, including repository structure, coding standards, reusable roles and modules, version control and peer review, and team onboarding.

Develop and maintain Ansible playbooks for configuration management, OS patching, application deployment, and compliance enforcement, along with Terraform configurations for provisioning and lifecycle management of virtual infrastructure across VMware and Morpheus/KVM.

Maintain NetBox as the authoritative source of truth for IPAM, DCIM asset records, and network topology, and integrate it with Ansible to automate routine physical equipment commissioning.

Serve as a Tier 2 escalation point for infrastructure incidents, performing root cause analysis and remediation with the networking, security, and cloud teams, and participate in the on-call rotation.

Follow change management processes, ensuring all changes are documented, reviewed, and approved in alignment with Thrive's ITSM standards.

Define and enforce standardized build documentation, and maintain runbooks, technical documentation, and knowledge base articles.

Requirements

3–5+ years of hands-on Linux system administration experience, with strong proficiency in Ubuntu, including systemd, networking, storage management, and security hardening

3+ years of hands-on VMware vSphere administration, including ESXi host installation, configuration, and patching; vCenter; clusters (HA/DRS); virtual networking (vSwitch/vDS); and datastore management

Hands-on experience administering KVM-based virtualization hosts (QEMU/KVM, libvirt/virsh, Linux bridging, storage pools) on platforms such as HPE Morpheus Enterprise HVM, Proxmox VE, or similar

2+ years of experience using Infrastructure as Code to provision and configure servers, hypervisors, and networking with Ansible (roles, playbooks, inventories) and Terraform (state management, CI/CD plan/apply workflows), along with automation scripting and Git-based version control (GitLab or GitHub)

Solid understanding of networking (TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewall rules) and shared storage (iSCSI, NFS, Fibre Channel, multipathing) in virtualized and cloud environments

Experience in datacenter or colocation environments, including racking, cabling, and in-cabinet power management

Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex system and infrastructure issues independently and under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a diverse workload

Strong documentation and communication skills, including producing accurate, maintainable runbooks, topology diagrams, and change records, and explaining technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders

Collaborative, automation-first mindset, with the ability to work effectively with peers and cross-functional teams and a drive to improve processes

Knowledge of ITIL and ITSM best practices

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with HPE Morpheus Enterprise for VM provisioning, template management, and self-service automation

Working knowledge of NetBox and its API for IPAM, DCIM, and network source-of-truth management

Linux Professional Institute Certification (LPIC-1/LPIC-2) or Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA)

Red Hat Enterprise Linux Automation with Ansible (RH294) or higher

HashiCorp Terraform Associate (003 or 004)

VMware Certified Professional – Data Center Virtualization (VCP-DCV)

Additional Information

Work Schedule: Standard business hours, with participation in an on-call rotation.

Work Location: Remote eligible.

Travel: Occasional travel for datacenter activities may be required (less than 10%).

Background Check: The selected candidate will be subject to criminal and credit background investigations and must meet eligibility requirements for access to restricted information, including the ability to pass CJIS clearance for the state of Florida, which requires U.S. residency.  
  
***How You’ll Grow at In Time Tec-***

* *In Time Tec, has made significant investments to create a stimulating environment for its people to grow. We want each of our employees to grow in their way and play their roles while honing their ownership abilities. As part of those efforts, we provide our professionals with a range of educational opportunities to help them grow in their career.*  
    
  *Our guiding principles of leadership, trust, transparency, and integrity serve as the foundation for everything we do and every success we achieve. We are proud of these fundamental principles since they demonstrate our dedication towards them as a “One Team”.*
* *We value every individual by giving them the freedom to make daily decisions that can support their health, well-being, confidence, and awareness. Our leadership team is there to offer the safe base by giving the right budding environment, instruction, tools, and chances necessary for your professional development in achieving your goals.*

*Our people and culture work together in a collaborative environment, making In Time Tec a thriving place to work. You can find out more about**Life at In Time Tec**here.*

Evaluate risk classifications, architectural implications, rollback plans, and monitoring strategies, approving changes, requesting revisions, or escalating concerns when necessary.
* Change Implementation and Validation: Oversee change execution, post-implementation monitoring, and validation activities. Ensure all production changes meet mandatory application and technical validation requirements, supported by documented evidence and predefined pass/fail criteria.
* Post-Change Monitoring and Closure: Lead the Hosting Response Bridge (HRB) during post-change stability windows, ensuring continuous monitoring and immediate escalation when anomalies arise. Enforce alert-suppression procedures, verify pre-change baselines and post-change comparisons, and authorize final change closure only when all validation requirements are satisfied.
* Rollback and Risk Management: Establish and document clear rollback triggers during TRB reviews, including maximum decision timelines. Exercise rollback authority when predefined conditions are met, escalating exceptions to the relevant Tower Leader and ensuring appropriate risk mitigation.
* Shift Handover and Operational Continuity: Ensure unresolved change activities and operational issues are accurately documented and transferred between shifts, with clear ownership and follow-up responsibilities to prevent missed actions or delayed closures.
* Operational Leadership and Incident Management: Oversee early detection, escalation, and resolution of major incidents and critical issues during assigned shifts. Ensure client requests, incidents, and problems are addressed promptly and professionally while maintaining high service quality.
* Team Coordination and Resource Management: Lead daily team stand-ups, coordinate shift handovers, manage client status updates, and allocate resources effectively across teams to support timely incident resolution and operational continuity.
* Client Communication and Escalation: Support Shift Site Reliability Engineers with client communications and escalations, ensuring transparent updates and professional management of critical service situations.
* Performance and KPI Management: Drive operational performance through agreed KPIs covering alerts, monitoring tools, incident management, and ServiceNow (SNOW) case metrics. Monitor service delivery effectiveness and implement corrective actions where required.
* People Management and Development: Provide detailed performance feedback, supervise employee attendance and participation, and motivate team members working rotating shifts. Collaborate with Tower Managers on employee development, training, performance assessments, and operational best practices.
* Reporting and Governance Metrics: Prepare monthly reports covering peer-review SLA breaches, TRB gate-hold and rework rates, closure refusals, change success rates, change-related incidents over 24-hour and 7-day periods, rollback invocation and success rates, and process exceptions by tower. Also report operational case, ServiceNow, and alerting KPIs.
* Continuous Improvement: Monitor change management effectiveness, identify recurring operational challenges, and implement improvements to governance processes and service delivery standards. Provide bi-weekly reporting through the change management control dashboard and drive consistently successful change outcomes.

**Requirements**

* Professional Experience: Significant experience in IT service delivery management, cloud operations, infrastructure management, or a related technical operations leadership role.
* Service Delivery Leadership: Proven ability to lead distributed or rotational teams responsible for supporting multiple clients and delivering mission-critical services in a 24/7 operational environment.
* Change Management Expertise: Strong understanding of enterprise change management governance, including change assessment, risk classification, approval processes, implementation oversight, validation, rollback planning, and closure controls.
* Technical Review and Governance: Experience leading technical review boards or comparable governance forums, evaluating architectural impacts, implementation risks, monitoring requirements, and rollback strategies.
* Incident and Problem Management: Demonstrated expertise in major incident management, critical issue resolution, escalation handling, service restoration, and operational continuity.
* Cloud and Infrastructure Operations: Solid understanding of cloud operations, infrastructure services, monitoring environments, and service reliability practices.
* ITSM and Monitoring Tools: Familiarity with ServiceNow (SNOW), incident management platforms, alerting systems, monitoring tools, and operational performance dashboards.
* Process and Performance Management: Experience defining, monitoring, and reporting operational KPIs, SLA compliance, change success rates, incident trends, and service delivery performance.
* People Management: Strong leadership and team management capabilities, including performance reviews, employee engagement, shift supervision, coaching, and resource allocation.
* Communication and Stakeholder Management: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to coordinate across technical teams, tower leaders, duty managers, and client stakeholders.
* Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Strong attention to detail and the ability to assess operational risks, investigate anomalies, make timely decisions, and implement effective corrective measures.
* Adaptability and Accountability: Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, client-focused environment, manage rotating shift operations, and take ownership of critical operational decisions.
* Continuous Improvement Mindset: Demonstrated commitment to strengthening governance frameworks, improving operational processes, and maintaining high standards of service reliability and customer satisfaction.

**Benefits**

* Remote Working Opportunity: Remote work arrangement within India, with the role associated with the Pune-Baroda location.
* Full-time Employment: Opportunity to take on a senior operational leadership position within an established healthcare technology environment.
* Leadership and Ownership: Significant responsibility for enterprise-wide change management governance and service delivery operations.
* Client Exposure: Opportunity to oversee services supporting more than 100 clients and contribute to the reliability of mission-critical healthcare technology systems.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with technical specialists, duty managers, Tower Leaders, and operational teams across multiple service delivery functions.
* Professional Development: Opportunities to strengthen expertise in cloud operations, IT service management, change governance, incident management, and service reliability.
* Strategic Impact: Direct influence on operational performance, risk management, service quality, and continuous improvement initiatives.

3d908b86.title: Expert Service Delivery Manager
3d908b86.description:
**Overview:** The Service Delivery Manager is a senior operations position providing leadership for rotational team and collaborate with duty managers supporting 100+ clients on a rotating shift pattern, responsible for the efficient and professional execution of activities associated with providing an exceptional level of hospitality for clients' mission-critical systems. The Service Delivery Manager also serves as the accountable owner of Change Management governance for the entire business unit under the Altera Cloud Operations Change Management Process (v2.1) — chairing the Technical Review Board (TRB), overseeing implementation and validation, and holding final closure authority across all towers and shifts.

**Change Implementation, Validation & Closure**
===============================================

* Facilitate TRB meeting for change reviews across cloud BU.

* Staff and lead the Hosting Response Bridge (HRB), providing 24x7 monitoring across the post-change stability window; trigger swarms the moment an anomaly is detected.

* Enforce alert-suppression discipline and confirm pre-change baseline capture and post-change comparison before closure.

* Oversee validation against Validation Test Library pass/fail criteria and evidence — including mandatory application and technical validation for production changes.

* Hold final closure authority: confirm the 24-hour or TRB approved closure window with HRB observation if the change was clean and evidence is complete before authorizing closure; refuse closure otherwise.

* Invoke rollback directly against a pre-agreed trigger without further approval; escalate exceptions to the Tower Leader.

* Carry open items into shift handover with clear owners so closure is never missed across a shift boundary.

**Operational Leadership & Incident Management**
================================================

* Major incident / critical issue early detection and fast remediation for all matters during their shift.

* Ensure all client requests, incidents, and problems are addressed in a timely and professional manner.

* Run stand-up calls with their team, managing proper hand-over of activities and client status between shifts and teams.

* Allocate resources as necessary across teams to provide efficient, effective resolution of issues.

* Identify and implement operational process improvements across teams.

* Assist Shift Site Reliability Engineers with client communication and escalations.

* Drive results through agreed KPIs for alerts, monitoring tools, and case/ServiceNow (SNOW) metrics.

**TRB Ownership & Change Process Governance**
=============================================

* Chair the Technical Review Board: the final gate reviewing risk classification, architectural impact, rollback adequacy, and monitoring plan for every change; approve, send back for rework, or escalate.

* Pre-agree and record rollback triggers at TRB, each with a maximum time-to-decide.

* Own and continuously improve the end-to-end process, intake template, and Validation Test Library across all towers.

* Track and report TRB gate-hold and rework rates monthly; a near-zero rework rate signals the board is a formality, not a control.

**People Management**
=====================

* Provide detailed and accurate job performance feedback for each resource working under their guidance.

* Supervise employee attendance and participation.

* Inspire and motivate employees on their rotating shift.

**Reporting Relationships**
===========================

The Service Delivery Manager has primary responsibility for the rating and review of each employee dedicated to rotating with them, with input from the Tower Manager. The Tower Manager is accountable for best practices, effective training/testing, and the overall architecture and direction of their service delivery tower, and provides functional direction and input into employee ratings. Employees have a hard-line reporting relationship into their Tower Manager, with a dotted line to the Service Delivery Manager.

**Metrics Ownership**
=====================

* Report monthly: peer-review SLA breaches, TRB gate-hold/rework rates, closure refusals, change success and change-caused incident rates (24-hr/7-day), rollback invocation/success rate, and process exceptions by tower, alongside case/SNOW and alerting KPIs.

* Success rate for changes driven thought TRB , all changes should be successful.

* Bi-weekly reporting of change management team control deck.

24935273.title: Architect
24935273.description:
**Role Summary**

The Citrix Architect is the technical authority for the organization's Citrix virtualization platform. This role investigates complex, high-severity issues, leads upgrade and migration projects (CVAD and Citrix DaaS), drives the Citrix Profile Management (UPM) vs FSLogix strategy, and evaluates and proves out new solutions through POCs before leading their production deployment.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**

**1. Architecture and Design**

· Design, document, and maintain the end-to-end Citrix architecture (CVAD on-prem, Citrix DaaS, hybrid, and multi-site/DR designs).

· Produce high-level and low-level designs (HLD/LLD), reference architectures, standards, and build guides.

· Define capacity planning, sizing, scalability, and high-availability strategies for Delivery Controllers, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, Cloud Connectors, and VDA workloads.

· Design secure remote access using NetScaler Gateway/ADC, including authentication (SAML, MFA, Entra ID), aligned with Zero Trust principles.

· Ensure the architecture aligns with security, compliance, and enterprise standards.

**2. Complex Issue Investigation and Escalation**

· Serve as the Tier 3 / final technical escalation point for complex, high-impact Citrix incidents.

· Perform deep-dive root cause analysis (RCA) on slow logons, session launch failures, black screens, session reliability/reconnects, HDX/graphics performance, VDA registration failures, and profile issues.

· Use tools such as CDF Control, Citrix Director, WEM analytics, Wireshark, ProcMon, Event Logs, and Citrix Scout to diagnose problems.

· Engage Citrix Support and vendors (Microsoft, hypervisor, storage, network) and drive cases to resolution.

· Document RCA findings, implement permanent fixes, and create knowledge base articles and runbooks.

**3. Upgrade and Project Delivery**

· Lead end-to-end delivery of CVAD upgrades (LTSR/CR): assessment, prerequisites, test plan, pilot, cutover, and rollback planning.

· Lead Citrix DaaS migration, upgrade, or onboarding projects, including Cloud Connector deployment and hybrid/cloud transition.

· Upgrade related components: StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, Licensing Server, Director, WEM, PVS/MCS, and VDA/master images.

· Develop project plans, timelines, risk registers, and communication plans; coordinate with Project Managers, infrastructure, security, and application teams.

· Ensure minimal downtime and sound change management (CAB, change records, post-implementation reviews).

**4. Profile Management Strategy (UPM vs FSLogix)**

· Evaluate Citrix Profile Management (UPM) vs Microsoft FSLogix on logon performance, scalability, storage impact, resilience, Office/OneDrive/Teams support, and supportability.

· Design the profile architecture: storage (SMB, NetApp, Azure Files), Cloud Cache vs VHD(X) locations, redirection, and exclusions.

· Lead profile migration projects, including pilot, tuning, and user acceptance testing.

· Define best practices for profile size, antivirus exclusions, and monitoring.

**5. New Solution Deployment and POC**

· Lead POCs and pilots for new technologies (e.g., Citrix DaaS, WEM, App Layering, Citrix Analytics, cloud-hosted VDAs, GPU/HDX 3D Pro, Windows 11 multi-session, Citrix Secure Private Access).

· Define success criteria, test cases, and measurable outcomes; present findings with clear recommendations, cost, and risk analysis.

· Lead production rollout of approved solutions through design, build, testing, and handover to operations.

· Evaluate alternatives (e.g., Azure Virtual Desktop, VMware Horizon) and provide objective comparisons when required.

**6. Operations, Automation, and Optimization**

· Optimize logon times, session performance, user experience, and resource utilization.

· Automate deployment, image management, and configuration using PowerShell, REST APIs, Terraform/Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines.

· Define monitoring and alerting strategy (Director, ControlUp, Splunk, SCOM, Azure Monitor, etc.).

· Perform regular health checks, patching strategy reviews, and lifecycle/EOL planning.

· Maintain golden image standards and application delivery/packaging strategy (MSIX, App-V, App Layering).

**7. Governance, Security, and Compliance**

· Define and enforce Citrix security baselines, hardening standards, and certificate management.

· Support audits and vulnerability remediation (NetScaler/ADC patching, Citrix security bulletins).

· Maintain architecture documentation and DR/BCP plans, and test DR failovers.

**8. Leadership and Collaboration**

· Provide technical leadership and mentorship to Citrix engineers and support teams.

· Act as the primary technical liaison with Citrix, Microsoft, and other vendors.

· Communicate technical concepts clearly to stakeholders, management, and non-technical audiences.

· Contribute to roadmap planning, budget inputs, and vendor/licensing strategy.

**9 Methodology Development & Knowledge Transfer**

* Design and continuously refine the team's diagnostic playbook — a step-by-step, tool-by-tool guide that enables engineers at all levels to systematically diagnose logon performance issues in a structured, repeatable way
* Develop training materials, recorded sessions, and runbooks covering the full diagnostic toolchain: Logic Monitor, Citrix Director, Power BI (Citrix All, GPO dashboard, scatter plot), Azure Log Analytics, Wireshark, Citrix policies, and GPO auditing
* Create and maintain a library of "lessons learned” specific, documented findings from customer investigations that can be evaluated and applied across the entire install base
* Mentor Systems Engineers, reviewing their diagnostic approaches, providing guidance on complex cases, and building their technical depth over time
* Conduct knowledge-transfer sessions and training surges so that the team's collective expertise grows faster than any individual's

**10 AI-Assisted Analysis & Tooling**

* Lead the team's use of AI for large-scale analysis — including ingesting Citrix configuration exports, GPO data, ServiceNow knowledge articles, and public Citrix best practice documentation to generate actionable insights and surface configuration gaps at scale
* Develop or guide the development of scripts (PowerShell, Python) to automate GPO auditing, data extraction, and comparison across customer environments
* Work with internal tooling teams to refine and productionize AI-based GPO audit capabilities and Citrix policy analysis pipelines
* Able to work on CITRIX Automation – Can use GitHub for CITRIX innovation

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

· 8–12+ years of experience in end-user computing, with 5+ years in Citrix CVAD architecture and engineering.

· Expert knowledge of Citrix CVAD, Citrix DaaS, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, PVS/MCS, Director, and WEM.

· Proven experience delivering major upgrades (CVAD LTSR/CR) and migrations.

· Hands-on experience with UPM and FSLogix, including design, migration, and troubleshooting.

· Strong knowledge of Windows Server/Client, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, PKI, networking, and storage.

· Experience with hypervisors and cloud platforms (VMware vSphere, Hyper-V, Nutanix AHV, Azure, AWS).

· Proficiency in PowerShell scripting and automation.

· AI-enabled Citrix automation: able to use AI tools to build and troubleshoot PowerShell/REST/Terraform automation for Citrix (image builds, deployments, upgrades, health checks), with GitHub for source control, pull request review, and CI/CD workflows (e.g., GitHub Actions) and the main branch as the controlled, reviewed source of truth.

· Demonstrated ability to lead POCs, solution deployments, and cross-functional projects.

· Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

· Citrix certifications (CCP-V, CCE-V, or current Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops certifications).

· Microsoft certifications (Azure, Windows Server, Microsoft 365).

· Experience with ITIL processes, change management, and Agile/hybrid project delivery.

· Experience with Azure Virtual Desktop or VMware Horizon.

**Key Performance Indicators**

· Reduction in critical incidents and mean time to resolve (MTTR).

· On-time, on-budget delivery of upgrade and migration projects with minimal downtime.

· Improved logon times and user experience metrics.

· POC outcomes delivered with clear, actionable recommendations.

· Quality and completeness of architecture documentation and knowledge transfer.
