5c1eab01.title: Engagement Manager (Remote)
5c1eab01.description:
Job Details
  
  
Remote
  
  
As an Engagement Manager with GlideFast Consulting, you will be accountable for the management and delivery of ServiceNow implementation projects. You will provide oversight and management of resources, as well as scope, schedule and cost related to projects. Utilizing best practices for effective project management, you will lead project management and operational support activities to define work schedules and assignments, review deliverables, manage discrepancies and communicate effectively with the customer and team.
  
  
What is the role?
  
  

* Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor throughout the project lifecycle
* Lead ServiceNow implementation projects using the GlideFast Engagement Methodology and ServiceNow Adaptive Implementation Framework (SAIF), ensuring delivery on scope, schedule, and budget
* Proactively manage project governance including RIDAC items, budget tracking, schedule adherence, and scope management to drive successful outcomes
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans, Work Breakdown Structures, and resource forecasts while keeping PPM and related tools updated with project status, risks, and issues
* Drive clear communication with clients and leadership through weekly status reporting, risk management, and proactive issue resolution
* Oversee the creation and delivery of project collateral such as kickoff decks, meeting notes, and implementation documentation, ensuring timely distribution and centralized storage
* Facilitate discovery workshops to validate requirements and align business objectives with technical solutions
* Collaborate with Solution Consultant, BPC’s, and developers to deliver high-quality, best practice solutions that achieve measurable results and positive client feedback
* Act as the primary liaison and escalation point for clients, advising on strategic initiatives, participating in customer success reviews, and driving consistently strong CSAT scores
* Continue learning service delivery solutions, technologies, and methodologies
* Maintain professionalism and an uninterrupted work environment during all client meetings and interactions
* Demonstrate strong corporate citizenship by completing required administrative tasks such as timesheets, feedback forms, and internal documentation accurately and on time

What experience do you need for success?
  
  

* 2+ years experience in project/program management
* 1+ year(s) professional consulting experience
* Knowledge of the ServiceNow ecosystem
* Knowledge of one or more project management software suites: MSProject, JIRA, ServiceNow PPM
* Experience providing effective, regular client project status reports
* Experience with Scrum methodology and project management
* Ability to quickly adapt to and utilize the current GlideFast implementation and advisory methodologies
* Beginner to intermediate experience with multiple Agile and project management frameworks: SAFe, Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid, Kanban, Lean

What will you bring with you?
  
  

* Agile/SAFe Scrum Master certification
* CSA
* Maintain an active government security clearance if applicable

The starting pay range for this role is $115,000.00 - $160,000.00. Full time employees will be eligible for medical, dental, vision, and life insurance in addition to discretionary bonuses. Actual compensation will depend on a number of factors, including actual work location, relevant experience (internal or external), technical skills, and other qualifications.

6104ac51.description:
**Role Overview**

We are seeking an Influencer Strategy Manager based in Delhi, India to lead influencer marketing campaigns. In this role, you will work on-site and partner closely with the Sales team to engage clients, understand their marketing needs, and transform business goals into high-impact influencer strategies. You will be responsible for end-to-end campaign delivery, risk mitigation, and driving client retention.

Key Responsibilities

• Sales Collaboration & Client Meetings: Partner closely with the Sales team to attend client meetings, pitch presentations, and discovery calls. Deeply understand brand requirements, identify core marketing pain points, and provide expert strategic consultation on-site.

• Strategy & Proposal Pitching: Translate vague or complex client briefs into actionable influencer marketing proposals. Build and present compelling PPT pitches with clear commercial logic to convince clients of optimal execution paths.

• Full-Lifecycle Project Delivery: Own client projects from contract signing to final wrap-up—managing brief breakdown, creator matrix curation, content approval, and performance delivery while maintaining overall campaign profitability.

• Risk Management & Mitigation: Monitor execution risks in real time. Swiftly coordinate with internal execution and BD teams to deploy contingency plans during delays or bottlenecks, managing client expectations professionally.

• Account Growth & Retention: Build long-term client trust through exceptional strategy execution and relationship management, driving account renewals and budget upsells.

• Data Analytics & Reporting: Analyze campaign metrics across platforms (YouTube, Instagram, etc.) to produce insightful wrap-up reports that guide the client’s next strategic moves.

Requirements

• Industry Background: 3+ years of experience in influencer marketing, social media agency, or digital marketing, with strong knowledge of YouTube and Instagram creator ecosystems and rate cards.

• Commercial & Pitching Skills: Proven ability to create persuasive strategy presentations, collaborate effectively with Sales, and negotiate with commercial acumen during client interactions.

• Communication: Excellent professional English (written and verbal) with the ability to translate complex operational updates into clear, client-friendly business communication.

• Campaign Management & Resilience: Strong multi-tasking and execution skills under tight deadlines, with high attention to detail regarding contracts, content compliance, and copyright standardizations.

• Work Arrangement: Willing and able to work full-time on-site/in-office at our Delhi office.

Nice to Have

• Hands-on experience working with Indian regional language creators (e.g., Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada), with a solid understanding of their target audience, content dynamics, and pricing benchmarks.

• Prior experience working in top-tier MCNs or global digital agencies.

• Demonstrated track record of managing and delivering influencer campaigns for mid-to-large brands.

5bc9f911.title: Advisory Solution Consultant - Presales
5bc9f911.description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

As a member of our Solution Consulting team, you will have a major impact on our future success by supporting [Employee Experience, Customer Workflow, ITX] Solution Sales through our partner ecosystem. You will guide revenue for ServiceNow with the support and partnership of Sales, Partner Ecosystem, Product Management, and the executive team. This is a technical consultant who can go wide and deep on discovery, solution positioning and demonstration while enabling and co-selling with partners during sales cycles.

About the Role :

The Solution Consultant will join the Partner Technical Acceleration Group as a technical consultant with the advanced ability to develop, position, and provide product-specific solutions in partnership with our channel/GSI ecosystem, while achieving quarterly and annual sales goals for an assigned territory through partner-led and partner-sourced deals.

Key Focus Areas

Driving pre-sales efforts for partner-led territory.

**What you get to do in this role:**

* Partner with top-tier System Integrators to develop and position ServiceNow-powered transformation solutions
* Support product sales as a technical and domain expert, partnering closely with assigned partners' pre-sales and delivery teams to extend their solution capability
* Lead discovery workshops to determine customers' challenges and give product demonstrations jointly with partner teams, to align our solution with customer needs
* Answer product feature and technical questions from partners, customers, channel partners, and ServiceNow colleagues
* Enable and upskill partner solution consultants and architects through technical training, certification support, and hands-on labs and
* Provide feedback to product management about product enhancements that can address customer and partner needs and provide additional value
* Share and learn best practices and re-usable assets with other Solution Consultants and partner technical teams to enhance the quality and efficiency of joint delivery
* Stay current on competitive analysis and market differentiation, and help partners position effectively against competitive alternatives
* Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, trade shows, and partner enablement events
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to partner account teams, supporting deal registration, solution scoping, and co-sell strategy
* Support partner build activities on ServiceNow platform and lead solution architecture discussions as needed
* Support and drive the partner GTM activities for a select few partners along with the partner manager
* Provide thought leadership through workshops, technology days, white papers, and industry forums focused on AI transformation
* Participate in executive briefings and business reviews with ServiceNow & partner leadership and their enterprise clients

**Why Join This Team**

* Work with a spectacular team of seasoned professionals in a positive, inclusive, and highly collaborative environment
* Work with the world's leading partner ecosystem on high-impact transformation initiatives
* Practice true business value selling with a strong sales support framework
* Design solutions that transform how enterprises operate – see your work make an impact
* Work with the industry-leading ServiceNow platform and cutting-edge AI/automation technologies

 **Qualifications**

**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analysing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 7+ years of pre-sales solution consulting or sales engineering experience
* Proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or technical expertise with enterprise cloud software solutions for Global Business Services ( HR Shared Services)/ CRM
* Experience working with System Integrators, consulting firms, or business process outsourcers
* Excellent understanding of architectural principles for cloud-based platforms including multi- tenancy and automation
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, IT, Engineering, or related field
* Territory management skills, including pipeline building and working with Sales and Partner counterparts to guide execution excellence
* Experience working in a channels role enabling or training partner technical teams (SIs, resellers, GSIs) on product positioning and delivery would be a plus
* Willingness to travel up to 40%, including international travel (primarily India)

**Key Competencies**

* Business Acumen: Deep understanding of how consulting firms, SIs create value; awareness of industry pressures and digital transformation drivers
* Collaboration: Ability to work across teams in highly matrixed organizations spanning ServiceNow, partners, and enterprise clients
* Influence: Navigate complex partner organizations, identify stakeholders and decision makers, build credibility and trust
* Nimble Learning: Quickly grasp new transformation methodologies, and evolving ServiceNow capabilities
* Execution Focus: Bias for action; address opportunities and challenges quickly with minimal supervision

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong understanding of transformation drivers with ServiceNow product suite (Preferably IT, CRM, and Security)
* Current ServiceNow certification (e.g., Certified System Administrator, Certified Implementation Specialist)
* Experience leading pre-sales efforts for India prospects
* Knowledge of AI and advanced analytics technologies
* ServiceNow platform development experience would be a value add

FD21

 **Additional Information**

**Work Personas**

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

**Accommodations**

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

**Export Control Regulations**

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

2a4dfb2a.description:
**Job Purpose**
Working with the Company's Sales Team, the Presales Consultant is responsible for providing presales technical support to the Sales team and presenting tailored demonstrations or qualification discussions to customers and/or prospects. The Presales Consultant also assists the Sales Team with qualifying opportunities - in or out and helping expand existing opportunities through solid questioning. The Presales Consultant will be responsible on conducting Technical Proof of Concept, Demonstration & Presentation on the supported products & solution.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Assist Account/Product Managers with qualification of opportunities by providing presales technical support.
* Provides pre-sales technical support and deliver deep dive product demonstrations to customers and business partners.
* Delivers training to partners on products solution.
* Contribute to and refine technical RFP/RFI responses
* Customer demonstrations and presentations
* Coordinating and managing technical validation events (POC)
* Coordinating and managing POC assets
* Participating in conferences, shows, exhibitions when appropriate and requested
* Recommend and influence market content.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills And Experience**

* Requires an in-depth knowledge of vendor products and general networking technologies including TCP/IP, DNS, Admin, and experience with switches, routers, and firewalls in Intranet/Internet environments.
* Good Network & Security knowledge.
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills, with ability to articulate complex technology simply.
* Ability to troubleshoot and solve technical problems.
* Self-motivated and flexible.
* Ability to effectively multi-task and be able to handle a high volume of requests, specifically unplanned/unscheduled requests.
* Able to execute instructions and to request clarification when needed.
* Able to exhibit ability to be sensitive to the needs, concerns, and feeling of others.
* Able to interact effectively with all levels of management.

At Tech Data, a TD SYNNEX Company, our values guide everything we do: Together, We Own It, We Dare to Go, We Grow and Win, and above all, We Do the Right Thing. These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact.
  
  
**What's In It For You?**

* Elective Benefits: Our programs are tailored to your country to best accommodate your lifestyle.
* Grow Your Career: Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on-demand courses.
* Elevate Your Personal Well-Being: Boost your financial, physical, and mental well-being through seminars, events, and our global Life Empowerment Assistance Program.
* Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: It's not just a phrase to us; valuing every voice is how we succeed. Join us in celebrating our global diversity through inclusive education, meaningful peer-to-peer conversations, and equitable growth and development opportunities.
* Make the Most of our Global Organization: Network with other new co-workers within your first 30 days through our onboarding program.
* Connect with Your Community: Participate in internal, peer-led inclusive communities and activities, including business resource groups, local volunteering events, and more environmental and social initiatives.

**Don't meet every single requirement? Apply anyway.**
At Tech Data, a TD SYNNEX Company, we're proud to be recognized as a great place to work and a leader in the promotion and practice of diversity, equity and inclusion. If you're excited about working for our company and believe you're a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly the person we're looking for!
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to building a diverse team that represents and empowers a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit, without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, genetics, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. To support our diversity and inclusion efforts, we may ask for voluntary gender disclosure information. This data will be used solely to improve our hiring practices and ensure fair treatment for all candidates.

83a96092.title: Lead - Solution Engineer
83a96092.description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
  
  
  
  
**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**
  
  
  
At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And, over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.
  
  
  
  
***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.***

**Job Description**

We are looking for a passionate and technically skilled
**Solution Engineer**
to be part of our SMBC Sales Support team for Freshservice. You will be instrumental in solving complex customer problems, designing tailored solutions — including AI-driven use cases built on Freddy AI and Agent Studio — and delivering impactful demonstrations of the Freshworks platform. This role suits individuals with strong pre-sales experience who thrive on customer interaction, solutioning, and collaborating with internal teams to drive business outcomes, and who are genuinely curious about applying AI to real customer problems rather than just talking about it.

**Pre-Sales Engagement & Customer Solutions:**

* Engage with SMB, mid-market customers to understand their business and technical challenges.
* Conduct discovery sessions, architect solutions, and deliver tailored product demonstrations and Proofs of Concept (POCs).
* Address technical objections and ensure alignment with customer needs.

**AI Solutioning & Positioning:**

* Understand and clearly explain core AI/LLM concepts (prompting, agents, model context/tooling) to both technical and business audiences without over-selling or over-simplifying.
* Position Freddy AI Copilot, Freddy AI Agent, and Agent Studio within customer discovery, tying AI capabilities to concrete outcomes (ticket deflection, resolution time, agent productivity) rather than generic AI messaging.
* Build and configure simple AI agents and automated workflows in Agent Studio (or comparable agent-builder tools) to bring AI use cases to life in demos and POCs.
* Field technical AI questions on integration, data handling, and governance, looping in specialists for deeper architecture discussions when needed.

**Solution Design & Documentation:**

* Participate in gathering requirements and scoping complex engagements.
* Create technical documentation including solution proposals, SoWs, and RFP/RFI responses.
* Evaluate opportunities from a technical feasibility standpoint and proactively mitigate risks.

**Collaboration & Execution:**

* Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Implementation teams.
* Align technical strategies with sales initiatives to accelerate deal closures.
* Continuously improve pre-sales tools, processes, and enablement assets.

**Customer Advocacy & Product Evangelism:**

* Articulate the value and capabilities of the Freshworks platform to both technical and business audiences.
* Represent Freshworks at customer meetings, events, and forums as a trusted technical advisor.
* Keep abreast of product developments and industry trends to provide relevant, up-to-date guidance.

**Qualifications**

* **5–8 years**
  of experience in pre-sales/solution engineering, technical consulting, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
* Strong background in SaaS, cloud technologies, APIs, and enterprise software environments.
* Proven experience designing and delivering technical demonstrations and POCs.
* Ability to work with mid-market and enterprise customers, understand their pain points, and craft effective solutions.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Familiarity with ITSM products and market is a must.
* Solid conceptual understanding of AI/LLM technology — prompting, RAG, agentic workflows, and how AI features are typically integrated into SaaS products; hands-on experience configuring or building AI agents/copilots (e.g., Agent Studio, similar low-code agent builders, or LLM APIs) is strongly preferred.
* Ability to credibly position and sell AI value to both business and technical stakeholders, including addressing common AI concerns (accuracy, data privacy, change management).
* This is a Night Shift role only, prior North America Market experience is a must

**Key Skills:**

* Pre-sales consulting & technical storytelling
* Solution architecture & demo delivery
* API, integrations, SaaS product understanding
* Discovery, qualification & objection handling
* RFP/RFI response and technical documentation
* Stakeholder collaboration (Sales/Product/Engineering)
* Strong communication & relationship-building
* AI/LLM concepts (prompting, RAG, agentic workflows) & positioning
* Hands-on AI agent/copilot building (Agent Studio or equivalent)

**Additional Information**

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

33dfebf0.title: Presales Aruba
33dfebf0.description:
**Company Description**
Aanet Talent Global Solutions (ATGS) is a leading provider of Talent, HR, and Influencer Marketing solutions that partners with businesses as strategic Talent Advisors to drive sustainable growth and operational excellence. The organization supports start-ups, mid-sized firms, and multinational corporations through comprehensive, customized consulting services tailored to each client’s specific needs. ATGS offers end-to-end talent solutions, including recruitment services focused on reducing time-to-close while maintaining high-quality hiring aligned with business objectives.

**Client: National IT Distributor Company.**

**Role Description:**
This is a full-time, on-site Presales role for HPE Aruba based in Delhi.

The Presales professional will collaborate with sales teams and clients to understand business requirements and design Aruba networking solutions that address technical and operational needs. Responsibilities include conducting product demonstrations, preparing solution proposals and presentations, and supporting bids and RFP/RFI responses.

The role involves engaging with customers to clarify technical queries, showcasing Aruba product capabilities, and providing consultative guidance throughout the pre-sales cycle. The individual will work closely with delivery and technical teams to ensure solution feasibility, accurate cost estimation, and smooth handover from pre-sales to implementation.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to assess customer requirements, evaluate technical options, and develop optimal Aruba solution designs.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills to present solutions, prepare clear documentation, and collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess Consulting skills to act as a trusted advisor, translate business needs into technical solutions, and guide customers through decision-making.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service skills to manage client expectations, address concerns promptly, and maintain long-term, professional relationships.
* Candidates should possess Presales expertise, including experience in solution scoping, product demonstrations, proposal development, and support for RFP/RFI processes.
* Relevant experience with Aruba networking products (switching, WLAN, security, network management) or similar enterprise networking solutions is highly beneficial.
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, information technology, computer science, or a related field is preferred, along with industry certifications (e.g., Aruba/HP networking certifications) as an added advantage.
* Ability to work on-site in Delhi, handle multiple opportunities simultaneously, and collaborate in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.

7e85284c.title: Senior / Solution Consultant - Veeva Quality India
7e85284c.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
  
  
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
  
  
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
  
  
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
  
  
The Role
  
  
The Solution Consultant / Senior Solution Consultant is a customer-facing member of the Veeva Quality Solution Consulting organization responsible for translating life sciences quality and manufacturing needs into compelling, value-driven Veeva Quality solutions. The role partners closely with Account Partners, Customers, Prospects and cross-functional Veeva teams throughout the sales cycle—from discovery and qualification through solution design, demonstrations, workshops, RFP/RFI responses, proof-of-concepts and executive engagement.
  
  
The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor to Quality leaders and business stakeholders, combining domain knowledge, solution expertise, consultative selling and strong communication skills to help customers modernize quality processes and realize measurable business value from Veeva's cloud platform.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Understand customer business objectives, quality processes, pain points and transformation priorities.
* Translate business and regulatory requirements into practical, differentiated Veeva Quality solution approaches.
* Create and deliver compelling demonstrations that show how Veeva Quality can improve compliance, efficiency, accountability and user experience.
* Lead consultative engagements—including discovery workshops, solution workshops, conference room pilots and proof-of-concepts—to demonstrate business value.
* Support the sales team in progressing opportunities, strengthening executive relationships and increasing confidence in Veeva as the preferred strategic partner.
* Bring market, industry and competitive insight into account strategy and solution positioning.

**Requirements**

* 5+ years overall experience including 3+ years of Solution Consultant experience in Pharma/Biotech, MedTech, Diagnostics or another relevant regulated industry.
* Experience in pre-sales and solution consulting customer-facing role within a software or technology organization.
* Strong understanding of Quality and/or Manufacturing operations in life sciences.
* Working knowledge of Cloud and SaaS applications, life sciences business processes and digital transformation concepts.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, interpersonal, facilitation and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Willingness to travel approximately 20–30% of time within India.
* Based in or able to work from the target territories: Mumbai, Hyderabad or Bangalore.
* English and Hindi proficiency; familiarity with relevant regional languages is an advantage.

****Nice to Have****

* Experience with software solutions used by Quality Assurance and Manufacturing organizations in Pharma/Biotech, MedTech or Diagnostics.
* Hands-on knowledge of one or more enterprise applications such as QMS, DMS, LMS, VMS or LIMS.
* Experience with SaaS/cloud technology and enterprise software platforms.
* Consulting, business analysis or software implementation experience.
* Previous experience with Veeva applications, including Quality, Regulatory, Clinical or Safety.
* Experience in competitive software evaluations and legacy-system replacement programs.
* Strong teamwork and willingness to contribute to broader team goals.
* The candidate should be curious, energetic, commercially aware, collaborative and comfortable taking ownership of customer-facing engagements from preparation through follow-up.

**Perks & Benefits**

* Health & wellness programs
* Life Assurance
* Veeva charitable giving program
* Additional annual leave over Christmas break

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
  
  
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances.

f167120d.title: Solutioning & Presales Engineer- XDR and Cloud Security
f167120d.description:
**About Mitigata**

Mitigata is India's first AI-native, full-stack cyber resilience company. Most businesses buy security, compliance, and insurance as three separate products from three separate vendors. We bring all three onto one platform, so a single partner can assess a client's risk, help prevent a breach, prove compliance, and cover the financial loss if an incident occurs.

Founded in 2023 and headquartered in Bengaluru, we are a team of 175+ serving 800+ customers across 25+ industries and 6+ countries, including India, the USA, the UAE, the UK, and Singapore. Our broking arm, Mitigata Insurance Brokers Pvt. Ltd., is licensed by IRDAI. We are backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Nexus Venture Partners, Titan Capital, WEH Ventures,, along with founder-angels including Anupam Mittal (Shaadi.com) and Nitish Mittersain (Nazara).

Join us in building the first line of defence for Digital India, with products built in India for the world.

**Role Overview:**

We are hiring a Pre-Sales Engineer to own the technical win on XDR, endpoint and cloud security opportunities, across platforms such as CrowdStrike, SentinelOne and Palo Alto Networks, and the CNAPP, CSPM and CWPP stack that protects multi-cloud workloads.

**Key Responsibilities :**

* Run technical discovery with CISOs, cloud and infrastructure teams to map endpoints, workloads, cloud accounts, identity and compliance needs (RBI, SEBI CSCRF, CERT-In, DPDP).
* Design XDR / EDR solutions on CrowdStrike Falcon, SentinelOne Singularity, Palo Alto Cortex XDR, Microsoft Defender and Trend Micro Vision One.
* Design cloud security solutions across CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, CIEM, KSPM and IaC scanning, using platforms such as Palo Alto Prisma Cloud, CrowdStrike Falcon Cloud Security, SentinelOne Cloud, Wiz and Microsoft Defender for Cloud.
* Assess AWS, Azure and GCP environments for misconfigurations, posture gaps and compliance against CIS benchmarks and regulatory frameworks.
* Deliver demos, workshops and proofs of concept, including attack simulations and cloud posture assessments, and convert them into technical wins.
* Lead technical responses to RFPs and RFQs: compliance matrices, architecture diagrams, bills of material, sizing and licensing.
* Recommend the right platform for each client's scale, budget and stack, and build managed XDR and cloud security proposals that combine it with Mitigata services and Gordon AI SOC.
* Work with CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Palo Alto and other OEM partner teams on joint pursuits, deal registration and enablement.
* Hand over cleanly to delivery with documented scope, design and success criteria.
* Train the sales team on positioning, competitive differentiation across platforms and qualification.

**Key Skills & Qualifications :**

* 4–8 years in cybersecurity presales, solutions engineering or security engineering, ideally at an MSSP, SI or OEM.
* 2+ years hands-on with at least two of CrowdStrike, SentinelOne and Palo Alto Networks (Cortex XDR / Prisma Cloud), including deployment, policy tuning and POCs.
* Working knowledge of CNAPP and CSPM concepts: posture management, workload protection (CWPP), entitlement management (CIEM), container and Kubernetes security, and IaC scanning.
* Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure and / or GCP security services and architecture.
* Strong grasp of endpoint, identity and network threats, MITRE ATT&CK, threat hunting and incident response workflows.
* Proven track record of running POCs and writing technical sections of enterprise and government RFPs.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics or equivalent experience.

**Good to have:**

* OEM certifications: CrowdStrike CCFA / CCFR, SentinelOne Certified, Palo Alto PCCSE / PCNSE / Cortex XDR, or Microsoft SC-200.
* Cloud certifications: AWS Security Specialty, Azure AZ-500, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, or CCSK / CCSP.
* Exposure to BFSI and regulated sectors in India — RBI, SEBI CSCRF, IRDAI, CERT-In and DPDP requirements.
* Experience with Wiz, Orca, Lacework, Zscaler or SASE / Zero Trust architectures.
* Scripting in Python, PowerShell or Terraform for automation and integrations.

**What makes you a strong fit**

* You explain complex architecture clearly to both a CISO and a CFO.
* You write crisp, well-structured proposals under deadline.
* You stay vendor-neutral and recommend what is right for the client.
* You enjoy working across sales, delivery and OEM partners.

**What We Look For**

Every role needs strong skills in its craft. Beyond that, the people who thrive at Mitigata tend to share a few traits:

* **You care about the problem.**
  Protecting businesses and people motivates you, and the impact of your work matters to you.
* **You think from first principles.**
  You question assumptions and reason through new problems instead of relying only on how things have always been done.
* **You take ownership.**
  You care about the outcome, not just the task, and step in where you are needed.
* **You act with integrity.**
  You are candid about mistakes and handle confidential information with care. Our clients trust us in their most difficult moments.
* **You learn quickly.**
  Threats, regulations, and our products change often. We value how fast you grow as much as where you are today.

**How We Hire**

Our process is structured and built to respect your time. It typically includes a recruiter conversation, a hiring manager conversation, and 3 to 5 interviews, one of which is a practical work sample based on real problems. We aim to reach a decision within 2 to 3 weeks of your first conversation and will keep you informed at every stage.

Every candidate is assessed on the same criteria, whatever their background. We handle your personal information with the same care we apply to our clients' data: we collect only what we need and share it only with the people involved in your application.

**Why Join Mitigata?**

*Protecting the businesses that power India's digital economy.*

* **Work that matters.**
  Cyber incidents hit real organisations, from hospitals disrupted by ransomware to directors facing liability claims to startups whose funding is put at risk after a breach. Your work helps protect their systems, their finances, and their reputation.
* **A distinctive model.**
  We combine cybersecurity, compliance, and liability insurance in one company, because protection works best when prevention and coverage go together.
* **Room to build.**
  We are building an AI-native platform and one of India's most comprehensive AI-driven Security Operations Centers, with real scope to solve problems from first principles.
* **Growth that follows impact.**
  We are early and growing quickly, so scope often expands faster than headcount. People who learn fast and take ownership see their responsibilities grow with them.
* **Startup pace, institutional foundations.**
  IRDAI-licensed, backed by leading investors, and trusted by 800+ customers, while still moving at the speed of a startup.
* Competitive compensation,
  **ESOPs**
  , and the opportunity to contribute to work with national impact.

If you want your work to protect the people and businesses behind India's growth, we would love to hear from you.
**Build for protection. Build for Bharat 🇮🇳**

**To Apply:**
Send your resume to vignesh.g@mitigata.com with the subject line Solutioning & Pre Sales

We are backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Nexus Venture Partners, Titan Capital, WEH Ventures,, along with founder-angels including Anupam Mittal (Shaadi.com) and Nitish Mittersain (Nazara).

Join us in building the first line of defence for Digital India, with products built in India for the world.

**Role Overview:**

We are hiring a Solutioning & Pre Sales Engineer to own the technical win on every SIEM and SOC opportunity Mitigata pursues (led by Splunk, and spanning Microsoft Sentinel, IBM QRadar, Google SecOps and other leading platforms) - from discovery and solution design to POC and handover to delivery.

**Key Responsibilities :**

Run technical discovery with CISOs, SOC heads and IT teams to map log sources, use cases, compliance needs (RBI, SEBI CSCRF, CERT-In, DPDP) and data volumes.

* Design SIEM solutions on Splunk (Enterprise / Cloud, Enterprise Security, SOAR) and other platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel, IBM QRadar, Google SecOps, Securonix and Elastic — including architecture, ingest sizing, retention and licensing.
* Deliver product demos, workshops and proofs of concept, and convert them into technical wins within agreed timelines.
* Lead technical responses to RFPs and RFQs: compliance matrices, architecture diagrams, bills of material and effort estimates.
* Recommend the right SIEM for each client's scale, budget and stack, and build managed SIEM + SOC proposals that combine it with Mitigata services and Gordon AI SOC.
* Develop detection use cases, dashboards and correlation rules (SPL, KQL, AQL, YARA-L) for POCs and reference content.
* Work with Splunk / Cisco and other OEM partner teams on joint pursuits, deal registration and enablement.
* Hand over cleanly to delivery with a documented scope, design and success criteria.
* Train the sales team on SIEM positioning, competitive differentiation across platforms and qualification.

**Key Skills & Qualifications :**

* 4–8 years in cybersecurity presales, solutions engineering or SIEM / SOC engineering, ideally at an MSSP, SI or OEM.
* 2+ years hands-on with Splunk: SPL, data onboarding, Enterprise Security, dashboards and sizing.
* Working knowledge of at least one more SIEM — Microsoft Sentinel, IBM QRadar, Google SecOps, Securonix, Elastic, Exabeam or similar — and the ability to compare them objectively.
* Strong grasp of log sources and integrations: firewalls, EDR, identity, cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), OT and core banking or ERP applications.
* Familiarity with SOC operations, MITRE ATT&CK, SOAR playbooks and threat intelligence.
* Proven track record of running POCs and writing technical sections of enterprise and government RFPs.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics or equivalent experience.

**Good to have:**

* Certifications: Splunk Core Certified Power User / Admin, Splunk Enterprise Security Certified Admin, Microsoft SC-200, IBM QRadar SIEM or Google SecOps.
* Security certifications such as CEH, CompTIA Security+, CISSP or GCIA.
* Exposure to BFSI and regulated sectors in India — RBI, SEBI CSCRF, IRDAI, CERT-In and DPDP requirements.
* Experience with AI-driven SOC, UEBA or XDR platforms. Scripting in Python or PowerShell for automation and custom integrations.

**What makes you a strong fit**

* You explain complex architecture clearly to both a CISO and a CFO.
* You write crisp, well-structured proposals under deadline.
* You stay vendor-neutral and recommend what is right for the client.
* You enjoy working across sales, delivery and OEM partners.

**What We Look For**

Every role needs strong skills in its craft. Beyond that, the people who thrive at Mitigata tend to share a few traits:

* **You care about the problem.**
  Protecting businesses and people motivates you, and the impact of your work matters to you.
* **You think from first principles.**
  You question assumptions and reason through new problems instead of relying only on how things have always been done.
* **You take ownership.**
  You care about the outcome, not just the task, and step in where you are needed.
* **You act with integrity.**
  You are candid about mistakes and handle confidential information with care. Our clients trust us in their most difficult moments.
* **You learn quickly.**
  Threats, regulations, and our products change often. We value how fast you grow as much as where you are today.

**How We Hire**

Our process is structured and built to respect your time. It typically includes a recruiter conversation, a hiring manager conversation, and 3 to 5 interviews, one of which is a practical work sample based on real problems. We aim to reach a decision within 2 to 3 weeks of your first conversation and will keep you informed at every stage.

Every candidate is assessed on the same criteria, whatever their background. We handle your personal information with the same care we apply to our clients' data: we collect only what we need and share it only with the people involved in your application.

**Why Join Mitigata?**

*Protecting the businesses that power India's digital economy.*

* **Work that matters.**
  Cyber incidents hit real organisations, from hospitals disrupted by ransomware to directors facing liability claims to startups whose funding is put at risk after a breach. Your work helps protect their systems, their finances, and their reputation.
* **A distinctive model.**
  We combine cybersecurity, compliance, and liability insurance in one company, because protection works best when prevention and coverage go together.
* **Room to build.**
  We are building an AI-native platform and one of India's most comprehensive AI-driven Security Operations Centers, with real scope to solve problems from first principles.
* **Growth that follows impact.**
  We are early and growing quickly, so scope often expands faster than headcount. People who learn fast and take ownership see their responsibilities grow with them.
* **Startup pace, institutional foundations.**
  IRDAI-licensed, backed by leading investors, and trusted by 800+ customers, while still moving at the speed of a startup.
* Competitive compensation,
  **ESOPs**
  , and the opportunity to contribute to work with national impact.

If you want your work to protect the people and businesses behind India's growth, we would love to hear from you.
**Build for protection. Build for Bharat 🇮🇳**

**To Apply:**
Send your resume to vignesh.s@mitigata.com with the subject line Solutioning & Pre Sales

c4dbac49.title: Senior / Solution Consultant - Veeva Quality India
c4dbac49.description:

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
  
  
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
  
  
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
  
  
The Role
  
  
The Solution Consultant / Senior Solution Consultant is a customer-facing member of the Veeva Quality Solution Consulting organization responsible for translating life sciences quality and manufacturing needs into compelling, value-driven Veeva Quality solutions. The role partners closely with Account Partners, Customers, Prospects and cross-functional Veeva teams throughout the sales cycle—from discovery and qualification through solution design, demonstrations, workshops, RFP/RFI responses, proof-of-concepts and executive engagement.
  
  
The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor to Quality leaders and business stakeholders, combining domain knowledge, solution expertise, consultative selling and strong communication skills to help customers modernize quality processes and realize measurable business value from Veeva's cloud platform.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Understand customer business objectives, quality processes, pain points and transformation priorities.

* Create and deliver compelling demonstrations that show how Veeva Quality can improve compliance, efficiency, accountability and user experience.

* Support the sales team in progressing opportunities, strengthening executive relationships and increasing confidence in Veeva as the preferred strategic partner.
* Bring market, industry and competitive insight into account strategy and solution positioning.

**Requirements**

* 5+ years overall experience including 3+ years of Solution Consultant experience in Pharma/Biotech, MedTech, Diagnostics or another relevant regulated industry.
* Experience in pre-sales and solution consulting customer-facing role within a software or technology organization.
* Strong understanding of Quality and/or Manufacturing operations in life sciences.
* Working knowledge of Cloud and SaaS applications, life sciences business processes and digital transformation concepts.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, interpersonal, facilitation and presentation skills.

****Nice to Have****

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
  
  
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances.

123b37e4.title: Presales Executive
123b37e4.description:
**Job Description Presales Executive**

**Real Estate – Channel Partner Sales**

**Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu  
 **Department:** Sales & Business Development  
 **Employment Type:** Full-Time  
 **Experience Required:** 1–3 Years  
 **Salary Range:** 20,000 – 30,000 per month, depending on experience, skills, and caliber  
 **Reporting To:** Sales Head / Management

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a dynamic, customer-oriented, and target-driven Presales Executive for a real estate business focused on channel partner and direct property sales.

The candidate will be responsible for handling property enquiries, qualifying prospective buyers, coordinating with channel partners, presenting project details, scheduling site visits, maintaining CRM records, and following up with prospective customers until booking and sales closure.

The ideal candidate should have prior experience in real estate presales, inside sales, or channel partner sales, along with excellent communication, customer-handling, and follow-up skills.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. Lead & Enquiry Handling**

* Respond promptly to leads received through channel partners, telephone calls, WhatsApp, websites, property portals, social media, and walk-ins.
* Qualify prospective buyers based on budget, preferred unit type, purchase purpose (self-use or investment), loan requirements, and purchase timeline.
* Register leads under the appropriate channel partner and ensure proper lead management.
* Avoid duplicate or disputed lead registrations through accurate record maintenance.

**2. Sales Pitch & Project Presentation**

* Explain project location, layouts, specifications, amenities, pricing, payment plans, and applicable approvals such as CMDA, DTCP, and RERA.
* Present project advantages, nearby connectivity, growth potential, and relevant comparisons with competing projects.
* Prepare cost sheets, quotations, and booking proposals.
* Provide accurate project information and assist customers in making informed property purchase decisions.

**3. CRM & Sales Tool Management**

* Record all leads, channel partner details, call notes, site visits, and follow-up dates in the CRM system.
* Update sales stages regularly, including enquiry, site visit, negotiation, booking, agreement, and registration.
* Generate reports on lead status, site visits, conversions, and channel partner performance.
* Maintain effective usage of MS Excel / Google Sheets, email, and WhatsApp Business.

**4. Site Visits & Follow-up Until Closure**

* Schedule and coordinate site visits with prospective buyers and channel partners.
* Follow up consistently through calls, messages, and emails after site visits.
* Handle customer objections related to pricing, location, possession dates, loan requirements, and legal clarity.
* Negotiate within approved limits and escalate matters to management wherever required.
* Facilitate conversion of prospects into confirmed bookings.
* Assist in the collection of token amounts or booking advances as per company procedures.

**5. Documentation & Team Coordination**

* Coordinate with sales, accounts, legal, banking / loan partners, and site teams.
* Assist buyers with booking forms, KYC documentation, agreements of sale, and home loan processing.
* Share buyer feedback and market insights with the sales team to improve sales strategies.
* Ensure smooth coordination between customers, channel partners, and internal departments.

**6. After-Sales & Relationship Building**

* Ensure smooth handover of booked customers to post-sales and accounts teams.
* Follow up on payment schedules and customer satisfaction.
* Build and maintain relationships with customers and channel partners to generate referrals and repeat business.
* Provide timely assistance to customers during the booking and post-booking process.

**7. Reporting & Target Achievement**

* Submit daily and weekly reports on leads, site visits, bookings, and follow-ups.
* Achieve monthly targets for site visits and property bookings.
* Maintain accurate CRM records and ensure timely follow-up completion.
* Monitor lead-to-site-visit and site-visit-to-booking conversion rates.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Graduate in any discipline. B.Com, BBA, MBA, or equivalent qualification will be preferred.
* 1–3 years of experience in real estate presales, inside sales, or channel partner sales.
* Hands-on experience with real estate or general CRM systems such as Zoho, LeadSquared, Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar.
* Strong spoken and written communication skills in English and Tamil.
* Knowledge of Hindi or Telugu will be an added advantage.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and email communication.
* Basic knowledge of real estate transactions, home loans, registration processes, RERA, and property documentation.
* Good negotiation, persuasion, customer relationship management, and follow-up skills.
* Ability to work in a target-oriented sales environment.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Number of leads generated and qualified through channel partners.
* Lead-to-site-visit conversion rate.
* Site-visit-to-booking conversion rate.
* Number of bookings and sales value closed.
* Follow-up completion rate.
* CRM data accuracy and timely updates.
* Channel partner engagement and relationship management.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Self-motivated, confident, and target-oriented.
* Strong customer-handling and communication abilities.
* Disciplined in follow-ups and sales pipeline management.
* Relationship-oriented with the ability to work effectively with channel partners.
* Collaborative and willing to support the sales team.
* Honest, ethical, and professional in dealings with customers and business partners.

**Compensation**

* **Monthly Salary:** 20,000 – 30,000, depending on experience, skills, and caliber.
* Compensation will be finalized based on the candidate’s relevant experience and suitability for the role.

**To Apply**

Interested candidates may send their updated CV to **sudhir@educohire.com** with the subject line **“Application for Presales Executive – Chennai”**.

For Queries, Contact: **9205582778**

da8fd84a.description:

* Drive the outlined strategy for growing the Cross-Currency APAC P&L for the assigned portfolio, leveraging existing JPMorgan relationship, developing new relationships with Corporate Banking and Payments Sales, and CDM Marketer.
* Sales enablement for simple cross-currency payment flows for a defined set of client portfolio: Train relevant coverage partners on cross-currency payment capabilities, including spot foreign exchange payment solutions available via supported payment platforms. This includes the end-to-end payment flow from initiation through automated payment processing, tracking and client reporting.
* Ownership of complex flow / foreign exchange control-enabled solutions: Serve as the primary solution partner for complex client needs, working with Sales (and other stakeholders when applicable) to configure or tailor existing capabilities. As a client-facing Vice President, drive organic growth by increasing penetration with existing clients and pitching solutions to new clients, including proposal responses and bundling of products & solutions, and educate clients on new ways of execution.
* Governance, legal and regulatory rigor (continuous, not episodic): Ensure governance and regulatory alignment are embedded throughout the client solutioning lifecycle. Stay current on product approvals, policy constraints, licensing/regulatory requirements and required controls—reducing late-stage surprises and minimizing rework when feasibility checks happen too late.
* Structured translation layer between Sales and Product: Convert pipeline signals, proposal inputs and client feedback into actionable product requirements, enhancement requests and prioritization inputs. Translate roadmap constraints into clear client positioning, field-ready enablement and guidance on what is feasible now vs. later. Work with Sales to maintain a healthy client pipeline, ensuring involvement across the sales cycle from opportunity identification through solution pitches and winning mandates. The role is expected to support multiple client segments and industries in India and translate requirements into scalable solutions.
* Coordination between Payments Sales, Corporate and Commercial Banks and CDM Markets for pro-active and target client calling, develop and present client relevant and thoughtful solution presentations and set-out pricing strategy for all of the Cross-Currency Solutions.

**Key Skills**

* Cross-border payments and FX expertise: strong understanding of cross-currency payment flows, foreign exchange, client implementation considerations and operating/processing constraints
* Regulatory and controls mindset: ability to operate effectively within governance frameworks, legal/compliance requirements, and local regulatory expectations applicable to cross-border transactions
* Advisory and Solutioning: capability to assess feasibility early, design repeatable solutions, and standardize patterns that can scale across clients and segments, while taking an consultative approach going beyond the standard product offering.
* Commercial acumen and client-facing leadership: strong executive presence, ability to influence outcomes, and proven experience supporting complex solution pitches and proposal responses
* Stakeholder management: demonstrated ability to drive alignment across Product, Sales, Technology, Operations, Implementation and Service teams
* Analytical and structured problem solving: ability to leverage data and structured thinking to prioritize opportunities, develop replication strategies, and deliver clear recommendations
* Globalized view: ability to recognize patterns across markets and segments, apply global standards with local expertise.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Significant experience in cross-border payments, transaction banking/cash management and/or FX-related solutions
* Strong understanding of end-to-end payment flows and the practicalities of delivery and execution in a regulated environment
* Demonstrated experience partnering across Product, Sales and delivery organizations to deliver client outcomes
* Track record in complex client solutioning, commercialization and supporting proposal responses
* Understanding of APAC regulatory environment related to cash management, account services and foreign exchange
* BA or BS from a top-tier program or equivalent level education preferred
* Minimum of 8 years+ of relevant work experience
* Exceptional writing, verbal communication and client facing skills

Morgan and Chase brands. f96e01c2.title: Professional Services Solution Consultant
f96e01c2.description:
**WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.**
**We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.**
**We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.**
**Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.**
**For more information, visit WPP.com.**
Role summary:
  
  
The Solution Consultant is a trusted advisor and hands-on solution partner within Professional Services. The role combines solution consulting, business and product analysis, technical understanding, stakeholder management, project management, and disciplined delivery thinking.
  
  
Working across agency and client teams, Product, Engineering, Growth, Enablement, Training, Support and delivery colleagues, the consultant discovers needs, shapes requirements, designs and demonstrates solutions, supports scoping and implementation, and feeds learning back into reusable patterns and product improvements.
  
  
Success means clients and WPP teams understand what is possible, requirements are clear before delivery starts, proven capabilities are configured appropriately, hand-offs are clean, and repeatable solutions can be deployed with less friction and faster time to value.
  
  
Key responsibilities:
  
  
Discovery & requirements:
  
  

* Lead structured discovery with agency, client and internal stakeholders to understand objectives, users, workflows, data, constraints and expected outcomes.
* Analyse current-state processes, usage and needs, separating problems to solve from requested features.
* Translate needs into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, solution specifications and, where required, scope inputs for statements of work.
* Identify dependencies, assumptions, risks and gaps early, and ensure the right Product, Engineering, Enterprise Solutions or Professional Services owners are engaged.

Solution design & consulting:
  
  

* Map business needs to proven, ready-to-deploy WPP Open capabilities and recommend an appropriate foundation or configured solution.
* Design and present solution options that explain the value, trade-offs, dependencies and delivery implications in language suited to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Create and deliver demonstrations that show how selected WPP Open capabilities address the defined use case.
* Support business-case and value-realisation thinking by linking the proposed solution to measurable client or operational outcomes.

Technical & platform expertise:
  
  

* Build and maintain strong knowledge of WPP Open architecture, capabilities, agents, configuration options, data and integration touchpoints.
* Stay current on platform releases, capabilities and deployment guidance, and distinguish proven, scalable capabilities from functionality still in development or testing.

Delivery partnership & quality:
  
  

* Partner with Project Managers, Product Analysts, Deployment Specialists, Configuration Admins and implementation teams from scope through go-live and handover.
* Ensure solution intent, requirements and acceptance criteria remain traceable through configuration, testing and delivery.
* Support UAT, solution validation and issue resolution, escalating material scope, quality or dependency risks through the appropriate delivery route.
* Contribute to clear handovers into Enablement, Training or Support where those teams own the next stage of adoption.

Project management & delivery coordination:
  
  

* Develop and maintain clear delivery plans that define milestones, dependencies, ownership, decision points and critical path activities for assigned engagements.
* Coordinate day-to-day project activity across stakeholders, ensuring actions are tracked, blockers are surfaced early and progress remains visible to the right delivery and leadership audiences.
* Maintain disciplined RAID management, including proactive identification of risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies, with clear mitigation plans and escalation routes.
* Support governance routines such as status reporting, checkpoint reviews, decision logs and delivery readiness assessments, ensuring stakeholders have confidence in progress and next steps.
* Balance speed, scope and quality by making delivery trade-offs explicit, aligning expectations early and ensuring changes are assessed for impact before commitments are made.
* Drive clean closure by confirming acceptance criteria, documenting outcomes, capturing lessons learned and ensuring handover routes are agreed before the engagement is considered complete.

Scale, product feedback & continuous improvement:
  
  

* Convert lessons from engagements into reusable solution patterns, templates, playbooks and configuration standards.
* Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering on recurring client needs, friction, feature gaps and opportunities for improvement.
* Help standardise intake and scoping so requests arrive with the information needed to route and estimate work accurately.
* Use delivery and usage evidence to identify opportunities to improve solution quality, reduce avoidable effort and accelerate time to value.

Stakeholder relationships:
  
  

* Act as a credible, pragmatic bridge between business, product and technology stakeholders.
* Build trust through transparent recommendations, clear documentation, realistic commitments and proactive communication.
* Work collaboratively across WPP, maintaining client-team ownership of client relationships while providing the expertise needed to make good solution decisions.

Skills & experience:
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in solutions consulting, business analysis, product analysis, implementation consulting or a comparable role, ideally within marketing technology or professional services.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with experience turning ambiguous business needs into structured, actionable requirements and solution options.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation and facilitation skills, including the ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience working across product, engineering, delivery and commercial stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery and backlog practices, including user stories, acceptance criteria and prioritisation.
* Ability to manage and coordinate the intake of features and change requests, clarifying need, priority, impact and ownership so requests can be translated into actionable outcomes.
* Understanding of digital marketing technology and related cloud, data, integration and workflow concepts.
* Experience with platform implementation, configuration, adoption or service design is advantageous.
* Experience with WPP Open, agent deployment, API integration, data modelling, Jira/Confluence or process-mapping tools
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, make sound trade-offs and maintain high-quality documentation and stakeholder communication.

Working principles:
  
  

* Client value first: recommend capability because it improves an outcome, not simply because it exists.
* Deliver what is available: favour proven, ready-to-deploy capabilities and be explicit about anything that is not yet scaled.
* Enable the enablers: design solutions and handovers so administrators, champions and enablement teams can sustain adoption.
* Client teams stay in control: provide expertise behind the scenes while respecting ownership of client conversations and ongoing relationships.

The person:
  
  
You are curious, structured and commercially aware, with enough technical depth to be credible with engineers and enough empathy and communication skill to make complexity understandable. You are comfortable challenging unclear requirements, bringing the right people together and turning a good bespoke answer into a better repeatable pattern. Above all, you focus on outcomes: dependable delivery that builds trust, scalable ways of working and faster realisation of value from WPP Open.
  
  
**Who you are:**
**You're open
*:***
we are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.
  
  
**You're optimistic
*:***
we approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.
  
  
**You're extraordinary:**
We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.
  
  
**What we'll give you:**
**Passionate, inspired people**
– we champion a culture of people that do extraordinary work
  
  
**Scale and opportunity**
– we offer the opportunity to create, influence and deliver projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.
  
  
**Challenging and stimulating work**
– unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers.
  
  
**We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.**
**WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.**
**Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.**
