32634056.title: Solution Architect - SCON
32634056.description:
**Global Cyber Solution Hub**

Cyber Defense & Resilience Solution Architect

**Global Consulting Services**

Deloitte’s Global Consulting Services professionals support our global businesses to drive impact and create enduring value for clients in Strategy, Risk & Transactions (SR&T) and Technology & Transformation (T&T). We deliver purpose-driven services and solutions and provide a consistent, best-in-class "One Deloitte" experience around the world.

**Position Summary**

**Level: Senior Consultant**

The Cyber Defense & Resilience Solution Architect will join the Global Cyber Solution Hub and support Deloitte member firm teams on strategic and complex Cyber opportunities. The role will help pursuit teams turn business and technical requirements into practical Cyber Defense & Resilience solutions. It will bring relevant leading practice methods, assets, alliance relationships, and delivery experience into the pursuit process.

This is an internal advisory role. The Solution Architect will work with pursuit teams, Cyber Defense & Resilience leaders, specialists, and delivery teams across the Deloitte network. The primary focus will be shaping differentiated solutions across areas such as security operations, managed detection and response, threat detection engineering, cyber incident response, technology resilience, attack surface management, and cyber recovery. This aligns with Deloitte's Cyber Defense & Resilience offering that helps clients detect, respond to, recover from, and build resilience against cyber threats.

**Work you'll do**

**Solution shaping and technical win strategy**

* Shape Cyber Defense & Resilience solutions for strategic and complex pursuits, including the operating model, delivery approach, service architecture, and technical win themes
* Work with pursuit teams to understand the opportunity and define the role Cyber Defense & Resilience should play in the overall solution
* Use Deloitte methods, assets, and tools to structure a differentiated solution
* Develop the scope, key assumptions, effort estimate, transition approach, and staffing model
* Collaborate with pricing specialists so the commercial model reflects the solution and delivery approach
* Review solution designs for feasibility, differentiation, and fit with the client need
* Support Deloitte firm teams as they prepare for solution workshops, proposals, demonstrations, and oral presentations
Help teams articulate outcomes related to threat detection, response effectiveness, operational resilience, incident readiness, and business continuity  

**Cyber Defense & Resilience domain leadership**

* Bring experience across security operations, attack surface management, threat intelligence, managed detection and response, incident response, cyber recovery, and resilience capabilities
* Support development of operating models for SOC modernization, MXDR, and managed security services
* Help pursuit teams evaluate technology ecosystems and alliance opportunities that strengthen the defense and resilience proposition
* Identify opportunities to incorporate AI, automation, orchestration, and advanced analytics into Cyber Defense & Resilience solutions
Review proposed service levels, performance measures, operating procedures, and governance approaches to support sustainable operations  

**Cross-cyber integration**

* Identify where Cyber Defense & Resilience should connect with Enterprise Security, Digital Identity, Cyber Operate, or our other offerings
* Help teams bring Cyber into broader transformation pursuits when there is a clear client need
* Review priority opportunities identified through the intake process and shape the Cyber Defense & Resilience scope where it adds value
* Consider how the solution will move from advisory and implementation activities into ongoing operations and managed services
Connect resilience and recovery requirements with broader technology transformation and business continuity objectives  

**Global coordination and pursuit support**

* Act as a force multiplier for Deloitte firm pursuit teams by bringing Global assets, proof points, and operational experience into the opportunity where appropriate
* Connect teams with Cyber Defense & Resilience specialists, delivery centers, and alliance resources
* Build working relationships with offering leaders and technical specialists across the Deloitte network
* Coordinate existing expertise and materials rather than recreate work already available elsewhere in Deloitte
Keep assumptions, dependencies, transition considerations, and open decisions clear so the Deloitte firm team can approve the final approach  

**AI-enabled solution development**

* Use approved AI tools to support research, solution workshops, and development of proposal content
* Assess how AI, automation, and intelligent operations could improve the security solution or delivery model
* Support development of solution concepts into demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and operational use cases
* Identify opportunities to integrate AI-driven detection, response, threat analysis, and operational efficiencies into solution architectures
Apply professional judgment when reviewing AI-generated content and remain accountable for the quality of the final work  

**Assets and offering development**

* Turn successful pursuit approaches into reusable solution patterns, playbooks, operating models, and reference architectures
* Capture qualifications and proof points that can support future opportunities
* Contribute Cyber Defense & Resilience content to sales materials and other Global Cyber priorities
* Feed pursuit insights back to Global Cyber Defense & Resilience leadership to help improve the offering
Maintain reusable content in line with confidentiality, intellectual property, and data-handling requirements  

**The Team**

Cyber Defense & Resilience teams help organizations strengthen their ability to detect, respond to, recover from, and adapt to cyber threats. The portfolio includes security operations, attack surface management, threat detection and response, cyber incident readiness and recovery, managed extended detection and response (MXDR), threat intelligence, and technology resilience services. Deloitte helps organizations modernize security operations, improve incident preparedness, accelerate response, and build resilience across business and technology environments.

The Global Cyber Solution Hub supports Deloitte member firm teams on priority opportunities across the Cyber portfolio. This global team helps teams shape solutions, locate relevant expertise, and reuse proven materials. Deloitte member firms remain responsible for the client relationship, approvals, and final deliverables.

**Qualifications**

Must have skills / project experience / certifications

* 5 to 8 years of experience in cyber consulting, security operations, incident response, cyber resilience, managed security services, or a solution architect or presales architect role
* Experience supporting large or complex pursuits
* Depth in one or more Cyber Defense & Resilience domains, such as SOC transformation, MXDR, threat detection and response, cyber threat intelligence, attack surface management, incident response, cyber recovery, or technology resilience
* Demonstrated ability to shape a solution from operating model and service architecture through delivery model and estimate
* Ability to explain and defend a technical approach with senior pursuit stakeholders and technical specialists
* Commercial fluency, including an understanding of managed services pricing models, margin considerations, and deal constructs
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to produce proposal-ready content and a clear presentation narrative
* Experience working across geographies and with distributed teams
Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities  

**Good to have skills / project experience / certifications**

* Practical use of approved AI tools in proposal drafting, research, or solution development
* Familiarity with Deloitte methods and the Global Cyber offering portfolio
* Experience with leading cyber defense technologies, security operations platforms, SIEM, SOAR, XDR, cloud-native security tooling, or attack surface management solutions
* Experience with managed security services and transition-to-operate programs
* Experience working with global delivery centers or distributed teams
* Relevant credentials such as CISSP, GIAC certifications, GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, GCFE, AWS Security Specialty, Microsoft Security certifications, or equivalent technical certifications
Experience incorporating automation, orchestration, AI, and analytics into security operations  

**Education:**

* BE, B.Tech, MCA, M.Sc. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or an equivalent degree from an accredited university

**Location:**

* Deloitte US-India Offices, based on applicable talent and business requirements

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

  
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

In this role, you will spearhead architectural blueprints, define target-state topologies, and deliver resilient, production-ready enterprise platforms uniting Modern Lakehouse architectures with state-of-the-art Generative AI capabilities.

  

Key Responsibilities

  

* **End-to-End Architecture & Solution Design:** Lead architectural strategy, high-level and low-level designs (HLD/LLD), and technical governance for enterprise Lakehouse, Data Mesh, and AI platforms using Azure Databricks and the Microsoft Azure cloud ecosystem.

* **Full Lifecycle Implementation Ownership:** Own the entire lifecycle of enterprise solution architecturefrom pre-architecture discovery, business requirements translation, and platform selection to architectural governance, reference designs, and production deployment.
* **Observability, Security & LLMOps:** Establish enterprise-grade guardrails including unified logging, exception handling, data lineage, LLM evaluation metrics (hallucination, ground truth, toxicity), RBAC, and model monitoring to guarantee platform resilience.
* **Technical Ownership & Code Governance:** Retain full architectural authority over complex modules, driving technical reviews, architectural decision records (ADRs), and enforcing best-in-class engineering benchmarks across teams.
* **Strategic Advisory & Collaboration:** Interface directly with client CTOs, Enterprise Architects, Data Scientists, and Business Consultants to articulate solution blueprints, trade-offs, and value delivery for mission-critical Data & AI ecosystems.
* **Mentorship & Capability Building:** Mentor senior data engineers and designers, establish reusable GenAI design patterns and accelerator frameworks, and spearhead organizational center-of-excellence (CoE) initiatives.

* **Architecture & System Design:** Enterprise Solution Architecture, HLD/LLD, Modern Data Lakehouse, Data Mesh, Medallion Architecture, Event-Driven Architecture, Cost Optimization & Sizing
* **Generative AI & LLMOps (Mandatory):** Azure OpenAI, Databricks Mosaic AI, LangChain, LlamaIndex, RAG Architecture, Vector DBs (Chroma, Pinecone, FAISS, Qdrant), Embeddings, Prompt Engineering, Model Evaluation, Guardrails
* **Core Cloud & Platform:** Microsoft Azure, Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Synapse Analytics
* **Data Engineering & Languages:** Python, PySpark, Apache Spark, SQL, Structured Streaming
* **Data Governance & Security:** Unity Catalog, Purview, Data Lineage, RBAC/ABAC, Data Privacy & Security Guardrails

  

Who We Are

Tiger Analytics is a global leader in AI and analytics, helping Fortune 1000 companies solve their toughest challenges. Our team of 4000+ technologists and consultants are based in the US, Canada, the UK, India, Singapore, and Australia, working closely with clients across CPG, Retail, Insurance, BFS, Manufacturing, Life Sciences, and Healthcare. 02e16c18.title: Director Principal Architect (AWS)
02e16c18.description:
**Job Description: AWS Field CTO**

Role Overview: We are seeking a highly strategic and experienced AWS Field CTO to lead our AWS practice and technology initiatives. In this role, you will serve as the primary technical evangelist, strategist, and solution architect for our AWS partnership. You will be responsible for driving offering and solution build, establishing thought leadership, accelerating internal engineering capabilities, and enabling presales, with a heavy emphasis on modern AWS data, analytics, and Generative AI technologies—specifically Amazon Bedrock, Amazon QuickSight, AWS Lake Formation, AWS Glue, and Amazon Redshift.

**Core Responsibilities**

Offering & Solution Build

* Solution Ideation & Design: Conceptualize, design, and build innovative, enterprise-ready solutions on the AWS cloud stack, leveraging AWS Lake Formation and Amazon Redshift for unified data lakes/warehouses, and Amazon QuickSight for business intelligence.
* Tools & Accelerator Build: Develop proprietary tools, frameworks, and accelerators using AWS Generative AI services (e.g., Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q, SageMaker JumpStart) to accelerate time-to-value for clients.
* Product Management: Collaborate with internal Studio and Product engineering teams to build, manage, and evolve AWS-centric offerings and repeatable solution blueprints.
* GTM Content & Collateral: Create compelling, partner-centric Go-To-Market materials, including technical content decks, battle cards, and solution briefs highlighting the ROI of AWS data and AI solutions.
* Solution Endorsement: Engage directly with AWS Partner Solution Architects and Partner Development Managers (PDMs) to secure official solution endorsement and joint GTM support.

**Thought Leadership**

* Public Speaking & Evangelism: Represent the company at major AWS events (e.g., AWS re-Invent, AWS Summits, Partner Forums), speaking on topics like cloud-native data architecture, modern analytics, and enterprise Gen AI adoption.
* Content Creation: Author and publish joint webinars, tech blogs, and whitepapers with AWS, showcasing success stories and cutting-edge implementations of Amazon Bedrock and QuickSight.
* POV Creation: Develop authoritative, partner-centric Points of View (POVs) on industry trends, serverless architectures, and how AWS technologies solve complex enterprise challenges.
* Mindshare Expansion: Actively cultivate and expand AWS mindshare both internally among consulting teams and externally across the ecosystem.

**Capability Acceleration**

* Product Roadmap Influence: Engage with AWS service teams and product managers to provide field feedback and influence product roadmaps for Bedrock, QuickSight, and AWS data services based on client requirements.
* Knowledge Community & COE: Establish and lead a Center of Excellence (COE) and internal community of practice focused on AWS Cloud, Data, and AI technologies.
* Innovation & POCs: Spearhead Proofs of Technology (POTs) and Proofs of Concept (POCs) on emerging AWS services and features (e.g., Bedrock agentic workflows, QuickSight Q, serverless analytics).
* Talent & Certification: Drive AWS certification programs across the practice. Onboard, mentor, and elevate technical talent across cloud engineering and data architecture disciplines.
* Partner Differentiation: Lead technical audits and assessments required to achieve and maintain key AWS Competencies (e.g., Data & Analytics, Generative AI, Migration) to differentiate our practice.

**Presales & Tech Enablement**

* Sales Enablement: Train and empower account executives and sales teams on pitching AWS offerings, positioning the strategic value of AWS Data and Gen AI services.
* AWS Professional Services Alignment: Establish joint engagement strategies and align closely with AWS Professional Services (ProServe) on strategic enterprise accounts.
* Presales Support: Provide high-impact presales architectural support on key pursuits, leading complex customer discovery sessions and technical proposals.
* Consumption & Cost Estimation: Architect cost-effective AWS solutions and prepare precise AWS Pricing Calculator estimates for large-scale data and AI workloads.
* Deal Expansion: Identify opportunities to expand client engagements by introducing new AWS services and modernization roadmaps.
* Delivery Oversight: Conduct delivery reviews and provide high-level technical governance for critical AWS client implementations.

**Qualifications**

* 15+ years of overall experience in IT architecture, software engineering, enterprise cloud architecture, or technical leadership roles.
* 5+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience designing and building solutions specifically on Amazon Web Services (AWS).
* Proven experience operating as a Field CTO, Chief Architect, or Enterprise Solution Architect within the AWS ecosystem or a top-tier AWS Consulting Partner.
* Deep technical expertise in AWS Data & Analytics services (AWS Lake Formation, AWS Glue, Amazon Redshift, Amazon EMR, Amazon QuickSight).
* Hands-on experience and strong architectural knowledge of AWS Generative AI and ML services (Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Q, Vector Databases).
* Track record of public speaking, technical writing, and driving thought leadership in cloud technologies.
* Strong presales capability, with experience building AWS consumption models and driving deal closure.
* Relevant AWS Certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate, or AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty) are highly preferred.

dff96c0d.title: Oracle Cloud Inventory & Costing Lead

Overview:
  
At Peloton, we don't just implement technology. We transform the way organizations work, compete, and grow. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in the US, Peloton is one of the most respected and fastest-growing global Oracle consulting firms, delivering Advisory, Consulting, and Managed Services to leading organizations across many industries, including Retail, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Consumer Packaged Goods, and more.
  
  
Peloton Consulting Group has the vision and connected global capabilities to help organizations envision, implement, and realize the benefits of digital transformation. Our team has the best practices, knowledge, industry expertise, and know-how. We make digital transformation a reality by leveraging AI, Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Supply Chain Management (SCM), Human Capital Management (HCM), Customer Experience (CX), Analytics, and Data Management for the cloud. Through connected capabilities, we bring people, processes, and technology together. We help organizations go further faster. That is the Peloton way!
  
  
What truly sets us apart is our people. We are team players. We are energetic and entrepreneurial. We are problem solvers and innovative thinkers who believe the best outcomes are built together. We believe in quality, appreciate creativity, recognize individual contributions, and place trust in every member of our team. If you bring strong business or technical expertise and want to do meaningful work alongside people who are equally passionate about getting it right, we think you'll feel right at home here.
  
  
Peloton is seeking an Oracle Cloud SCM Workstream Lead with deep expertise in Inventory and Cost Management to support large-scale Oracle Cloud implementations. This role is responsible for leading the Inventory and Costing workstream, driving solution design, and ensuring successful delivery aligned with client business objectives.
  
As an Oracle Cloud SCM Lead, you will partner with supply chain and finance stakeholders to design and implement solutions that improve inventory visibility, valuation accuracy, and operational efficiency.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
Workstream Leadership & Delivery
  
- Lead the Inventory and Costing workstream across the full project lifecycle (requirements through deployment)
  
- Own solution design, configuration, and delivery for Inventory Management and Cost Management modules
  
- Manage workstream scope, risks, issues, and dependencies
  
Process Assessment & Solution Design
  
- Assess current-state inventory and costing processes and identify improvement opportunities
  
- Design future-state solutions aligned with Oracle Cloud best practices
  
- Define and refine business processes across areas such as: - Inventory transactions and controls
  
- Inventory valuation and costing methods (Standard, Average, FIFO, Actual)
  
- Cost accounting and subledger integration
  
  
Requirements Gathering & Configuration
  
- Lead workshops to gather and document business requirements
  
- Translate requirements into functional designs and system configurations
  
- Ensure alignment between business needs and Oracle Cloud capabilities
  
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
- Partner with Finance, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Order Management teams to ensure end-to-end process integration
  
- Align Inventory and Costing with upstream and downstream processes (e.g., Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Record-to-Report)
  
Client Advisory & Stakeholder Engagement
  
- Serve as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders on inventory and costing strategies
  
- Communicate effectively with both business and technical audiences
  
- Provide recommendations to improve operational efficiency and financial accuracy
  
Testing, Deployment & Support
  
- Lead testing activities (SIT/UAT), including scenario design and validation
  
- Support deployment, cutover planning, and post-go-live stabilization
  
Practice Development
  
- Contribute to continuous improvement of Peloton methodologies, accelerators, and intellectual property
  
- Mentor junior team members and support capability development
  
  
Required Qualifications & Experience:
  
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Supply Chain, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  
- 7+ years of experience in Oracle SCM Cloud implementations
  
- Strong functional expertise in:- Inventory Management Cloud
  
- Cost Management Cloud
  
  
- Experience with costing methods such as:- Standard Costing
  
- Average Costing
  
- FIFO / Actual Costing
  
  
- Experience leading at least one full lifecycle Oracle Cloud SCM implementation
  
- Strong understanding of inventory processes, costing, and accounting impacts
  
- Ability to translate business requirements into system solutions
  
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills
  
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  
- Ability to work independently in a remote, client-facing environment
  
- Alignment with Peloton values: Amplify Ideas, Can-Do Attitude, Teamwork, Integrity, Own Your Voice, and Next-Level Service
  
- Willingness to travel as required
  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications:
  
- Oracle Cloud certifications in Inventory Management and/or Cost Management
  
  
- Experience across broader SCM modules (e.g., Procurement, Order Management, Manufacturing, Planning)
  
  
- Understanding of financial integration points (e.g., subledger accounting, GL impact)
  
  
- Experience supporting multi-pillar Oracle Cloud implementations (ERP + SCM)
  
  
- Experience mentoring junior team members
  
  
  
Compensation:
  
Peloton provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, business needs, and geographic location. Peloton also offer bonus opportunities and a comprehensive benefits package including:
  
  
- Competitive base salary with performance-based bonus
  
- Vacation, Leave, and Holiday pay
  
- Annual Health Wallet
  
- Group Medical Insurance
  
- Group Term Accident & Life Insurance
  
- Paid holidays and PTO
  
  
Peloton Group is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

**Transformation Architect specializing in Data**
to lead the transformation of large-scale enterprise delivery programs for strategic clients. This role is ideal for a hands-on, client-facing architecture leader who can translate business challenges into modern data, analytics, and AI solutions.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience across
**enterprise data architecture, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, ETL/data integration, Azure Data Factory (ADF), AI/BI, and Azure/AWS cloud environments,**
along with the executive presence to consult with clients, shape solution roadmaps, and lead transformation from strategy through implementation.

**What You Will Do**

l Serve as a
**client-facing Data Solution Architect,**
partnering with client executives, technology leaders, data teams, and delivery organizations to define and execute enterprise data transformation strategies.

**modernization roadmaps across data platforms, analytics, AI, cloud, and data engineering.**

**data platforms and pipelines using technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure, and AWS.**

**data ingestion, ETL/ELT, lakehouse architectures, data warehousing, analytics, BI, and AI use cases.**

**cloud-based data ecosystems.**

**AI, advanced analytics, and BI**
to improve decision-making, automation, productivity, and customer experience.

l Data modeling, ingestion, transformation, and consumption

**Azure and AWS**

l AI/BI strategy and architecture

l Generative AI and AI-enabled analytics

l Power BI and enterprise visualization

l Enabling AI/ML use cases through modern, governed data platforms

l Translating enterprise data into actionable business insights

**Delivery Transformation**

l Modernization of large-scale enterprise delivery environments.

l Global and offshore delivery models.

l Automation and productivity improvement.

l Governance, quality, security, and operational excellence.

**Core Skills & Experience**

**Data Architecture & Engineering**

l Strong experience designing
**enterprise-scale data architectures and modern data platforms .**

l Hands-on architectural experience with
**Microsoft Fabric and/or Databricks.**

l Deep understanding of
**ETL/ELT processes, data integration, data pipelines, and orchestration.**

l Experience designing and modernizing
**Azure Data Factory (ADF) pipelines.**

l Understanding of modern architectural patterns including
**lakehouse, data lake, and data warehouse architectures.**

l Experience integrating structured and unstructured data across multiple enterprise systems.

**Cloud**

l Strong experience with
**Microsoft Azure,**
particularly Azure-based data services.

l Experience working with
**AWS data environments**
and/or designing multi-cloud solutions.

l Experience migrating legacy data platforms and workloads to cloud-based architectures.

**AI, Analytics & BI**

l Experience designing data platforms that support
**AI, machine learning, GenAI, advanced analytics, and BI use cases**

l Strong understanding of how enterprise data architectures enable AI adoption

l Experience with
**Power BI and/or Tableau**

l Ability to connect technical data strategy to measurable business outcomes

**Architecture & Delivery**

l Experience designing integrations using APIs, microservices, and enterprise data services

l Understanding of DevOps/DataOps, CI/CD, observability, security, and data governance

l Ability to take solutions from
**discovery and architecture through POC, implementation, and enterprise-scale adoption**

**Qualifications**

**l 8+ years of experience**
in solution architecture, data architecture, data engineering, technology consulting, or enterprise transformation roles.

l Demonstrated experience architecting
**large-scale enterprise data and analytics solutions.**

l Strong experience with
**Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, ETL/ELT, ADF/data pipelines, and Azure and/or AWS cloud environments.**

l Experience leading
**data modernization or cloud data transformation initiatives**
from strategy through implementation.

l Strong enterprise consulting and client-facing experience, including the ability to lead discovery sessions and architecture discussions with senior technical and business stakeholders.

l Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations and business value for executive audiences.

l Proven ability to lead cross-functional engineering, architecture, data, and delivery teams.

l Experience delivering measurable improvements across cost, scalability, performance, quality, and customer experience.

**Why This Role**

**data strategy, architecture, AI, and enterprise transformation.**

Nice to Have

b2815d0e.title: Integration Architect
b2815d0e.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**

Configure-Price-Quote (CPQ) Business Process Owner

\_\_

We are seeking an experienced Integration Architect with a strong foundation in **full-stack development, specializing in .NET backend technologies and Microsoft Azure**. The ideal candidate will design scalable and secure solutions while providing technical leadership and aligning architectural strategy with business goals. Guides cross-functional teams through architectural decisions, ensuring technical excellence and innovation.

The preferred Working Model: Hybrid / Remote.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* **Solution Architecture:** Design practical, scalable, and secure solutions using .NET and Microsoft Azure that meet business and product needs.
* **Integration & APIs:** Design and guide integrations between applications, APIs, internal systems, and external solutions to ensure smooth and reliable connectivity.
* **Technical Guidance:** Provide technical guidance to development teams across .NET, front-end, database, and cloud technologies, helping teams make sound technical decisions.
* **Azure Solutions:** Design and improve Azure-based solutions with a focus on performance, reliability, security, scalability, and cost effectiveness.
* **DevOps & Engineering Practices:** Support good engineering practices including CI/CD, containerization, infrastructure as code, coding standards, and technical documentation.
* **Architecture & Security Standards:** Ensure solutions follow relevant architecture, security, data privacy, and development standards while keeping governance practical and effective.
* **Cross-Team Collaboration:** Work closely with internal teams and external partners to manage technical dependencies, address challenges, and support successful delivery.
* **Stakeholder Partnership:** Collaborate with Product Owners, business stakeholders, UX, and engineering teams to turn business requirements into effective technical solutions and support the long-term product vision.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Around 7+ years of relevant experience in software development, solution architecture, integration architecture, or technical leadership within enterprise environments.
* Strong experience with C#/.NET, ASP.NET Core, Microsoft Azure, and designing modern, scalable applications and APIs.
* Good understanding of system integrations, microservices, event-driven architecture, databases, and modern front-end technologies such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Familiarity with DevOps and cloud engineering practices, including CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, and infrastructure as code; experience modernizing existing or legacy applications is an advantage.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product Owners, development teams, business stakeholders, and external partners in a global environment.
* Knowledge of Salesforce CPQ / CLM are preferred.

You don’t need to meet every requirement to apply. If you have .NET and Azure experience and enjoy designing solutions and collaborating across teams, we encourage you to apply.

This opportunity is open to candidates in one or more countries covered by the European Pay Transparency Directive. The final work location will depend on the selected candidate. As pay may vary by location, compensation details will be shared with candidates who progress to the first interview stage.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit **https://www.abb.com** to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

* Working knowledge of Python, Lambda, Ansible and Terraform.
* Experience with GitLab, CI/CD pipelines, automation and Jira.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical and client communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

* AWS, EDB or CKA certifications.
* Graduate in Computer Science, IT or Engineering.

4a6486dc.title: Managed Services Consultant
4a6486dc.description:
### **About ITRS**

At ITRS, we make society’s critical technology work. Our mission is to deliver automated and holistic IT observability solutions that safeguard critical applications and enable innovation. We are the only monitoring and observability platform designed for the most demanding and regulated industries — trusted by 90% of Tier 1 capital markets firms.

We believe when our team thrives, so do our customers. With us, you’ll find:

* **A culture that backs you** – We’re proud to be a Great Place to Work for multiple years in a row due to our inclusive, supportive environment.
* **Work that matters** – Make a real difference with 1,000s of global customers in industries that keep the world running, including 9 out of 10 top investment banks.
* **Room to grow** – Whether you're starting your career or bringing years of experience, we’re committed to your development. Just ask our team members who’ve been excelling here for 10+ years.

With headquarters in London and teams across the US, Europe, and Asia, ITRS combines the agility of a high-impact tech business with the stability of a private equity–backed global partner.

### **Scope of Role**

Our clients choose Managed Services to ensure Geneos is kept up to date, operational and correctly configured. We also work with our clients to ensure their monitoring is taken to a higher advancement level, to allow them to get the most value out of the product.

Reporting to our Service Delivery Manager, our Managed Service team monitors all ITRS components in our client environment to ensure they are up and operational. We respond to client queries on how to use the product, requests to make changes and configuration requests where the client requires. Also, we perform project work which includes upgrading and enhancing the client’s Geneos environment. We also work with our on-site team members who are based in Singapore and Mumbai working onsite our client premises.

### **As a Managed Services Consultant, you will:**

* **Monitor** ITRS components in our client environment and resolve issues to ensure uptime and Client SLAs are met.
* **Answer Client Queries** providing clients with the information they need to use ITRS products and implementing changes to deliver the latest monitoring for the client.
* **Restore Client Incidents** by investigating and resolving issues with ITRS components in our client environment with assistance.
* **Perform root cause analysis** using problem analysis methodology to assess and diagnose underlying causes of recurring Incidents
* **Hands-on implementation of technical solutions** to permanently fix reccuring incidents.
* **Monitor progress on the resolution of Known Errors** and ensure best available workaround for Incidents are documented and communicated.
* **Fulfil Client Configuration Requests** by gathering requirements and helping our client configure Geneos implementing within client SLA.
* **Document and share information** by updating the knowledge base to provide accurate troubleshooting for the Managed Services team.
* **Provide ideas and suggestions** improve products, services, or processes.

**Performance is measured through regular quarterly appraisals with your line manager to include a review of the following:**

* Quality of client communication by providing concise information to the client.

* Quality of work to the client by meeting our defined standards including quality checks.
* Client satisfaction and feedback of your work.
* Positive contribution to the Managed Service workload by meeting the targets set by your line manager.
* Meet your ticket response and resolution time SLA.
* Meet Geneos uptime SLA by monitoring and resolving incidents.
* Expectation to perform according to our behaviour and values

 **Requirements**  

### **You will have:**

* Minimum 3 years’ experience working in a client-facing environment preferably in a financial institution or vendor and preferably in an IT Operations role.
* Excellent written and oral English communication skills.
* Passionate about our client experience.
* Experience in Unix and Windows Operating Systems.
* Experience in one or more scripting languages such as Shell, Bash, Perl, XML.
* An understanding of Databases e.g. Oracle and an understanding of SQL.
* Willingness to work onsite at either our Pune or Mumbai office and flexibility to work on a rotational shift schedule, including night shifts as required.

### **A person in this role would benefit from the following:**

* Experience using or administering a real-time monitoring tool, e.g. Geneos, BMC Patrol, AppDynamics, Nagios.
* Exposure to an ITIL Operations environment.
* Experience of Application Support in Financial Services.
Deliver continuous improvement  

  
  
**Benefits**  

* Health insurance with Care
* Provident Fund
* Group personal accident policy
* Generous leave entitlements

ITRS is an Equal Opportunity employer and Inclusion is part of our everyday life. We celebrate diversity and pride ourselves on providing an environment where all employees can be their authentic selves and have a voice, allowing everyone to contribute equally. We remain committed to advocating inclusion, diversity, and equality into our ITRS family as we grow and enrich our business.

We welcome applications from everyone in the community as we recognise that a diverse workforce is a stronger workforce.

d86ddf82.title: Success Architect - Industry Specific
d86ddf82.description:
**Apply here :**

https://salesforce.wd12.myworkdayjobs.com/External\_Career\_Site/job/India---Hyderabad/Salesforce-Senior-Architect\_JR322959

  

Cloud Success is a specialized team within Customer Success, bringing together technical architects, customer support engineers, and product advisors. This team delivers expert guidance on optimizing and demonstrating Salesforce technology to drive long-term business success, in addition to resolving technical issues.

Success Architects are a pivotal part of the Cloud Success team, supporting Salesforces most critical and strategic customers. They provide expert guidance on solution design, focusing on scalability, security, and adherence to standard methodologies. By assessing system performance, they help to optimize efficiency and reliability while proactively identifying risks and recommending improvements to maintain technical health. Success Architects empower businesses to maximize their Salesforce investment by aligning technology with core business goals.

The Industry Success Architect collaborates across Customer Success and the Product organization to drive long-term customer solutions. This includes resolving immediate technical challenges with support engineers while identifying root causes, partnering with customer success managers on strategic guidance and long-term technology health, and liaising with product teams to surface customer feedback for product improvements.

Key Responsibilities:

As an Industry Success Architect, you will specialize in multiple Industry Clouds with primary, secondary, and tertiary areas of expertise. You will:

* Drive Customer Impact - Partner with our most strategic and high-priority customers, assessing their Industry Cloud implementations and delivering expert recommendations on technical architecture, solution design, application lifecycle management, reliability, and feature adoption.
* Lead with Multi-Cloud Expertise - Serve as a trusted Subject Matter Expert (SME) in your designated Industry Clouds, providing both proactive and reactive guidance on architecture, technology strategy, thought leadership, and product best practices. You will help the team stay at the forefront of Industry Cloud innovations, ensuring they are equipped with the latest product developments and emerging trends.
* Communicate with Clarity - Simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, from technical teams to executive leadership, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor in key business and technology discussions.
* Innovate & Solve Problems - Identify capability gaps and design inefficiencies, recommending product enhancements or creative custom solutions that drive customer success and long-term adoption.
* Execute Proven Strategies - Leverage and tailor Success Architect playbooks to meet the unique challenges and opportunities of your Industry Cloud customers.
* Build Strong Relationships - Collaborate with internal and external partners, fostering connections that drive customer success, product improvement, and overall business growth.
* Lead enterprise success strategy with an AI First mindset using Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, and AI-powered analytics as primary tools for designing, modeling, and continuously optimizing customer success programs
* Apply generative AI to develop executive-level deliverables including strategic business reviews, value realization frameworks, and multi-stakeholder success plans with strong human judgment applied to business context and executive narrative
* Leverage AI-generated portfolio insights to identify whitespace opportunities, adoption barriers, and risk indicators, driving strategic recommendations and C-level alignment
* Serve as an internal thought leader and practitioner on AI-augmented success practices defining standards, playbooks, and governance for AI tool usage in partnership with CS leadership

**Required Multi-Cloud Aptitude:**

We are looking for individuals with expertise spanning multiple Industry Clouds (Primary, Secondary, and Tertiary) from the following list. Prioritization of these clouds is geographically diverse, but we are primarily seeking skills in:

* Life Sciences Cloud
* Financial Services Cloud
* Loyalty Cloud

**Basic Requirements:**

**1. Solution Design & Architecture**

* 8+ years of experience in software, system, or enterprise architecture.
* Expertise in Salesforce products, platform capabilities, technical governance, and best practices.
* Experience with large-scale, complex implementations, including SaaS, PaaS, multi-tenancy, and multi-tiered infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise application integration, covering process orchestration, master data management, AI, analytics, and security best practices.

**2. Communication & Leadership**

* Ability to assess business objectives, propose solution options, and drive stakeholder alignment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and executive audiences.
* Skilled in creating clear, visually compelling design documents for diverse stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead discussions, influence decision-making, and advocate for best practices.

**3. Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving**

* Ability to identify design inefficiencies, recommend optimizations, and drive customer transformation.
* Provide data-driven insights on customer success stories and industry trends.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies.
* Deep, demonstrated AI First experience in a senior or strategic customer-facing role, with hands-on use of Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, or equivalent AI-powered success platforms
* Ability to synthesize AI-generated insights into executive-ready narratives and strategic recommendations, demonstrating strong business and commercial acumen
* Experience defining or contributing to AI usage frameworks, governance policies, or AI fluency enablement programs within a CS or professional services organization
* Strong consultative skills with the ability to guide enterprise customers on leveraging Salesforce AI capabilities to achieve their own business outcomes and ROI

**Desired Technical Skills:**

* Secure & Scalable Architecture: Expertise in role hierarchy, sharing rules, profiles, permission sets, and security configurations. Proven ability to design scalable, high-performance architectures aligned with Salesforce best practices, including Large Data Volume (LDV) considerations.
* Salesforce Development: Hands-on experience with APEX programming, JavaScript, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components (LWC). Familiarity with governor limits and best practices for efficient code execution.
* Data Management & Integration: Proficient in designing and managing data models, validation rules, and data governance best practices. Experience with data import/export, ETL tools, and integrating Salesforce with external systems via REST/SOAP APIs and middleware (e.g., MuleSoft).
* System Integration & Extensibility: Strong understanding of integrating Salesforce with other enterprise systems using APIs, middleware, and event-driven architectures. Experience working with OAuth, Platform Events, External Objects, and tools like Salesforce Connect.

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
  
  
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
  
  
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
  
  
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
  
  
The Role
  
  
The Solution Consultant / Senior Solution Consultant is a customer-facing member of the Veeva Quality Solution Consulting organization responsible for translating life sciences quality and manufacturing needs into compelling, value-driven Veeva Quality solutions. The role partners closely with Account Partners, Customers, Prospects and cross-functional Veeva teams throughout the sales cycle—from discovery and qualification through solution design, demonstrations, workshops, RFP/RFI responses, proof-of-concepts and executive engagement.
  
  
The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor to Quality leaders and business stakeholders, combining domain knowledge, solution expertise, consultative selling and strong communication skills to help customers modernize quality processes and realize measurable business value from Veeva's cloud platform.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Understand customer business objectives, quality processes, pain points and transformation priorities.
* Translate business and regulatory requirements into practical, differentiated Veeva Quality solution approaches.
* Create and deliver compelling demonstrations that show how Veeva Quality can improve compliance, efficiency, accountability and user experience.
* Lead consultative engagements—including discovery workshops, solution workshops, conference room pilots and proof-of-concepts—to demonstrate business value.
* Support the sales team in progressing opportunities, strengthening executive relationships and increasing confidence in Veeva as the preferred strategic partner.
* Bring market, industry and competitive insight into account strategy and solution positioning.

**Requirements**

* 5+ years overall experience including 3+ years of Solution Consultant experience in Pharma/Biotech, MedTech, Diagnostics or another relevant regulated industry.
* Experience in pre-sales and solution consulting customer-facing role within a software or technology organization.
* Strong understanding of Quality and/or Manufacturing operations in life sciences.
* Working knowledge of Cloud and SaaS applications, life sciences business processes and digital transformation concepts.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, interpersonal, facilitation and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Willingness to travel approximately 20–30% of time within India.

* English and Hindi proficiency; familiarity with relevant regional languages is an advantage.

****Nice to Have****

* Experience with software solutions used by Quality Assurance and Manufacturing organizations in Pharma/Biotech, MedTech or Diagnostics.
* Hands-on knowledge of one or more enterprise applications such as QMS, DMS, LMS, VMS or LIMS.
* Experience with SaaS/cloud technology and enterprise software platforms.
* Consulting, business analysis or software implementation experience.
* Previous experience with Veeva applications, including Quality, Regulatory, Clinical or Safety.
* Experience in competitive software evaluations and legacy-system replacement programs.
* Strong teamwork and willingness to contribute to broader team goals.

**Perks & Benefits**

* Health & wellness programs
* Life Assurance

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Advisory Solution Consultant, Core Business Solutions is an expert pre‑sales professional who combines deep domain expertise across Core Business workflows (for example, HR Service Delivery, Workplace Service Delivery, Legal and Contract Operations, Finance and Procurement–related solutions) with advanced consultative selling skills. The Advisory Solution Consultant is a lead contributor in the Solution Consulting organization, a trusted advisor to customers and partners, and a mentor to other Solution Consultants. This role works closely with Sales to build and execute account penetration strategies in a defined market vertical and maintains strong external networks with customers and technology partners to identify and shape market opportunities. This is a hands-on technical consultant who can go wide and deep on solution delivery and solution positioning during sales cycles.
  
  
**What You Get To Do In This Role**

* Partner with Account Executives and broader account teams to develop and execute account penetration strategies for Core Business Solutions in a defined territory or vertical.
* Lead discovery sessions with customers to understand business objectives, challenges, and current processes across HR, Workplace, Legal, Finance, Procurement, and supplier management operations, and translate them into Core Business Solution opportunities.
* Design solution architectures and value‑based proposals on the Now Platform that align Core Business workflows to customer business outcomes, including cross‑workflow and cross‑platform scenarios.
* Deliver compelling, story‑driven product demonstrations and presentations that articulate the vision, value, and differentiation of ServiceNow Core Business Solutions to both executive and technical audiences.
* Lead complex pre‑sales engagements, including RFP responses, proof‑of‑concepts, and workshops, ensuring proposed solutions are feasible, scalable, and aligned with ServiceNow leading practices.
* Build and maintain strong, long‑term relationships with key customer stakeholders as a trusted advisor on Core Business transformation and the Now Platform.
* Develop and maintain relationships with Product Management and Development to provide field feedback, influence roadmap, and stay ahead on new capabilities across Core Business Solutions.
* Maintain an active external network with customers, partners, and industry communities to identify emerging trends, shape ServiceNow’s point of view, and uncover new market opportunities.
* Contribute to internal enablement, reusable assets, and best practices (e.g., demo scenarios, discovery frameworks, industry use cases) specific to Core Business Solutions.

**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* To be successful in this role you have:
* 8+ years of pre-sales solution consulting or sales engineering experience or similar customer‑facing role (e.g., solution consulting, value engineering, product management with heavy customer engagement), ideally in SaaS or enterprise software.
* Deep domain expertise in at least one Core Business area (for example, HR Service Delivery, Workplace/Facilities, Legal and Contract Operations, Finance operations, Sourcing and Procurement, or Supplier Lifecycle operations), with the ability to credibly engage with senior business stakeholders.
* Proven track record designing and presenting end‑to‑end solutions that drive measurable business outcomes and value for customers.
* Strong consultative skills, including discovery, qualification, objection handling, and executive communication.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex pre‑sales cycles collaboratively with Sales and cross‑functional teams.
* Excellent presentation, storytelling, and demo skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and tailor messages to different audiences.
* Ability to work in a fast‑paced, matrixed, global environment and manage multiple priorities and opportunities in parallel.
* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* Travel, as necessary

**Success in This Role**

* Positive impact on pipeline creation and progression for Core Business opportunities.
* Win rate and deal quality for opportunities where you are engaged.
* Demonstrated mentorship and uplift of the broader Solution Consulting team.

FD21

**Job Description**
F5 gives the world’s largest businesses, service providers, governments, and consumer brands the ability to securely deliver every app, anywhere—with confidence. We do this by working collaboratively in an innovative environment, helping each other succeed. We take great pride in being trusted advisers to our customers, offering the best solutions for their interests. If our mission and culture excite you, we would love to talk to you!
  
  
**The SE Job Overview:**
The Solutions Engineer (SE) is a sales and technical role with focus on customer/partners and is part of the sales organization. The SE’s primary responsibility is to support the sales team with technical skills and provide technical knowledge around F5 solutions to our customers. To be effective, an SE needs to have excellent technical skills and knowledge on both F5 products and the “eco-system” that we work in. Fear not, we do provide training and certification to keep abreast with these critical skills!
  
  
The high-level objective is to achieve the allocated sales target and selling relevant F5 solutions and products to our customers business needs, in partnership with the Sales Account Manager. From our customer(s) perspective, the SE is a trusted adviser who proactively learns and understands their technical and business challenges and is able to propose effective solutions to mitigate their concerns/offer gainful solutions. The F5 SE not only presents the technical features but also business benefits in the Technical Value Proposition.

* Articulate the F5 product strategy, messaging and positioning F5’s value proposition and solutions for customer business objectives
* Provide technical expertise through sales presentations, solution designs, solution demonstrations, proof of concepts by various mediums – in-person/virtual presentations, white boards etc
* Determine viability of opportunity and map out organizational structure.
* Drive the sales process in partnership with the Account Manager, by identifying the Technical Decision Maker, getting their technical validation, support, and sponsorship.
* Consistently provide world-class customer service through the customer life cycle
* Work collaboratively with internal technical and sales resources, share best practices, updates, offer and seek expertise as the need arises in various opportunities.

* Experience in secure Cloud architectures, Security product like WAF, ZTNA, Firewall, SSL VPN
* Experience with public/private cloud vendors and automation toolsets, basic CI/CD understanding.
* Experience with SaaS vendor and able to articulate SaaS benefits
* Experience with container orchestration solutions (eg: OpenShift, Kubernetes)
* Proficient in one or more programming languages will be added advantage, good understanding of routing, switching, virtualization

* 10+ years of related industry experience with FSI & Enterprise background
* 6+ years of experience in a similar customer facing technical role
* Familiarity/experience with F5 or similar industry solution deployment a plus

Your contributions to the change management process will ensure thorough documentation, effective planning and execution of maintenance activities, and compliance with standard procedures.

1276d865.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing role.
* Experience in architecting solutions that integrate AI models using agents with enterprise data sources using patterns like RAG, Text-to-SQL, and semantic search.
* Experience with coding in Python, JavaScript or TypeScript, Go, or Java, to demo, prototype, or workshop integration patterns with customers.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in developing agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or the Google AI Agent Development Kit (ADK).
* Experience with cloud technologies including SaaS applications, iPaaS, business automation solutions, cloud infrastructure, agentic AI, and cloud networking.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
* Knowledge of integration patterns using OpenAPI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect AI agents with business systems and Application Programming Interface (API) gateways.
* Knowledge of observability constructs including distributed tracing, logging, and audit logging for AI applications.

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
As a AI Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to customers. You will serve as a technical expert responsible for accelerating technical wins and adoption of complex, specialized workloads. You will leverage your deep expertise in strategic product areas in partnership with platform CEs, writing code, developing prototypes, proofs-of-concept, and demos to promote new specialized solutions to customers. You will solve AI-centered customer issues and provide a critical feedback loop to influence product development.
  
  
It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive the technical solution for complex workloads within AI product areas to ensure rapid and successful adoption, primarily supporting the business cycle from technical evaluation through customer ramp.
* Combine business strategies and direct development and prototyping to provide functional, customer-tailored solutions that secure buy-in from customer domain experts.
* Provide deep technical consultation to customers, acting as a technical advisor and building lasting customer relationships. Leverage learnings from customer engagements to contribute to reusable solutions and assets with the Go-To-Market team.
* Work within product and engineering management systems to document, prioritize, and drive resolution of customer feature requests and issues.
* Travel to customer sites, conferences, and other related events as required, acting as a public advocate for Google Cloud.
