3bb75979.title: Senior Infrastructure & Cloud Architect
3bb75979.description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  

Could you be the full-time Compute & Cloud Architect in Bangalore we’re looking for?

**Your future role**

Take on a new challenge and apply your cloud and infrastructure expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside innovative and collaborative teammates.

You'll play a critical role in shaping the Alstom Transport strategy, designing compute and cloud services—especially public cloud services—and ensuring seamless integration of business solutions within Alstom’s infrastructure landscape. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (such as IS&T Business Partners, Projects, and Operations), evaluate new technologies, and contribute to strategic roadmaps, among other responsibilities.

  

You’ll specifically take care of designing and promoting public cloud services, but also providing technical assistance for business solutions within Alstom’s IT environment.

We’ll look to you for:
  
Responsible for designing, governing, and optimizing cloud architectures across public, private, and hybrid environments. This role ensures that cloud solutions are secure, scalable, cost-efficient, and aligned with business and enterprise architecture standards.
  
Acts as a technical leader, trusted advisor for stakeholders, and mentor for cloud and platform teams.

* Collecting and analyzing business demands from IS&T Business Partners
* Evaluating and integrating new technology solutions into strategic roadmaps
* Initiating and contributing to projects identified in strategic roadmaps
* Defining the service catalog and technological standards roadmap
* Participating in IS&T innovation initiatives
* Define and govern Kubernetes architectures ( AKS, OKE, OpenShift) Establish cloud-native architectural patterns
* Contributing to and validating project scoping, general design, and business cases
* Providing technical assistance and expertise in adopting public cloud services
* Collaborating with the global Compute & Cloud team to consolidate infrastructure strategies
  

**All about you**

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

Define cloud architecture solutions for complex enterprise systems
  
Design scalable, resilient, and secure architectures across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS
  
Lead architectural decisions for cloud migrations, modernizations, and cloud-native initiatives
  
Establish reference architectures, patterns, and standards

**Technology Leadership**

Provide expertise and Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend adoption strategies
  
Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, security, and compliance frameworks

**Security, Governance & Compliance**

Integrate security-by-design principles (IAM, encryption, network security, zero trust)
  
Ensure compliance with regulatory and corporate requirements (ISO, GDPR, etc.)
  
Define cloud governance models (landing zones, guardrails, cost controls)

**Delivery & Transformation**

Partner with application, infrastructure, and DevOps teams to deliver cloud solutions
  
Support large-scale cloud migration and transformation programs
  
Review and approve architectural designs and technical roadmaps
  
Optimize cloud cost management (FinOps best practices)

**Stakeholder Management**

Collaborate with business leaders to translate requirements into cloud solutions
  
Present architectural decisions to executive and technical stakeholders
  
Work closely with vendors, system integrators, and cloud service providers

* Degree in Engineering, preferably in Information Technology.
* Overall 10+ yrs, More than 5 years of experience in Architecture, with a focus on hosting and cloud services
* Certification as an Azure Solution Architect (AZ305) is mandatory
* Proficiency in scripting languages such as PowerShell, Shell, Bash, Ansible, and Terraform
* Experience with operating systems such as Windows Desktop, RHEL, and Ubuntu
* Familiarity with DevOps tools like GitLab CI, Azure DevOps Pipelines, Terraform, Packer, Ansible, Git, and REST API
* Strong communication skills, efficiency, and ability to execute
* Intellectual curiosity, creativity, and a results-oriented mindset
* Fluency in English and eagerness to work autonomously in an international environment

**Things you’ll enjoy** Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

* Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling
* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects
* Utilise our dynamic and flexible working environment
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
* Progress towards advanced leadership or technical roles
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

**Important to note**

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

  

**Job Segment:** Information Technology, IT Architecture, Developer, Solution Architect, Cloud, Technology

b68935fa.title: Bank IN Solution Architecture - VP
b68935fa.description:
Date live: 11/05/2026

Business Area: Customer Digital and Data

Area of Expertise: Technology

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000131567

  

Join us as a Bank IN Solution Architecture – VPat Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.

To be successful as a Bank IN Solution Architecture – VP, you should have experience with:

* Work closely with engineers, QA engineers, UX designers, architects, and Scrum Masters to deliver high-quality software.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Partner with engineering teams to define scalable, secure, and maintainable Android solutions.
* Define architecture, APIs, integrations, and cloud-based services.
* Support release planning and dependency management.
* Ensure product increments deliver measurable business value.

* Develop architecture roadmaps supporting the modernization and strategic evolution of the Core Banking estate.
* Identify opportunities to:
  + Reduce legacy technology risk.
  + Simplify architecture.
  + Reduce technical debt.
  + Improve automation.
  + Increase API enablement.
  + Improve resilience and recoverability.
  + Introduce appropriate cloud and container capabilities.
* Assess build vs buy vs reuse vs vendor-platform options and provide clear architecture recommendations.
* Support incremental modernization strategies that protect critical banking services while reducing transformation risk.
* Ensure near-term project decisions remain aligned with longer-term target architecture.
* Define and assure non-functional requirements covering:
  + Availability
  + Resilience
  + Recoverability
  + Performance
  + Capacity
  + Scalability
  + Security
  + Maintainability
  + Observability
* Assess failure modes and dependencies across Core Banking customer journeys.

* Exp with Fiserv in Core banking and account servicing capabilities, Customer, account, transaction and product integrations.
* Interfaces between Fiserv-based services and digital channels, payments, cards, data and downstream banking platforms.
* Experience with OpenText in Enterprise content and document-management capabilities supporting banking processes.
* Document creation, storage, retrieval, archival and records-management integrations.
* Integration of content-management capabilities with customer and operational journeys.
* TSYS experience with Card-processing and card-servicing capabilities.
* Account, transaction, authorization and servicing integrations.
* Integration between TSYS capabilities and core banking, digital channels, payments and supporting services.
* Define integration patterns between Core Banking platforms.
* Design solutions that minimize blast radius and avoid unnecessary single points of failure.
* Ensure architecture supports effective monitoring, fault diagnosis and operational support.

* Partner with Engineering and Operations teams to investigate complex performance, availability and integration issues.
* Ensure capacity and performance implications are understood before significant production changes.
* Act as the architecture interface between business, product, engineering, operations and enterprise technology teams.
* Technically challenge vendor proposals and ensure proposed solutions meet enterprise architecture requirements.
* Communicate complex architecture decisions clearly to both senior technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Influence stakeholders where immediate delivery objectives conflict with longer-term technology strategy or acceptable risk.
* Provide architecture input into commercial and technology discussions where vendor capability, licensing, infrastructure or product direction impacts strategic decisions.
  

  

Some other highly valued skills may include:

* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.
  

  

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

  
  

This role is based in Bangalore.

**Purpose of the role**

To design, develop, and implement solutions to complex business problems, collaborating with stakeholders to understand their needs and requirements, and design and implement solutions that meet those needs and create solutions that balance technology risks against business delivery, driving consistency.

**Accountabilities**

* Design and development of solutions as products that can evolve, meeting business requirements that align with modern software engineering practices and automated delivery tooling. This includes identification and implementation of the technologies and platforms.
* Targeted design activities that apply an appropriate workload placement strategy and maximise the benefit of cloud capabilities such as elasticity, serverless, containerisation etc.
* Best practice designs incorporating security principles (such as defence in depth and reduction of blast radius) that meet the Bank’s resiliency expectations.
* Solutions that appropriately balance risks and controls to deliver the agreed business and technology value.
* Adoption of standardised solutions where they fit. If no standard solutions fit, feed into their ongoing evolution where appropriate.
* Fault finding and performance issues support to operational support teams, leveraging available tooling.
* Solution design impact assessment in terms of risk, capacity and cost impact, inc. estimation of project change and ongoing run costs.
* Development of the requisite architecture inputs required to comply with the banks governance processes, including design artefacts required for architecture, privacy, security and records management governance processes.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

73144497.title: Senior Solutions Architect
73144497.description:
**Company Description**
Conversive is a demand capture and conversion platform focused on organizations where every customer decision has significant impact. The company helps businesses turn inbound customer inquiries across SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, social channels, and voice into booked appointments, qualified opportunities, and closed deals through AI-orchestrated, compliant conversations. Conversive’s Conversational Harness connects each interaction to customer history, business rules, and CRM data, ensuring seamless, contextual experiences and efficient use of human judgment. Built for high-consideration decisions in sectors such as healthcare, mortgage, education, automotive, and legal, the platform deploys in days or weeks and writes outcomes back to CRM systems for clear revenue attribution. With 18 years of experience serving more than 5,000 organizations, Conversive operates on ISO 27001-certified infrastructure as a native Salesforce ISV and integrates with Zoho and other leading CRMs.

**Role Description**
The Senior Solutions Architect is a full-time, on-site role based in Pune City, responsible for designing and delivering scalable, secure solutions on Conversive’s demand capture and conversion platform. This role involves collaborating with clients and internal stakeholders to understand business requirements, translating them into technical architectures, and leading end-to-end solution design across integrations, data flows, and application components. The Senior Solutions Architect will work closely with product, engineering, and implementation teams to guide software development efforts, validate designs, and ensure solutions align with best practices, performance, and compliance standards. Day-to-day activities include conducting technical discovery and consulting sessions, preparing architectural documentation, overseeing integration with CRM and communication systems, and supporting pre-sales efforts with demos and technical proposals. The role also includes mentoring junior team members, contributing to architecture standards, and continuously improving solution patterns for high-consideration industries.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Solution Architecture skills, including designing scalable, secure, and maintainable enterprise solutions.
* Candidates should possess Consulting and Business Process skills to translate complex requirements into practical architectures and optimized workflows.
* Candidates should possess Software Development skills, with experience in modern programming languages, APIs, and cloud-based application design.
* Candidates should possess Integration skills, including experience with REST/JSON APIs, webhooks, messaging platforms, and CRM integrations (Salesforce, Zoho or similar).
* Relevant experience in customer engagement, contact center, or conversational AI platforms is highly beneficial.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and present technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
* Experience in industries such as healthcare, mortgage, education, automotive, or legal is a plus.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering

01899228.title: Senior Solution Architect - SAP S/4HANA
01899228.description:
**Title:**
Senior Solution Architect, Pre-sales, SAP S/4HANA

**Location:**
India

**Reports to:**
VP SAP S/4HANA Business

**Works with:**
Global Sales leaders, SAP account teams and Acuiti delivery

**Start:**
Immediate

**Who We are:**

Acuiti Labs is an SAP Endorsed Partner with a strong reputation in SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management). We help subscription, usage and consumption based businesses modernise how they monetise, bill and recognise revenue.

We are now launching a dedicated SAP S/4HANA business as a new growth engine. It will operate as a start-up within Acuiti Labs: entrepreneurial and fast moving, with the backing of an established partner's delivery capability, client base, SAP relationships and global footprint.

This is a rare chance to join an SAP practice as one of its founding

members and help shape how it wins in the market. Please visit our website.

https://www.acuitilabs.com/

* ***Most Innovative Companies in The UK, 2024***
* **Great Place to Work® Certified™ (2022 to Present)**

**What we believe in:**

We take pride in having a diverse and talented workforce spread across various geographical locations. We are a gender-neutral organisation and we strongly believe in Diversity and Inclusion. Our core values include:

* **Excellence**
* **Integrity**
* **Learning**
* **Organizational pride**
* **Respect**

**The Role:**

Acuiti Labs is hiring a senior solution architect to lead pre-sales for our new SAP S/4HANA business. You will bring broad S/4HANA solution expertise; good experience in SAP Finance will be a strong advantage.

**The mandate:**

Your job is to help win S/4HANA business. Working alongside the regional sales leader, you will be the trusted solution voice in front of clients: understand their business challenges, design the right S/4HANA solution, and build the proposals, demos and estimates that win the deal.

As a founding member of the practice, you will also build the pre-sales toolkit that others will use: reference architectures, solution collateral, demo scripts and estimating models. Once a deal is won, you will make sure it moves smoothly into delivery with a solution the team can execute well.

**Key responsibilities:**

**Pre-sales and deal support**

* Partner with the regional sales leader on qualified opportunities, from discovery through to contract.
* Lead client discovery workshops with CFOs, CIOs and business leaders to understand their business and process requirements.
* Own the solution response for RFIs, RFPs and proposals, including scope, approach, assumptions, estimates and commercials.
* Plan and deliver compelling solution demonstrations and presentations, including SAP system demos where appropriate.

**Solution architecture**

* Design end-to-end S/4HANA solutions across core business processes, such as finance, order to cash, procure to pay and supply chain.
* Bring good experience in SAP Finance to client conversations where helpful, including financial accounting, controlling, the Universal Journal and financial close.
* Advise clients on the right route to S/4HANA, including RISE with SAP (Private Cloud), GROW with SAP (Public Cloud), and greenfield, brownfield or selective data transition approaches.
* Shape end-to-end architectures covering integration, SAP BTP, data migration and clean core principles.
* Where relevant, connect S/4HANA with order to cash, billing and revenue recognition, including Acuiti's SAP BRIM expertise.
* Establish and evolve Acuiti's S/4HANA architecture principles, reference architectures and design standards, ensuring consistency across opportunities

**Proposition and asset development**

* Help define Acuiti's S/4HANA offerings, including Finance and revenue transformation for complex billing and subscription businesses.
* Build reusable pre-sales assets: reference architectures, solution collateral, demo scripts, estimating models and case studies.

**Expected outcomes**

Onboarded to Acuiti's propositions and BRIM capability; core S/4HANA solution collateral and demo in place; actively supporting pursuits with the sales leader

Months 4 to 6

Leading solution design on qualified opportunities; first S/4HANA win supported; strong working relationships with SAP pre-sales and account teams

Months 7 to 12

Contribution to multiple wins; repeatable pre-sales toolkit of reference architectures, estimators and demo scripts; smooth handover of won deals to delivery; case studies and thought leadership published

**Candidate profile: experience and expertise**

**Must Have**

* 12 or more years in the SAP ecosystem, including at least 5 years in pre-sales or solution architecture roles with an SAP partner, systems integrator or SAP.

* Strong understanding of RISE with SAP, GROW with SAP and S/4HANA migration approaches, and what it takes to deliver them well.
* Hands-on implementation experience as a solution architect, finance lead or functional lead on S/4HANA programs.

**Good to Have**

**What we look for:**

Mindset matters as much as experience. We are looking for someone who:

* **Thinks like a founder.**
  Energised by building something new, takes ownership and creates assets others can reuse.
* **Works as one team.**
  Collaborates closely with sales, delivery, SAP and colleagues across the US, UK and India.
* **Is AI-native**
  . Uses AI to improve how presales and delivery are performed and helps shape our AI-enabled S/4HANA proposition.

**What we offer**

* The chance to be a founding member of a new SAP S/4HANA business and shape how it goes to market.
* The backing of an established SAP Endorsed Partner: delivery capability, SAP relationships, an existing client base and global teams spread across the US, UK, Netherlands and India.
* Direct access to, and partnership with, the practice leadership and Acuiti Labs leadership team.

Given Antier's work across Web3, Blockchain, Artificial Intelligence, enterprise applications and technology services, the individual must possess the ability to understand emerging technologies, evaluate their business applicability and guide the development of solutions from conceptualisation to production.

This is a hands-on architecture and strategic technology leadership position. We are looking for someone who can independently establish technical direction, challenge existing approaches, guide engineering teams and contribute to building new technology capabilities and solutions from scratch.

Key Responsibilities

cc4b34a3.title: Solution Architect
cc4b34a3.description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators who are focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

  

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

  

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies that rely on our best-in-class platform.

  

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals and we have fun celebrating
our wins.

  

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and be your best self!

At Anaplan these words come to life by making employees feel empowered and inspired.
  
Building a strong culture around company values is an ongoing journey that will continue to be the core of our existence.

  

We want you to think big and act bold through expressing your authentic best self! Anaplan is looking for a tenacious
**SOLUTION ARCHITECT**
 to join 
**PROFESSIONAL SERVICES**
in
**INDIA.**
This is a stellar opportunity to get involved in a highly visible, large scale SaaS cloud company. This role is an immediate full-time position. If you’re ready to roll up your sleeves and seek unique problems that no one else is solving, keep reading.

  

**Come see for yourself what an exciting place to work looks like**

  

**Insight on your impact**

  

We're not looking for average.  Do you enjoy diving into issues and designing complex solutions?  Do you have a passion for data, multi-dimensional modeling and data integration? If so, this job is for you.

  

**What you'll be doing:**

  

As an Anaplan Solution architect, you are primarily responsible for architect, design and the successful delivery of Anaplan planning solutions in strategic accounts. You will:

  

  
* Understand, review and gather client requirements per Anaplan defined scoping & analysis
  
* Translate existing solutions, spreadsheets, and business problems into sophisticated Anaplan multi-dimensional models
  
* Modify existing models as part of a connected solution, optimization, or to incorporate new functionality
  
* Serve as the architectural SME for large-scale connected planning solutions
  
* Exemplify The Anaplan Way
  
* Provide candid, meaningful feedback and progress updates in a timely manner to the Project Manager/Business Partner and team
  
* Develop Anaplan model documentation
  
* Participate and/or lead Data Integration and Migration Solutions
  
* Participate and/or lead UAT testing and deployment
  

  

**Your qualifications, your influence**

  

*To be successful in the role, you must possess the following skills*

  

  
* A 6 year degree in Finance, Accounting or Supply chain experience
  
* 4+ years’ experience implementing Enterprise Performance Management solutions or 4+ years experience in Data and Analytics
  
* 4+ years experience in either of following functional areas : Financial Planning & Analysis or Sales Performance Management
  
* Sophisticated Microsoft Excel / financial modeling skills
  
* Proven knowledge of a formal system implementation methodology – requirements gathering, design, build/test and deploy (Agile methodology preferable)
  
* Superb written and oral communication skills
  
* Proven track record to lead execute responsibilities simultaneously
  
* Appetite for service excellence and a collaborative style
  
* Strong understanding of data integration (inbound and outbound)
  
* Passion for business analytics, modeling and planning
  
* Excellent problem solving and analytical skills
  
* Results-oriented, motivated, self-starter
  
* Coaching mentality
  
* Collegial, open and grounded in integrity
  
* Desire to work with a truly dynamic and exciting team, with a “roll-up your sleeves” approach
  
* Strong desire to excel and be committed to gaining exposure to multiple industries while further developing your career
  

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion**

**and Belonging**

  

Build your career in a place that thrives on diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

  

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

  

**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

  

Anaplan does not:

  

  
* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
  
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible, and then followed up via written communication.
  

  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

c5c945d7.title: Solution Architect Pre-Sales
c5c945d7.description:
**Position: Solution Architect Pre-Sales**

Experience: 12+ Years

Qualification: Bachelor’s Degree in in Engineering / Computer Science / IT (or equivalent)

Location: Trivandrum

About Our Client:

Our Client, with Headquarters in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, is an innovative IT consulting company with almost 3 decades of industry presence with a primary focus on Public Administration. They have established themselves as an organization delivering mission critical projects to Government Clients across the country. Our client confirm to Global Quality Standards including CMMI DEV/5, ISO 9001:2015, ISO 20000 and ISO 27001. Currently they are working on Government Projects in multiple states in the Country.

**Job Description:**

We are looking for a Solution Architect – Pre-Sales who will take ownership of the technical solutioning and technical content of bids and proposals. The primary responsibility of this role is to analyse RFPs and customer requirements, define the appropriate technical solution and architecture, make technology and implementation approach decisions, and lead the preparation of the technical response for bid submissions.

The candidate will work closely with Business Development, Domain Experts, Product Teams, OEMs/Technology Partners, Project Management, and senior management to develop technically sound, compliant, scalable, and commercially viable solutions.

**Responsibilities:**

1. RFP Analysis & Technical Assessment

* Lead the
  **technical analysis of RFPs, RFIs, EOIs, and tender documents**
  .
* Analyse and interpret functional, technical, architectural, integration, infrastructure, security, performance, data migration, and O&M requirements.
* Prepare a detailed
  **technical requirement and compliance matrix.**
* **Identify technical gaps, ambiguities, dependencies, risks, assumptions, and deviations in the RFP.**
* **Identify areas requiring clarification from the customer and prepare technical clarification queries.**
* **Assess the technical feasibility of the opportunity and advise BD team on the appropriate solution approach.**

2. Technical Solutioning & Architecture

* Take ownership of the technical solution proposed for the bid.
* Define the solution approach based on the RFP requirements, existing products, customer needs, and project constraints.
* Decide whether the requirement should be addressed through product/framework, customization, custom development, OEM/third-party solution, integration, or a combination of these.
* Prepare the required solution architecture, architecture diagrams, workflows, and integration architecture.
* Evaluate different technical options and recommend the most suitable solution considering functionality, scalability, security, timeline, complexity, risk, and cost.

3. Technical Proposal Preparation

* Lead and own the preparation of the technical proposal / bid response.
* Prepare and review all technical sections of the proposal.
* Ensure the technical response is clear, accurate, and compliant with the RFP.
* Coordinate with domain, product, and technical teams to collect the required inputs.
* Ensure the proposed solution, architecture, resources, timeline, and commercials are aligned.
* Conduct the final technical review of the bid before submission.

4. Technical Compliance & Bid Quality

* Take ownership of the
  **technical compliance matrix**
  and ensure that all mandatory requirements are adequately addressed.
* Validate that every important RFP requirement has a corresponding response in the technical proposal.
* Identify non-compliance or potential technical disqualification risks before bid submission.
* Review the complete bid from a technical perspective before final submission.

5. Technology & Product Evaluation

* Evaluate available products, frameworks, OEM technologies, and third-party solutions against RFP requirements.
* Recommend appropriate technologies and products for the proposed solution.
* Coordinate with OEMs and technology partners to obtain technical inputs, architecture information, compliance details, and product capabilities.
* Evaluate
  **build vs. buy vs. customize vs. integrate**
  options.
* Identify opportunities to leverage existing company IP, products, reusable frameworks, and accelerators.

6. Technical Estimation & Solution Planning

* Prepare technical estimates covering effort, resources, skills, timelines, infrastructure, licences, third-party components, integrations, data migration, testing, security, and O&M requirements.
* Validate whether the proposed solution is technically feasible within the proposed timeline and budget.
* Work closely with the Commercial/Bid Team to ensure alignment between the technical solution and commercial proposal.

7. Customer & Technical Presentation

* Participate in customer discussions, technical workshops, pre-bid meetings, and clarification sessions.
* Present the proposed solution and architecture to customers and evaluation committees.
* Conduct technical demonstrations and solution walkthroughs when required.
* Respond to technical queries raised during the bidding and evaluation process.
* Support technical negotiations and post-bid technical clarifications.

8. Bid-to-Delivery Transition

* Conduct structured technical handover of the awarded solution to the delivery team.
* Explain the proposed architecture, technical commitments, assumptions, dependencies, and solution approach.
* Highlight any specific technical commitments made during the bid that need to be tracked during implementation.
* Support the delivery team during the initial project phase where clarification of the proposed solution is required.

**Required Technical & Architecture Skills**

Strong understanding of enterprise IT concepts, including:

* DBMS (RDBMS and NoSQL)
* Web Servers and Application Servers
* Hands-on development experience in at least one programming language (e.g., Java, Python, .NET or equivalent)
* Application design patterns and coding best practices
* APIs and system integrations (REST / SOAP / event-based integrations, etc.)
* Microservices and monolithic architecture concepts
* Cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP – architectural and deployment understanding)
* Containerization and orchestration concepts (Docker, Kubernetes – conceptual)
* Data migration strategies and ETL concepts
* Analytics, reporting, and dashboards
* AI / ML fundamentals and use cases
* Blockchain and IoT concepts
* Data Centre (DC) and Disaster Recovery (DR) architecture

**Experience & Qualification**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering / Computer Science / IT or equivalent.
* **12+ years of overall IT experience.**
* **Minimum 5–8 years of experience in Solution Architecture/Technical Pre-Sales Head/ Technical Consulting**
  .
* Prior hands-on software development experience is mandatory.
* Proven experience in
  **technical proposal preparation and RFP-based bidding.**
* **Experience in large-scale Government / PSU / Enterprise IT projects is highly desirable.**
* **Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi.**

1ed579b9.description:
Hi,

  

Wishes. GSN provides corporate search services, identifying and bringing talented professionals to meet the needs of IT and non-IT clients across India. The company has been supporting client hiring needs for over 20 years.

  

Currently we are actively hunting for **Senior Security Architect** for one of our MNC Client. Kindly find below the detailed Job Description for your better understanding.

  

**Exp Range : 12 to 20 yrs**

**Work Location : Bangalore / Pune / Chennai**

**Work Mode : Hybrid**

**CTC Range : Rs 45 LPA to Rs. 50 LPA**

  

**\*\*\*** Looking for **SHORT JOINERS \*\*\***

**Job overview :**

As **Senior Security Architect**, you will be the senior technical adviser within the offshore consultancy team. Working under the technical direction of the UK Head of Service, who holds design authority, you will produce the security architecture, design and risk material that underpins the service, and provide technical leadership to the offshore engineers.

**This is a design, review and advisory role.** You will work within clients offshore consultancy team, outside the client's operational environment. You will not have access to the client's operational systems or data and will not make live changes. Operational changes are implemented by UK-based, security-cleared personnel; your work provides the designs, analysis, recommendations and assurance that those changes depend on. You will work from information released to the team through clients controlled UK service boundary.

  

**Essential skills:**

* **Enterprise security architecture across network, identity, endpoint, cloud and data security domains.**
* Designing logging and SIEM integration architectures, including log source definition and retention requirements.
* Applying **risk assessment methods** such as **ISO/IEC 27005 and NIST SP 800-30**.
* Working knowledge of the **NIS Regulations, NCSC CAF, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF and CIS Controls.**
* Reviewing proposed changes for architectural and security risk and producing clear, evidence-based recommendations.
* Excellent written communication for executive, governance and regulator-facing documentation.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Produce and maintain security architecture and design documentation (high-level and low-level designs) for the client's security tooling estate, for approval by the UK Head of Service.
* Carry out architecture and risk reviews of proposed high-risk changes (firewall, intrusion prevention, gateway, privileged access and application control) before they are presented to the client's Change Advisory Board.
* Define logging and audit requirements for in-scope security tools, including log sources, feed requirements for the client's retained SIEM, and a retention architecture aligned with client policy and regulatory obligations.
* Assess and recommend tooling and approaches for PKI and secrets management.
* Produce NIS Regulations and NCSC Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF) alignment assessments and contribute evidence to the client's regulatory reporting.
* Prepare inputs for the client's governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) reporting on the enterprise's security status.
* Develop risk treatment plans in line with client policy and industry best practice and maintain inputs to the security risk register.
* Prepare technical content and risk papers for the client's cyber security governance board, in support of the UK Head of Service and the Lead Information Risk Manager.
* Maintain the master set of security architecture diagrams and ensure that diagrams produced by the engineering team are consistent and up to date.
* Identify and assess continual improvement opportunities, including benefit-cost appraisal and sequencing into quick wins, foundational change and strategic uplift.
* Apply appropriate consideration of operational technology (OT) and IT/OT boundary risk in all architecture and design work.
* Provide technical leadership, peer review and mentoring to the Lead Security Engineer, Security Engineers and Vulnerability and Patch Manager.
* Support the growth of Clients Cybersecurity Practice through knowledge sharing, technical contribution and client-facing delivery excellence.

  

**Required Qualification :**

* **12+ years in IT and cybersecurity, including 6+ years in security architecture for enterprise or CNI environments.**
* **Experience producing architecture, design and risk artefacts for regulated organisations.**
* **Experience supporting governance boards, risk registers and GRC reporting.**
* Experience working with multi-supplier environments and managed security service providers.
* **CISSP, CISSP-ISSAP or SABSA Chartered Foundation (at least one required).**
* **TOGAF,** a cloud security certification (e.g. **CCSP, AZ-500, AWS Security Specialty**) or **GICSP/ISA/IEC 62443 certification** would be advantageous.

  

**\*\*\*** Looking for **SHORT JOINERS \*\*\***

If this role excites you and aligns with your aspirations, don't hesitate to call me @ **9840035825** directly or click **APPLY ONLINE**. Let's explore this opportunity together!

  

Thanks and Regards,

**Ananth** | GSN | +91.98400.35825 | Google review : https://g.co/kgs/UAsF9W

afac32f0.description:
**Description**
Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)
  
  
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
As a Customer Solution Manager you will work with the largest and most complex enterprises in the world, to enable their multi-year journey to the cloud. In this new, highly visible, role you will ensure that all AWS teams work together effectively and efficiently to deliver migration, modernization and GenAI outcomes for the customer in relation to Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
You will be a trusted advisor to the customer. You will leverage your complex program management, technical, organizational, and transformation expertise to understand customer's business and strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and drive the implementation to success by working with the customer, AWS, and our partners. You will understand your customers' biggest IT challenges and provide prescriptive guidance, based on AWS best practices, to guide them through their migration and modernization journey to AWS at scale.
  
  
You will take end-to-end ownership of multiple migration, modernization and GenAI projects within a single enterprise or across several enterprises, utilizing your communication skills to interface with and influence a broad range of multi-disciplinary teams (Business development, solutions architecture, support, product, professional services, and partners). The Customer Solution Manager role is responsible for cloud migration and modernization programs (incl. technical, operational, organizational, and education) that span across traditional IT teams and business units.
  
  
Engaging from the inception stage onwards, you will have a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture, and processes, you will be your customer's voice within AWS, ensuring that their needs are accurately communicated to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. Engaging during the latter stages of the business cycle you will be responsible for ensuring consistent best-practices are applied, including: (1) ensuring Migration Readiness Assessment (MRA) is conducted and bringing in SMEs to deliver the migration foundations (e.g. landing zone build, security controls, operating model, training etc.), (2) Migration kick off workshops are conducted (including stakeholder alignment), and (3) Executive Steering Committees and reporting are established, including customer, partner, and AWS Cloud exec sponsors and ensure mechanisms are in place to identify and mitigate any identified risks. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by delivering successful IT transformation programs. You will ensure that the customer IT and business stakeholders are aligned, to ensure broad adoption of the migration and modernization across the customer organization. You will use AWS mechanisms to inform the customer migration journey. Where required, you will lead the interaction with specialist teams, ProServ and Partners for handoffs, especially with respect to migreation, modernization and GenAI implementation.
  
  
In addition to your customer facing responsibilities, you will help shape the rapidly growing Customer Solution Management function, where your passion to define and implement standard processes, methodologies, and tools will be highly valued. Passionate about customer value creation, you will be adept at measuring and quantifying customer value realization and ensuring it stays on path. Successful candidates will have a technical program management background, technology foundation and consultative mindset, be detail driven, and have experience in managing teams to deliver complex programs. You will be a passionate and proven leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, communicate confidently at both the executive and project team level, and collaborate with a wide range of technical and non-technical teams, regardless of geographical or organizational boundaries to ensure compliance with AWS Standards, policies and best practices. You will be comfortable in working with diverse teams to ensure appropriate partners are on-boarded and involved in the migration as required. Be an active participant of steering committees and governance structures regardless of who is leading the migration and modernization and act as the point of contact for escalations if the migration and modernization hits barriers. You will be proactive in assessing Migration and modernization progress and design and implement plans to mitigate any risks or delays. Along with project management cadence, you will support the people and process pillars of migration including CCOE design and be the overall owner of reporting and system updates related to the health of migration. You will be a natural problem solver with a cool head that can deal with ambiguity, work autonomously to drive the deliver results for your customer, build IP, and share best practice across geographies.

1a862fe5.title: Program Manager
1a862fe5.description:
**Who we are**
--------------

Mindtickle is the leading AI-powered revenue enablement platform, helping sales teams learn faster, practice smarter, and perform at their best. We bring together onboarding, training, coaching, content, digital sales rooms, conversation intelligence, and AI role-plays into one platform so revenue teams have everything they need to build winning sellers.

Global companies, like Fortune 500 organizations, trust Mindtickle to support their revenue teams. Customers and industry analysts have also recognized us. G2 has ranked us the #1 Sales Training & Onboarding platform for 28 consecutive quarters, and Forrester has recognized Mindtickle as a Leader in revenue enablement. Mindtickle was also recognized as AI-Based Sales Solution of the Year by the 2025 AI Breakthrough Awards and has received Stevie Awards for Technology Innovation and Customer Support Excellence.

At Mindtickle, we're helping companies create high-performing revenue teams, and we're looking for people who want to help shape what's next.

### **Role summary**

The Program Manager, Services runs the internal programs that make Mindtickle Services efficient, predictable and profitable. The role spans all four service lines — Professional Services, Content as a Service (CaaS), Managed Services and Technical Solutions — rather than a single customer engagement.

You will own portfolio-wide visibility into cost, revenue, margin and sourcing (in-house vs. outsourced); run strategic Services initiatives from charter to closure; coordinate internal response on escalations and accounts that need operational support; and build the executive narratives that leadership uses with founders, Sales and customers.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for a structured operator who is equally comfortable in a spreadsheet, a platform, a cross-functional working session and an executive deck.

### **Key responsibilities**

**1) Services portfolio governance & visibility**

* Build and maintain a single source of truth across PS, CaaS, Managed Services and Technical Solutions: active programs, capacity, utilization, delivery health and risk.
* Run the Services governance cadence — weekly portfolio reviews, monthly business reviews and quarterly planning — with clear decision logs and action tracking.
* Define and standardize portfolio metrics and reporting so leadership can see issues early and act on data, not anecdotes.

**2) Program financials: cost, revenue & sourcing**

* Track Services revenue, cost and margin by service line, account and program; surface variance and its drivers.
* Maintain clear visibility into what is delivered in-house versus outsourced — vendor spend, contractor utilization and the cost/quality trade-off of each.
* Support pricing, estimation and capacity models with leadership, Finance and Presales; flag margin risk before deals are signed and during delivery.
* Prepare inputs for budgeting, forecasting and headcount planning.

**3) Strategic initiatives**

* Charter, plan and drive Services-wide initiatives end to end — e.g., AI-led delivery transformation, new service packaging, operating-model changes and tooling rollouts.
* Own initiative governance: scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, RAID logs and success metrics.
* Hold cross-functional owners accountable and report progress and outcomes to leadership.

**4) Escalation & account operations support**

* Act as the program lead on escalations: assemble the right internal team, run the recovery plan, track commitments and close the loop.
* Provide operational support to accounts that need it — resourcing gaps, cross-team dependencies, commercial or scope clarity — without becoming the day-to-day delivery owner.
* Capture root causes and turn recurring issues into process or product fixes.

**5) Operational efficiency & process improvement**

* Identify inefficiencies across service functions — hand-offs, duplicated effort, tooling gaps, manual reporting — and drive measurable fixes.
* Standardize playbooks, templates and operating rhythms across service lines.
* Partner with team leads to apply AI and automation to internal workflows (reporting, estimation, resource allocation).

**6) Executive communication & storytelling**

* Build executive presentations for founders, leadership reviews, Sales/GTM forums and customer executive meetings.
* Turn operational data into a clear narrative: what is happening, why it matters and what decision is needed.
* Draft briefs, business cases and updates for Services leadership.

**Tools, cadences & metrics**

**Tools:** Jira, Rocketlane, Excel/Google Sheets, Salesforce (inputs), BI dashboards, Google Slides/PowerPoint, and AI assistants for analysis and drafting.

**Our Culture & Values**
------------------------

We hire builders, people who move fast, learn from failure, and use AI as a default part of how they work. Our values- Delight Your Customers, Act as a Founder, and Better Together- aren't wall decor. They're how we make decisions here.

Growth at Mindtickle looks like owning more, not just doing more. Your scope will outgrow your job title if you want it to. You'll work alongside people who've scaled revenue tech globally, get direct feedback from leaders invested in your development, and take on challenges before you feel ready because that's how the best growth happens.

Our team spans 5+ countries, backgrounds, and perspectives. We believe the best products are built by people who bring different ways of seeing the same problem - and everyone has a seat at that table.

We hire for potential. Apply even if your experience doesn't match every requirement; your skills, perspective, and drive matter here. At Mindtickle, you can be yourself, build your career, and do the best work of your life alongside people who genuinely want to see you succeed.

We believe the best products are built by teams with different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of seeing the world. We welcome every unique identity, and we mean that.

**Mindtickle is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Your Right to Work: In compliance with applicable laws, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the respective work locations and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

c9d9a75d.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Data
c9d9a75d.description:
**Aliases**
**:**
Project Manager, Program Manager, Product Manager, Data Operations Lead, Data Delivery Lead, Technical Delivery Lead, or Data Governance Lead.
  
  
**About Truveta**
Truveta is the world's first health provider-led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta's ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a unique combination of health, software, and big data expertise who share our company values.
  
  
**This opportunity**
Join the founding team of the Truveta India Development Center and play a pivotal role in shaping its future. As one of the early employees, you will help build and scale a high-impact organization while contributing to the products and platforms that advance healthcare through data and AI. This is an unusual chance to influence both the technical direction and the culture of a growing global engineering hub.
  
  
You will be the program owner for the Data Platform work carried out in India. That means the data-source onboarding, the processing and quality programs, the governance and access work, and the release and adoption of what the team builds. It is a single, senior, hands-off-the-keyboard role with real accountability and no direct reports.
  
  
**Who We Need**
We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead complex, cross-functional programs across data acquisition, data processing, data quality, governance, platform delivery, and data-product adoption. You will work closely with engineering, data engineering, product, data science, operations, security, compliance, and business stakeholders to convert ambiguous data challenges into clear programs, measurable outcomes, and reliable production capabilities.
  
  
You will have built systems and we expect you to read an architecture diagram without help, to follow a design review closely enough to ask the question everyone else missed, and to know from experience which risks are worth a week of the team's time and which are not. You will not have formal authority over the teams you depend on, so the job is done through clarity, technical credibility, and follow-through.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
In this role you will:
  
  

* Own programs from problem definition and planning through delivery, adoption, and post-launch measurement.
* Build and maintain roadmaps, milestones, dependency maps, risk registers, decision logs, and the delivery mechanisms that keep them useful.
* Partner with engineering and data teams on architecture, technical constraints, sequencing, and delivery risk, at a depth that lets you challenge the plan rather than only record it.
* Coordinate data-source onboarding, ingestion, transformation, normalization, enrichment, and validation programs.
* Drive resolution of data-quality issues, operational defects, and recurring pipeline failures, including the root-cause work that stops them recurring.
* Coordinate data governance, access control, privacy, security, metadata, lineage, and compliance initiatives.
* Identify cross-team blockers and drive them to resolution without relying on formal authority.
* Facilitate technical reviews and ensure major decisions, trade-offs, assumptions, and risks are written down where people will find them.
* Coordinate launch readiness, release management, operational support, and post-launch reviews.
* Prepare clear written updates and recommendations for engineering and business leadership across India and Seattle.
* Improve program management practice, reporting automation, delivery predictability, and operational maturity at the site.

**Required Qualifications**
The experience requirement is 11+ years in total, composed of 7+ years in a hands-on individual-contributor technical role and 4+ years in a technical program or project management role. The two are counted separately and added; a year spent doing both is counted once.
  
  

* At least 11 years of professional experience in total.
* At least 7 years in a hands-on individual-contributor in technical roles such as software engineering, quality assurance, data engineering, analytics engineering, systems engineering, or platform engineering.
* At least 4 years in a technical program management or technical project management role, owning delivery across engineering teams.
* Experience delivering programs involving data platforms, data pipelines, data governance, analytics infrastructure, or distributed systems.
* Working knowledge of data ingestion, ETL and ELT, batch and streaming pipelines, APIs, databases, cloud platforms, and data quality.
* Ability to read architecture diagrams and hold a substantive conversation with engineers about designs, trade-offs, dependencies, and operational risk.
* Experience managing dependencies across multiple teams, driving requirements, delivery plans, risk management, release readiness, and adoption.
* Strong written communication, including executive status reporting and written recommendations that carry out a decision.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity and influencing teams.
* Familiarity with Agile development, release processes, incident management, and production operations.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
The following skill sets would be good to have:
  
  

* SQL or equivalent data-querying ability used in practice rather than in principle.
* Hands-on background with Kafka, Spark, Flink, Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, AWS Glue, or comparable platforms.
* Experience with data governance, metadata, data lineage, access control, privacy, security, or compliance programs.
* Experience with external data suppliers, healthcare data, financial data, or other regulated datasets.
* Experience operating data platforms against measurable uptime, freshness, accuracy, completeness, latency, and cost targets.
* Experience managing distributed programs across India and the United States.
* Experience standing up program management practice at a new site or in a new platform area.
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Aha, Linear, Asana, Smartsheet, or equivalent tools.

8292473d.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
8292473d.description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.8B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a highly accomplished Technical Program Manager (TPM) — at the Staff level — to play a pivotal role in spearheading our product development and geographic expansion initiatives. This strategic role requires a deep technical background to effectively partner with product managers and engineering managers, providing technical leadership to own the execution plan and deliver complex, cross-team engineering initiatives. You will be the champion for predictable and timely delivery, able to take ownership of and drive the mitigation of risks to the program, and skilled in facilitating quantifiable success across diverse engineering and product teams. Your core responsibility is to ensure the predictable delivery of products by actively engaging in technical discussions, identifying and proactively resolving dependencies and technical blockers, mitigating architectural risks, and applying best-in-class program management practices.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Technical Strategy & Planning
  
  

* Drive strategic, cross-functional planning and prioritization, partnering with Product and Engineering leadership to develop comprehensive program plans, including roadmap definition, dependency mapping, and resourcing models.
* Drive the process of translating high-level business and product requirements into actionable, concrete engineering tasks, milestones, and technical specifications.
* Contribute to the definition and tracking of effective technical metrics, driving improvements that optimize engineering operating performance and system health.

Technical Execution & Delivery
  
  

* Lead and facilitate regular program-level meetings and reviews with Product and Engineering leadership to ensure projects achieve successful outcomes.
* Proactively monitor program health, tracking status, risks, issues, and complex technical dependencies across engineering teams.
* Deep dive into technical issues to facilitate resolution, and drive appropriate executive-level escalations and program-level change management processes as-needed.
* Take personal ownership of engineering roadblocks and technical delays, escalating issues appropriately and driving them to timely closure by working directly with engineering leads.

Process & Communication
  
  

* Manage high-level program communications, ensuring all stakeholders—from delivery teams to executive management—are consistently informed of roadmap changes, release plans, and delivery status, with a clear explanation of technical trade-offs and risks.
* Establish, document, and champion the adoption of new program frameworks, tools, and best practices across the R&D organization.
* Act as an agent of change, helping to establish and strengthen the Technical Program Management function across the company.

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience as TPM, Engineering Lead, Manager, or equivalent working directly with software engineering teams.
* Proven track record to communicate technical issues effectively to technical and non-technical partners at different levels of the organization.

2673a1ca.title: Senior Program Manager (Platform)
2673a1ca.description:
**Company overview:**
TraceLink is the world’s largest Agentic Business Network, enabling life sciences and healthcare companies to build and manage a scalable digital workforce of governed, no-code AI agents that execute and coordinate mission-critical supply chain operations alongside human teams. Powered by the Integrate-Once™ OPUS platform, TraceLink links more than 300,000 network participants, enabling multi-enterprise processes at global scale.
  
  
Founded in 2009 with the simple mission of protecting patients, today Tracelink has 5 global offices, over 800 employees and more than 1700 customers in over 60 countries around the world. Our expanding product suite continues to protect patients and now also enhances multi-enterprise collaboration through innovative new applications such as MINT.
  
  
Tracelink is recognized as an industry leader by Gartner and IDC, and for having a great company culture by Comparably.
  
  
**Senior Program Manager**
**What will you be doing?**

* Prepare project plans and collaborate with highly technical stakeholders (Engineering, Product Management, Architecture, Security, Cloud Operations, etc.)
* Monitor the progress of projects and report status, plans, and issues to executive management
* Operate cross-functionally in an agile environment to support the delivery of comprehensive, on-time, high-quality products, and solutions
* Hands-on release coordination, ensuring predictability and quality of application, solution, and platform deployments
* Work with other members of the product management organization to ensure new functionality and fixes are being evaluated and prioritized in a timely manner
* Develop and implement strategies to minimize schedule and technical risk
* Document processes and procedures for use and educate team members to ensure consistency across the team members
* Engage internal stakeholders across multiple organizations to identify opportunities to improve processes/productivity, drive improvements, and increase awareness

**In this role, you will:**

* Manage Risks, Timelines, Schedules, Resource Availability, Dependencies, Delivery Dates and Communication.
* Partner with executive decision-makers and stakeholders to deliver success and help our customers achieve the desired business value
* Partner with internal teams (Product Management, User Experience, Technical Communications, Services, Support, Engineering, and Executive Sponsors) to ensure coordination and alignment, leveraging all necessary parties to ensure our success
* Apply TraceLink product, business process, methodology & ecosystem knowledge to drive effective projects
* Proactively build and expand business relationships that enable better product quality, time to delivery, and customer satisfaction

**What we’re looking for:**

* BS degree or higher in Project Management, Computer Science, Engineering, IT, Management of Information Systems or equivalent
* 10+ years of technical program management experience
* Solid understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) models as well as knowledge of both Agile and traditional project management principles and practices and the ability to blend them together in the right proportions to fit a project and business environment
* Knowledge in delivering high-quality software solutions using a predictable delivery process
* Strong cross-functional, technical project management experience, including planning, scheduling, monitoring, risk management, and stakeholder reporting
* Demonstrated experience in leading key projects, including strategic customer programs from inception to successful roll-out and beyond

**EMOTIONAL INTELLIGENCE**

Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines.
  
  
Our culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Master's degree or Bachelor's degree and 13+ years, of program, project, portfolio, product, business systems, or platform management experience.

a2a98c65.title: Program Manager - Engineering & Automation Projects , GESI-IN
a2a98c65.description:
**Description**
The Program Manager – Automation & Engineering Projects drives end-to-end project governance for automation, capacity, and Innovation Lab initiatives within the GESI-IN (PMO/Ops Eng/Automation) team. This role is responsible for managing the full lifecycle of approved OP1/OP2 intake requests, maintaining the India Product Development System (IPDS) master tracker, and ensuring project health through continuous risk analysis and timely escalation. The Program Manager owns launch readiness planning with backward-scheduled timelines, coordinates cross-functional stakeholders across Operations, RME, WHS, Finance, GPO and vendor partners, and delivers executive-level business review narratives (WBR, MBR, QBR). Additionally, the role produces monthly newsletters, event-driven flash reports, and leads weekly project reviews and gate-review logistics to maintain cadence and accountability across all active programs.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Tracking all approved OP(OP1 & OP2) Intake requests (ATL/BTL Category) through Laminar intake flow on Capacity, automation initiatives, Innovation Lab, Study & assessment/any other category that requires GESI-IN (Ops Eng/Automation) team’s delivery.
* End to end monitor and control of project through continuous risk analysis at each phases by leveraging Source. Timely escalation of leadership support through proper technical write up & WP doc.
* Own the Innovation lab’s master project tracker — India Product Development System (IPDS) phase, milestones, dev-cycle time, RAG status and payback for every active project. Keep it current and audit-ready.
* Create and maintain tracker of launch (ETA: Go-Live) backward updated status for timely actions/support.
* Business Review Docs: Owning end to end details & quality of all automation/capacity/IL charters for narratives for all business review docs (WBR, MBR & QBR).
* Monthly Innovation Lab Newsletter — project progress, wins, look ahead and team spotlights.
* Issue event-driven flash reports for gate outcomes, milestone hits and critical blockers for leadership attention.
* Coordinate across Operations, RME, WHS, Finance, GPO and vendor partners to keep cross-functional commitments on track.

A day in the life
  
  
A typical day begins with a standup reviewing project health dashboards on GES Source, flagging any RAG status shifts or emerging risks across active Engineering projects and automation charter. Mid-morning is spent updating tracker, aligning milestone timelines, and preparing concise escalation notes for leadership. After lunch, cross-functional syncs with Operations, RME, Finance, and vendor partners keep launch commitments on track. The afternoon wraps up drafting business review narratives or newsletter updates, followed by a gate-review prep session to finalize agendas and close out action items before end of day.
  
  
**About The Team**
GESI-IN (Global Engineering Services & Innovation – India) is the team that delivers for Amazon's India network expansion and consolidation. The team partners with Operations, RME, WHS, Finance, GPO and all other cross functional teams to design, develop and deploy engineering solutions, capacity programs, and automation charters that improve safety, quality, and throughput at scale. The team takes ideas from concept through pilot to network-wide rollout. You will join a fast-paced, data-driven group that values deep-dive problem solving, cross-functional collaboration, and a bias for action to deliver measurable impact on the ground.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Knowledge of MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in a fast-paced, automated, industrial, logistics, production or manufacturing environment

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience of automated equipment including packaging machinery, sortation and conveyor systems
* Experience in preventative maintenance systems

If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
